trailerName: Furious Attack (怒袭, 2026) || Trailer || New Chinese Movie

title: Guided by Horses
overview: In the stunning beauty of the Kimberley, this feature length documentary is a cinematic story of hope, rising from the quiet, unexpectedly powerful bond between a cast of young people and horses, who are participating in a uniquely special sanctuary created by Aboriginal researcher Professor Juli Coffin.

title: Любопытная Варвара. Тайны востока
overview: Varya, a girl who knows everything about forensics and dreams of becoming a great detective like her grandfather, and her best friend Vasya, who is ready to do anything for adventure, will once again prove that childhood curiosity and faith in goodness are stronger than any difficulty.

title: Leo and Tig. The Road to Baikal
overview: Leo and Tig set off on a journey to faraway Lake Baikal to bring back home the lost seal pup named Lufi. Along the way, they make new friends with Zhu, a red panda, and Wukong the Monkey King. They also cross paths with the evil chieftain of a horse herd Tengri-Khan, who wants to seize the seal. For whoever brings Lufi home will be granted any wish by the Master of Baikal – the great dragon Lusud.

title: Между нами, девочками
overview: Three friends, Naika, Zhenya, and Alisa, embark on a traditional spa weekend to escape their routine and family roles, but especially their mothers-in-law. Their plans are ruined when Naika's future mother-in-law, Margarita Pavlovna, unexpectedly joins them, and the three friends' escape from reality and everyday life turns into a true test of their friendship. It turns out they all view life differently.

title: Doctor Glas
overview: The lonely doctor Gabriel Glas despises society's superficiality - until the fashion designer Helga enters his life. She's trapped in a destructive marriage, and Gabriel sees his chance to save her. Soon, they are caught in a web of lies, desire, and power. The deeper Gabriel is drawn into the relationship, the more moral boundaries he crosses - with catastrophic consequences.

title: Slay Day
overview: On Friday the 13th, 1987, in the picture-perfect town of Belle Falls, six teens prepare for their biggest night of the year: the Sadie Hawkins dance. But when the town exhumes the body of the real Sadie Hawkins to unravel the truth behind her killing spree fifty years earlier, a malevolent force returns to the town.

title: 'Tis the Season
overview: Two wealthy children hold a washed-up mall Santa hostage as their Christmas Eve spirals into chaos.

title: O Little Christmas Market
overview: An artist's fights to saves her town's beloved Christmas market from a developer but a budding romance with the architect tied to the deal may help bring about a Christmas miracle.

title: When Anyone Sees
overview: Christian, a young man overlooked by society, burdened by a dark past and escalating madness, finds himself trapped in a world of violence and despair.

title: Paranormal Activity
overview: The eighth installment in the franchise. Plot TBA.

title: Турбозавры. Суперфильм
overview: Viewers will learn about the new adventures of dinosaurs who can transform into cars, and the children Katya, Petya, and Ippolit.

title: Girls und Panzer das Finale: Part 5
overview: The fifth film in the six-part Girls und Panzer: Saishuushou film series.
original_title: ガールズ＆パンツァー 最終章 第5話

title: The Ogre's Bride
overview: In a Japan where humans and demons co-exist peacefully, Yuzu is an ordinary high school girl who lives in the shadow of her older sister, who is the bride of a demon. One day, she has a life-changing encounter with a beautiful ogre who claims her as his bride.

title: unti-unti
overview: Using a camcorder, a young child tries to get her busy parents' attention, hoping to reunite them for another family dinner.

title: Oh..! Sukumari
overview: Follows an aspiring politician who falls in love with Sukumari, a beautiful and soft-natured woman, while her father conceals a secret that threatens their relationship.

title: Don't Be Prey
overview: An edge-of-your-seat adventure into one man’s fight to reclaim his life by taking on the world’s most dangerous marathon swims, the Oceans Seven. Featuring unforgettable characters, raw vulnerability and breathtaking ocean feats, it’s  a gripping, uplifting journey of resilience, reinvention and what it really takes to survive.

title: Zero Intention of Living Quietly
overview: Mistreated by people unable to cope with his unique visible difference, actor Adam Pearson glimpses a path away from isolation through his love of cinema. Upon meeting kindred spirit Ellie - a girl who shares his genetic condition, NF1 - their quest begins to forge a new type of movie hero, and finally press play on life.

title: Just Look Up
overview: A defiant young visionary, part stand-up comic, part young Bob Dylan, part brilliant mind, leads a disruptive climate movement reinventing protest, channeling civil disobedience, and demanding a livable future.

title: Mango Pachcha
overview: Set in Mysuru, a crime drama unfolds across a decade (2001-2011), following a chain of events that builds tension over time. The city's setting plays a key role in reflecting different phases across the years.

title: Sex
overview: An intimate evening between two teenagers is shaken when their emotions, lusts and secret desires collide with the need to capture everything on a mobile phone camera.

title: AS IF
overview: Maya finds an old love letter that describes places in her city—places that have vanished or changed beyond recognition. She walks through these lost locations, guided only by the memories of someone she never knew.

title: Hauntshow
overview: The twisted final broadcast of an underground variety show. A mysterious, macabre, deviant and delinquent double-bill of chillers hosted by Hauntrella, Hauntressa and the dearly departed Hauntiana.

title: Home Bodies
overview: Two children, raised in total isolation by an automated house, begin to confront the mysteries of their existence after an enigmatic stranger arrives from outside.

title: How to Conquer the World
overview: What will be left behind when humanity vanishes from the surface of the earth? Abandoned stations, schools and plants create a post-apocalyptic landscape of the world without people.

title: Four Itchy Boys
overview: Four young men quarantined for a unexplainable, unrelenting itch prepare for a live-stream press event to prove they’re not the monsters the world believes them to be. But behind the scenes, a ruthless producer is plotting a more grotesque spectacle.

title: Stepfather
overview: After years of eradicating any family that falls short of perfection, Darnell believes his new wife Asia and her daughters might finally be the real deal. That is, until tensions rise and they uncover his deadly pattern. Now, getting rid of them won’t be as easy as he planned.

title: Sandiwara
overview: In a night market, five characters recount their own unique story and represent a facet of Malaysian culture rarely explored.

title: I Constantly Thank God for Esteban
overview: Home alone on the eve of her First Communion, 12-year-old Carmen receives an unexpected visit from a trio of neighborhood roller girls and scooter boys. While at her home, the kids make Carmen painfully aware of her religious upbringing, ultimately stealing her First Communion dress, culminating in a final showdown at their local roller rink.

title: Bandit
overview: To save his pregnant wife, a former bandit in Bali returns to the World Premiere of crime with his old friend, only to be drawn into a deadly manhunt when the car they steal turns out to contain a body and a gun.

title: Hito wa Naze Love Letter wo Kaku no ka
overview: A woman writes a letter to a young man, leading to a correspondence with his father that unveils the truth of a 24-year-old high school romance, his son's death, and the power of love letters.

title: Yaarra Antha Paiyan Naanthan Antha Paiyan
overview: Vijay and Shalini’s marriage is crumbling under constant misunderstandings. In the same city, Deepika loses her alcoholic husband Manikandan and is left drowning in loneliness.  Seeking comfort, Deepika and Vijay cross the line and fall into a secret affair.But danger strikes when Sukumar, a corrupt sub-inspector obsessed with Deepika, begins  hunting her for his own desires. As guilt closes in on Vijay and suspicion rises for Shalini, Deepika is trapped between a forbidden relationship and a ruthless predator.  Will Shalini discover the truth? And can Deepika escape Sukumar’s grip before everything collapses?

title: Man Chicken
overview: In this found footage comedy, two brothers go on an adventure to find the urban legend known as "Man Chicken." The trip takes a turn for the worst, as the truth begins to reveal itself, the deeper they travel into the forest.
trailerName: ‘MAN CHICKEN’ (2025) – Found Footage Horror Comedy From Jesse Heisel | Official Trailer

title: Ninja Wars - BlackFox vs Shogun's Ninja
overview: Rikka Isurugi (Chihiro Yamamoto), head of the Fox Clan, is investigating the "White Lotus," a mysterious cult suspected of plotting a rebellion against the Shogunate. During her mission, she encounters Okyo (Kanon Miyahara), a Fuma Ninja dispatched by the Shogun. Their paths converge as they face a formidable common enemy: the Iga Ninja clan, led by Hattori Hanzo (Kane Kosugi), who harbors a deep vengeance against the Tokugawa family. A three-way conflict between the Fox Clan, Fuma Ninja, and Iga Ninja is about to begin.
trailerName: NINJA WARS 〜BLACKFOX VS SHOGUN'S NINJA〜 | Sneak Peek (Members Premiere 3/29)

title: Youri
overview: Amsterdam, 1982. When journalist Jan Brokken meets Youri Egorov – the world-famous Soviet pianist who fled his homeland because of his sexuality – an unexpected friendship begins. Jan, quiet and guarded, is drawn to Youri’s brilliance, excess and freedom; Youri, in turn, recognizes in Jan a kindred outsider. As their bond deepens, Youri inspires Jan the courage to pursue the life he has always postponed: becoming a writer.

title: Venezia Diorama
overview: Through a series of animated art boards depicting a decaying Venice, the film unfolds like a set of postcards, capturing the mythical city's final moments of fragility.  Blending archival footage with contemporary observations, and anchored by the story of the 1902 collapse of St Mark's Campanile, Venezia Diorama invites us to reflect on a city slowly eroding, yet suspended in time.

title: Boy
overview: While housesitting alone, Danny invites an older stranger over for a casual hookup. The charged encounter pushes Danny out of his comfort zone and into a world of confusion, forcing him to face the mismatch of who he is and who he appears to be.

At 8:38 PM, May wakes up in a room with no memory. With one lifeline call, she must uncover the truth, before it’s too late. But is the voice helping her… or hiding something darker? 8 minutes is all she has.

title: The Strawberry
overview: After a terminal diagnosis, Herb Kaplan seeks peace with his broken family and the joy he long overlooked. As old wounds heal and new bonds form, he learns to cherish the sweetness in front of him and say goodbye on his own terms.
trailerName: THE STRAWBERRY | Official Teaser Trailer (Mike Farrell, Doug Jones, 2026)

title: Beneath the Night
overview: A metro driver with colorful hair is unexpectedly chosen as the face of a public transport advertising campaign, blurring the lines between the visible and hidden.

title: Influencer
overview: At K-DOL Academy, where idols gather, the stage is a battlefield and popularity means everything! Confident Sky, cheerful Anroy, and the quietly supportive Little Crab find their relationships growing increasingly complicated as dreams and romance collide. Some push themselves to the limit in pursuit of glory, some let love throw off their rhythm, and some get lost between friendship and competition. Youth has no pause button—“Love Trainee” captures their growth and confessions with the most passionate energy and heartfelt emotions.

title: Dummy
overview: Archibald the Amazing, a ventriloquist nearing the end of his career, gives one final performance with his dummy, Chucklehead. After the show, he tragically takes his own life in his hotel room-but his negative energy inhabits Chucklehead, transforming the dummy into a murderous force of terror. From a class reunion to hotel staff to unsuspecting bystanders, Chucklehead embarks on a blood-soaked rampage, vowing to make it a night to remember.
trailerName: Dummy Killer Puppet Movie Trailer SRS Cinema Mark Polonia

title: No Pain
overview: Davide’s life is turned upside down by a tragic event for which he bears an unwitting responsibility. Devastated by guilt, he is driven to a series of seemingly irrational choices that gradually lead him toward profound consequences. Yet, through his deep emotional bond with Elsa, Davide may still find an unexpected path to peace.

title: The Flush
overview: In 2033, a health records chip enables coverage for medical needs. The FMC, valued at 3 trillion dollars, faces potential issues discovered by Ray Macintosh that could disrupt the healthcare model.

title: Space Ranger: New Worlds
overview: With the Space Ranger program having ended, the elite cosmic soldiers search for meaning in a peaceful galaxy, until a new threat arises.

title: Kamen Rider Eins with Girls Remix
overview: All the incidents occuring around the Girls Remix up to this point were part of Sumire Kurono's plan to create the ultimate Kamen Rider. Now that plan is moving into its final phase. Sumire kidnapes Nayuta Mikazuki again. After performing her final surgery, "Kamen Rider Eins" is finally born. Will the Girls Remix be able to get Nayuta back? And what will become of Nayuta, who has become Kamen Rider Eins?
trailerName: 【予告】仮面ライダーアインズ　ｗｉｔｈガールズリミックス（３０秒）

overview: Two brothers are roped into a scheme to rob from the rich and give to the poor, only to find their victims are not who they think they are.

title: A city beyond the harbor
overview: Tormented by a mysterious malaise, a woman tries to go on with her daily tasks. Meanwhile, her son becomes involved with another young man as all the spaces around them seem to point towards the end.

title: My Undesirable Friends: Part II - Exile
overview: A group of Russian independent journalists flee the country and navigate life in exile after the invasion of Ukraine, focusing on their dispersed lives and ongoing struggle for truth across different nations. While Part I documented their lives in Moscow facing mounting pressure from the Putin regime, Part II chronicles their forced displacement and new realities in various countries, continuing their mission against authoritarianism.
trailerName: My Undesirable Friends: Part II – Exile | Trailer | NYFF64
original_title: My Undesirable Friends: Part II - Exile

title: Holiday Ever After: A Disney World Wish Come True
overview: Lindsey and her extended family head to Walt Disney World to spend a magical Christmas together, but the dream of a jolly holiday gets quickly dashed when Lindsey discovers her room is next door to Philip, a disastrous first date she recently had, who’s also there on a family trip. As Lindsey and Philip’s paths cross throughout their stay, the frost starts to thaw as they learn they’re not so different from each other after all. Thanks to some Walt Disney World magic, the holiday wish Lindsey made in Cinderella Fountain just might turn their rivalry into romance.
trailerName: Holiday Ever After: A Disney World Wish Come True - Coming to Hallmark Channel in 2026
original_title: Holiday Ever After: A Disney World Wish Come True

title: True Justice: Eye For An Eye
overview: Amateur sleuths tackle a fresh challenge at a local school, diving into the fierce world of parent politics. Their investigation uncovers hidden agendas and unexpected alliances as they navigate the complex web within the community.

title: The Hostage's Hero
overview: Ship hijackings in the Malacca Strait are on the rise and attracting global attention. Lieutenant Colonel Taufiq is reassigned to Indonesia to lead a maritime patrol aboard the KRI Karel Satsuitubun. While on their mission, they face the hijacking of the MT Pematang tanker by a group of pirates. Amidst the dangerous task, the soldiers are faced with a dilemma between national responsibility and family.

title: Lift
overview: Six years after an office elevator accident that claimed many lives, PT Jamsa Land is terrorized again. Linda, the company's public relations staff, is trapped in the elevator and forced to face a mysterious voice from the intercom. Her child is taken hostage, and Linda has no choice but to participate in a dangerous game that slowly reveals the dark secrets of the tragedy six years ago.
trailerName: LIFT | OFFICIAL TRAILER | 26 FEBRUARI 2026 DI BIOSKOP

title: The Next Shift
overview: In efforts to try and fit in with his new classmates, Wesley decides to join a couple of them on a night out that leads to a crime that may change the course of his life.

title: Lydia and the Mist Rider
overview: When her older brother Thaddeus is mysteriously kidnapped by the Spellbinder, 11-year-old Lydia sets off to find him in the Misty Sea. Picked up by the crew of a flying ship, the Dolphin, Lydia becomes the apprentice of Ambrosia, a Stargazer. Ambrosia is trying to find other children who have disappeared, including her own son. Determined to solve the mystery, Lydia must learn stargazing magic and ready herself to confront the Spellbinder.
original_title: Lydia et le vaisseau des tempêtes

title: Bullet and Lace
overview: Bullet and Lace, a neon-soaked, Giallo-inspired nightmare, follows a young woman whose favorite true crime podcast becomes the voice of the masked intruder stalking her through the night.

title: Enemy in My House
overview: Enemy in My House is a live-filmed stage play blending mystery, suspense, comedy, faith, and an unforgettable twist. Journalist Monique Daniels is newly married, expecting her first child, and grateful to God for her many blessings—until Harmony, a new assistant from the news station, enters her life.  What begins as casual workdays quietly spirals into daily drama as secrets, sabotage, and temptation rise to the surface. Someone is determined to destroy Monique’s family, her career, and her peace. As the tension escalates, her instincts as an investigative journalist sharpen, drawing her into a dangerous search for the truth.  In a gripping unraveling of deception, Monique is forced to confront a devastating reality: the news anchor isn’t just reporting the headline—she’s become it.  A tense, emotional roller coaster captured live on stage, Enemy in My House delivers powerful performances, sharp storytelling, and a shocking ending that leaves audiences breathless.
trailerName: Enemy in My House | Official Trailer

title: Erased
overview: When confronted by the now 18-year-old son he dismissed before birth, a high-powered businessman must decide between their potential relationship and a life changing financial opportunity.

title: Moonfish
overview: A grieving astronaut who's lost his only companion on a deep-space mining mission must fulfill a strict corporate quota to return home. As his year of solitude passes, his grip on reality unravels the line between the living and non-living.

title: Taboo Cocoon
overview: The life of a hypochondriacal Internet musician takes a turn for the worse after an unexpected reunion with a childhood best friend runs parallel to a wave of mass killings.

title: Lucky Strike
overview: A wounded American soldier fights to survive behind enemy lines during WWII's Battle of the Bulge against the Germans, relying on his instinct, spy craft and a hand-radio to evade capture and find his way back to his unit.

title: Steps
overview: Think you know Cinderella's 'evil' stepsisters? Think again! When misunderstood Lilith is blamed for hijacking the Royal Ball with a stolen magic wand, she accidentally turns her sister Margot into a frog and leaves the kingdom in the hands of a prince-obsessed mean girl. Now Lilith must team up with Cinderella — and a surprisingly dreamy troll — to save the kingdom, repair the fractured fairytale, and prove that even so-called villains deserve a shot at happily-ever-after.

title: Far from Maine
overview: Haunted by the killing by Israeli police of a Palestinian friend from his youth, an Israeli queer filmmaker embarks on a cinematic dialogue across time — confronting memory, friendship, and the genocide unfolding today.  In this intimate cinematic letter, Israeli filmmaker Roy Cohen addresses his Palestinian friend and fellow peace activist Aseel Aslih, who was murdered by Israeli police in their youth. Cohen tells Aslih of his experiences navigating a growingly genocidal society and seeks Aslih’s moral clarity and resilience in the evocative letters he had written as a teenager.

title: Lure
overview: After being invited to a party by a mysterious and alluring woman, six men awake to find themselves part of a cult family's gruesome annual tradition to find the perfect suitor.

title: Dukun Magang
overview: Raka is a final-year student frustrated by the constant rejection of his thesis by his lecturers. Sekar, his college friend, suggests that his thesis explore the world of shamanism. Meanwhile, Mbah Djambrong is a legendary and eccentric shaman from Kalimati, a remote village renowned for its supernatural traditions, holding mysteries about humanity's relationship with the mystical and spiritual world.

title: All About the Money
overview: A son of one of America’s wealthiest families creates a communist revolutionary base in rural Massachusetts as a means of disrupting the capitalist system he grew up in, but has now come to despise. It’s the starting point of an astonishing journey.

title: Nuisance Bear
overview: A polar bear is forced to navigate a human world of tourists, wildlife officers, and hunters as its ancient migration collides with modern life. When a sacred predator is branded a nuisance, it becomes unclear who truly belongs in this shared landscape.

title: Sentient
overview: An investigation into laboratory research on animals exposes a hidden world in which it’s not just the animals getting hurt. The story of Dr. Lisa Jones Engel, a primatologist turned animal welfare advocate, asks whether harming animals and ourselves in science’s name is justified

title: 2DIE4
overview: The film follows Brazilian Formula 1 driver Felipe Nasr as he competes in a real race, capturing a story unfolding in real time.

title: Masked
overview: Masked exposes the often overlooked mental health battles of those on the Autism Spectrum. Chloe Cavelle shares her journey of learning to function in a world not built for her.

title: Zi
overview: In Hong Kong, a young woman haunted by visions of her future self meets a stranger who changes the course of her night -- and possibly her life.

title: Popeye II: Returns
overview: Sequel to Popeye's Revenge (2025). A military experiment goes catastrophically wrong when a test subject escapes after receiving an experimental enhancement serum. Now supercharged with deadly abilities, he descends upon an unsuspecting summer camp with violent intent.

title: Matched: True Love
overview: At a secluded island resort, a matchmaking tour turns into a deadly game when buried secrets surface — forcing a survivor of past app-related murders to fight for her life once again.
trailerName: 映画『マッチング TRUE LOVE』特報映像【2026年秋全国公開】

title: Kidnapped: Elizabeth Smart
overview: Elizabeth Smart's harrowing abduction at 14 from her family's Utah home unfolds through her own words and never-before-seen material in this documentary.

title: Vadh 2
overview: A police officer's pursuit of truth in a shocking prison crime intertwines with the lives of a widowed prison guard and a soon to be released inmate, unravelling a web of morality and redemption.

title: Othello
overview: Moorish general Othello is manipulated into thinking that his new wife Desdemona has been carrying on an affair with his lieutenant Michael Cassio when in reality it's all part of a scheme orchestrated by bitter ensign Iago. Filmed live at the Theatre Royal Haymarket in London especially for the big screen.
trailerName: OTHELLO - Cinema Trailer (David Harewood, Toby Jones & Caitlin FitzGerald)

title: The Last Goodbye
overview: When you own a non-denominational funeral parlour. When you’ve lost your driver’s license for drinking too much. When you fall in love with an office trainee 25 years your junior. When your daughter begins to understand that you’re not the father she thought you were. When the retired boxer who lent you money is on your back. When death seems more interesting than life... What could go wrong?

title: Loss
overview: Amy is having the worst day of her life. Her 16-year-old daughter, Emma, is finally undergoing a heart transplant after waiting over two years. As Emma fights for her life, Amy sits alone in the hospital waiting room, overwhelmed by fear, exhaustion, and a deep anger towards God. She tries to pray but can’t find the words, consumed by rage at the unfairness of it all.

title: F.-M. Banier filmé par A. Arietta
overview: In 2015, Arrietta portrayed his friend François-Marie Banier — his studio, his photographs, his paintings — with a Mekas-like freshness and cheerful detachment. Ten years on, a visit to a country house adds another piece to the fragmentary account of a life shaped by encounters and friendships.

title: Together Forever
overview: A Mormon couple ties the knot.

title: In Spite of Ourselves
overview: Hannah is a determined Portland baker, and Archie, an up-and-coming Los Angeles comedian with a tendency to dodge commitment. What begins as immediate, undeniable chemistry turns into two blissful weeks together—until real life intervenes. Pulled back into their separate worlds, the pair must navigate distance, doubts, and their own hilariously messy insecurities to determine whether love can truly go the distance.
trailerName: IN SPITE OF OURSELVES — Official Trailer (2026)

title: Crisis Actor
overview: Fired from her day job, an impulsive actress crashes a support group and spirals into a chaotic night that forces her to face her addiction to drama.

title: Boulevard
overview: Hasley, a girl with a list of unfulfilled dreams, and Luke, a complex and vulnerable boy marked by a tragic past, find refuge on the boulevard, where they discover whether love can conquer all.

title: Eureka or (The Quest for Nothing)
overview: A lonely surfer sets out to find the holy grail.

title: Lights! Camera!! Scream!!!
overview: Three friends went to Maine to make a horror film.  They disappeared. Their footage didn't.

title: Puro R.A.P.
overview: Five young Panamanian freestyle artists fight to turn their craft into a way of life, as rap becomes their only voice in a country that doesn’t always listen.

title: Con City
overview: Follows a struggling family whose lives change when a receipt printer starts generating money after a lightning strike, leading to public chaos when society discovers the money-making machine.
trailerName: Con City | Official Trailer | Arjun Das | Anna Ben | Yogi Babu | Netflix India

title: The Quiet Beekeeper
overview: In the small community of Åmotfors in Värmland, Olof lives a quiet life as a beekeeper after losing his partner many years ago. All that remains is his teenage daughter Lise, who increasingly seeks to escape the confines of home. Olof struggles to reach her, and grief has long lain buried in silence—until he suddenly falls ill and is forced to confront all that has remained unspoken. With great sensitivity, Marcus Carlsson portrays the different stages of life and reminds us how the fragility between people can hold both pain and light.

title: A Tribe Called Love
overview: Set in a Somali neighbourhood in Toronto, teenagers Farah and Halima as they fall in love despite warnings to stay apart because they’re from different tribes. When Farah’s family relocates to Vancouver, the relationship ends abruptly — until they reconnect in their twenties in Toronto. But the same cultural barriers that once divided them soon resurface. Will their love be strong enough to rewrite their fate, or are some histories destined to repeat themselves?

title: Toko Perlengkapan Mayat
overview: Daeng Sarro, the owner of a mortuary supplies business, asks his children and grandchildren to come and stay at his house in a remote village after his wife dies, until the mourning period is over. However, due to urgent matters, Rahma must return to the city, while her children remain at home. Day by day, various mysterious events begin to haunt Daeng Sarro's grandchildren.

title: Antiheroine
overview: Singer, songwriter, and actor Courtney Love has long had an impact on rock and pop culture. Now sober and set to release new music for the first time in over a decade, Courtney is ready to reveal her story, unfiltered and unapologetic.

title: If I Go Will They Miss Me
overview: A poetic, emotionally expansive father-son story about Black family, grace, imagination, and the hope that love can transform even the most fragile relationships into something more healing and beautiful.
original_title: If I Go Will They Miss Me

title: Ha-Chan, Shake Your Booty!
overview: Haru and Luis love competing in Tokyo’s ballroom dance scene, but after tragedy strikes, Haru withdraws into isolation. When friends coax her back to the studio, she develops an infatuation with the new instructor. She must face what comes next as sparks fly.

title: Night Nurse
overview: As a series of perverse scam calls unsettles an idyllic retirement community, a starry-eyed nurse becomes entangled with her mysterious patient.

title: Seized
overview: When the small town of Marion, Kansas, is thrust into the international spotlight after a police raid on the Marion County Record and the death of its 98-year-old co-owner, a fierce debate ignites about the abuse of power, journalistic ethics, local journalism, and the United States Constitution.

title: When a Witness Recants
overview: In 1983, author Ta-Nehisi Coates learned that a 14-year-old boy was murdered in his Baltimore middle school. Upon revisiting the case, he uncovers the truth: Three innocent teenagers were wrongfully convicted and spent 36 years in prison — creating a lasting impact on the accused, the witnesses, and their community.

title: Drive - The Pretenders
overview: A young race car mechanic fakes an engagement to the most scandalous racing star on the scene—officially for his reputation, secretly for her own chance behind the wheel. But soon the lie threatens to destroy everything, including what has long since become more than just a game.

title: To Hold a Mountain
overview: In the remote highlands of Montenegro, a shepherd mother and daughter proudly defend their ancestral mountain from the threat of becoming a NATO military training ground, stirring memories of the violence that shattered their family.

title: Time and Water
overview: Facing the death of his country’s glaciers and the loss of his beloved grandparents, Icelandic writer Andri Snær Magnason turns his archives into a time capsule to hold what is slipping away — family, memory, time, and water.

title: The Friend's House is Here
overview: In Tehran’s underground art scene, Pari, a theater director, and Hanna, a dancer, are roommates, best friends, actors, and professional partners, navigating rehearsals, performances, and the quiet rituals of everyday life—until their secret circle is discovered. Shot covertly but far removed from familiar portrayals of Iran, directors Maryam Ataei and Hossein Keshavarz blur the boundaries between theatrical performance and lived experience, crafting a luminous portrait of sisterhood where art becomes inseparable from life and even the smallest creative choices can become acts of resistance. Winner of the US Dramatic Special Jury Award for Ensemble Cast at the 2026 Sundance Film Festival.

title: The Disciple: A Wu-Tang Fable
overview: An outsider fueled by relentless determination works his way into the inner circle of the Wu-Tang Clan, where his ambition and creativity converge in the making of an album poised to ignite global controversy.

title: Silenced
overview: After #MeToo broke the cultural silence on gender violence, international human rights lawyer Jennifer Robinson fights against the weaponization of defamation laws to silence survivors.

title: Frank & Louis
overview: Frank, serving a life sentence, takes a prison job caring for aging incarcerated men with Alzheimer’s and dementia. What begins as a self-interested bid for parole becomes a profound, transformative bond with fellow prisoner Louis, offering Frank a glimpse of redemption in an unforgiving place.

title: Queen of Chess
overview: A Hungarian girl dreams of conquering international men’s chess. After a 15-year battle against world champion Garry Kasparov and her domineering father, Judit Polgár revolutionizes the sport’s patriarchal culture to become one of the greatest chess prodigies in history and the greatest woman chess player of all time.

title: The History of Concrete
overview: After attending a workshop on how to write and sell a Hallmark movie, filmmaker John Wilson tries to use the same formula to sell a documentary about concrete.

title: Once Upon a Time in Harlem
overview: A decade after his death, genre-defying filmmaker William Greaves has one last trick up his sleeve with what he considered the most important event he captured on film: a 1972 party he engineered with the living luminaries of the Harlem Renaissance.
original_title: Once Upon a Time in Harlem

title: Mum, I'm Alien Pregnant
overview: When a messy underachiever accidentally gets alien-pregnant, she must overcome skeptical doctors, a useless baby daddy, and her oversharing mum in order to survive and reclaim her life.

title: The Oldest Person in the World
overview: A decade-long global journey chronicles the ever-changing record holders of the title of oldest person alive. What begins as a portrait of longevity becomes a meditation on the passage of time, the randomness of fate, and the joy and profound human experience of being alive.
original_title: The Oldest Person in the World

title: The Last First: Winter K2
overview: A historic race to become the first to summit K2 in winter unravels into tragedy, exposing how ambition, ego, and the pursuit of glory can be as dangerous as the mountain itself.

title: Kikuyu Land
overview: As a Nairobi journalist probes a land battle entangling the local government and a powerful multinational corporation, covered wounds are revealed and family secrets are exposed.

title: Joybubbles
overview: Joybubbles discovers he can manipulate the telephone system by whistling a magic tone. Born blind and yearning for connection, his early obsession unwittingly lays the groundwork for a subculture that shapes the future of hacking and technology.

title: Jane Elliott Against the World
overview: A rural Iowa schoolteacher becomes a national voice against racism after leading a controversial 1968 lesson in discrimination with her all-white third-grade class. Now nearly 90, she refuses to hold back amid today’s fights about race, history, and power after a lifetime of speaking out.

title: Give Me the Ball!
overview: World champion tennis trailblazer Billie Jean King has had a game-changing impact on culture and sports. Rare archive and candid interviews with Billie Jean and those closest to her reveal how one woman put changing the world ahead of saving herself.

title: Ghost in the Machine
overview: The untold origins of artificial intelligence lie not in machines but in power, revealing the fantasies behind the hype that got us here and where we go next.

title: Cookie Queens
overview: A celebration of girlhood and the complexities that come with it, Cookie Queens is a coming-of-age story about the joys, pressures, and tensions woven into one of America’s most cherished rituals: Girl Scout Cookie season.

title: Closure
overview: After his teenage son goes missing, Daniel scours the depths of the Vistula River, torn between the dread of a fatal leap and the hope that his son may still be alive.

title: The Brittney Griner Story
overview: Explores the circumstances that led to Brittney Griner playing basketball outside the U.S. despite being one of the best players in the sport, including her harrowing detainment, unwavering determination to secure her freedom, and her advocacy for the release of other wrongful detainees.

title: Birds of War
overview: The love story of a London-based Lebanese journalist and a Syrian activist and cameraman as told through 13 years of personal archives across revolutions, war, and exile.

title: The Best Summer
overview: Immersive POV camera footage reveals electric performances, candid interviews, and intimate backstage life with the Beastie Boys, Sonic Youth, Foo Fighters, Pavement, Rancid, Beck, The Amps, and Bikini Kill — an all-access view inside an era-defining moment in music.

title: Barbara Forever
overview: An archive-driven exploration of the life, work, and legacy of iconic, pioneering lesbian filmmaker Barbara Hammer.

title: American Pachuco: The Legend of Luis Valdez
overview: Against political resistance and industry skepticism, Luis Valdez pushes Chicano storytelling from the fields to the film screen with Zoot Suit and La Bamba, crafting iconic works that challenge, celebrate, and expand America’s story.

title: American Doctor
overview: United by a shared oath to save lives, three American doctors—Palestinian, Jewish, and Zoroastrian—work in a besieged hospital in Gaza and return to the United States to fight for the patients and colleagues they left behind.

title: The AI Doc: Or How I Became an Apocaloptimist
overview: A father-to-be tries to figure out what is happening with all this AI insanity, and explores the most powerful technology humanity has ever created... and what's at stake if we get it wrong.

title: Aanikoobijigan [ancestor/great-grandparent/great-grandchild]
overview: Trapped in museum archives, Ancestors bend time and space to find their way home. History, spirituality, and the law collide as tribal repatriation specialists fight to return and rebury Indigenous human remains, offering a revealing look at the still-pervasive worldviews that justified collecting them in the first place.

title: Rare Birds
overview: A trouble-making 12-year-old tries to convince her former camp counselor to ditch his dead-end job at the local antique store for one last game of basketball.

title: Lou's Team: The Story of the Humboldt Crabs
overview: Nestled in the redwood forest of Northern California, the Humboldt Crabs, founded in 1945, are the oldest continuously operated summer collegiate baseball team, with their own band, ardent fans, and tradition of winning.
trailerName: Lou's Team: The Story of the Humboldt Crabs | Official Trailer

title: Chhaki Suna
overview: Each victim holds a piece of the puzzle, but solving this deadly game could make the investigator the final player.

title: Wraith
overview: A psychological horror in which a man named Mark wanders a dark, deserted hospital looking for his supposedly dead wife, whose spirit continues to call out to him beyond the halls…

title: Nightmare's Advice
overview: Lucie, a PhD student without a work visa and plagued by insomnia, is trapped in a destructive affair with her thesis advisor while being pursued by a jealous ex. Seeking help from a reclusive shaman on the city’s edge, she meets Béatrice, a young woman as carefree as she is determined to help her.

title: Dolioo
overview: Sarah Jamson, daughter of Hudson’s murdered ally, wages a one-woman war against Hudson, using stealth, strategy, and vengeance-marked corpses to haunt him psychologically. Chloe Varenne, a symbol of lost love and innocence, becomes the spark that pushes KAEL toward rebellion.

title: The Fields of Abbottsville
overview: In Ohio, late 2004, after a young religious fanatic Joshua Tinsman (Brennan Abbott) celebrates his 18th birthday. He is then forced into committing crimes by his preacher Ron Tinsman Jr. (Aaron Hickman) that he doesn't want to follow through on. Years of indoctrination and influence from his friends discourages him from leaving. After all, it's the ideology that he and his childhood friend Stephen grew up with since birth. How can you leave something you spent your whole life working towards? Loosely based on a true story.
trailerName: The Fields Of Abbottsville (Proof Of Concept)

title: A Common Story
overview: Erika and Mauro live in the province, living a simple life made up of reassuring habits and small gestures. When their daughter Irene leaves to study abroad, the house empties, and the balance on which the couple has built their existence seems to be shaken.

title: Back to Buenos Aires
overview: It follows Mariano Guerra as he returns to Argentina to testify against soldiers who tortured him during the dictatorship, focusing not on revenge but on his inner struggle with guilt, trauma, and the lasting psychological impact of violence kept largely off-screen.
trailerName: 'Back To Buenos Aires': exclusive first trailer for Marco Bechis' Venice Competition title

title: Cameron Winter at Carnegie Hall
overview: A concert film documenting Cameron Winter's sold-out performance at Carnegie Hall.

title: Kenatha Kanom
overview: Desperate to find water, residents of a parched village start digging a new well, but what they find is not water but a dinosaur fossil.

title: A Hair Short
overview: A lensless exploration of hair on 35mm film.

title: Krashanka 2.0. The Quantum Paradox
overview: After the events of the first part, where Ivan Zabiyaka built a ballistic missile, he takes on a new invention: a Time Machine, disguised as an old minibus.

title: Breast Friends Forever
overview: Beauty-and-breasts besties Astrid Lee and Audrey Avila team up with sharp-tongued detective and comedy legend Janno Gibbs to solve the hilarious case of men getting way too… well, inflated.

title: Angkinin Mo Ako
overview: Cess Garcia and VMX’s next big thing Dara Lima star in a steamy drama about two sisters and the man who sparks their sensual awakening. A female lawyer hires a young man as tutor for her younger sister but unknown to her, their review sessions are becoming wild

title: To Grandfather's Village 2
overview: Vladik is spending his summer holidays with grandfather Yura again, when Viktor, a former diplomat and Vladik's grandfather by dad, suddenly appears in the village. He quickly finds a common language with the locals, gives his grandson expensive gifts and captivates him with stories about traveling around the world. Rivalry for the grandson's attention breaks out between the grandfathers - from caustic jokes to open confrontation. Grandfather Yura feels more and more that he is losing, but when a dangerous secret from Viktor's past comes to light, he has the opportunity to get rid of a competitor.

title: Krantijyoti Vidyalay Marathi Madhyam
overview: Students and teachers from a Marathi school come together to save their school from demolition, as an international school is set to be built in its place. Personal challenges merge with institutional struggles as they seek preservation of Marathi-medium schools and their local culture, while also acknowledging the need for change.
trailerName: Trailer | Krantijyoti Vidyalay MM | 1st JAN | Kshitee | Hemant | Prajakta | Amey | Siddharth

title: Tosnos
overview: Tosnos (তছনছ) is a Bangladeshi Action, Thriller, Mystery film directed by the acclaimed Badiul Alam Khokon. Produced by Munna Khan Multimedia, this cinematic venture stars Munna Khan and Eamin Haque Bobby in the lead roles, alongside powerful supporting performances from veteran actors Misha Sawdagor and Deepa Khandakar. The story is written by Kamal Sarker. This high-stakes thriller is set to explore a gripping narrative of power, corruption, and revenge.
trailerName: TOSNOS (তছনছ) Official Teaser |  Munna Khan | Bobby | Badiul Alam Khokon | New Bengali Movie 2026

title: MIKE.
overview: Based on real events, a young man is consumed by buried trauma and destructive impulses. As family matters pull him into a chaotic downward spiral, he is forced to confront his past before he loses himself forever.

title: CHAITANYA
overview: The story of Chaitanya, the mystic saint who transformed devotion into a revolution.  The great king Prataparudra learns that God Himself is secretly present in his kingdom. He tries to meet with Him, but he must pass through insurmountable trials to earn His favor.
trailerName: CHAITANYA Movie | Official Trailer | Epic Historical Drama of Divine Love

title: Lifeline
overview: How far would you go, and what would you risk for the one you love? What drives Ananya, a city girl, to this distant village and where will her journey lead?

title: The Project
overview: An Afro-Brazilian filmmaker and a Swiss-Serbian photographer embark on a personal and political journey to confront the colonial mindset that still shapes relationships in today’s world. From Brazil, one of the most unequal countries marked by structural racism, to Switzerland, one of the richest and most privileged nations, they face uncomfortable questions: how can a Black woman thrive in a society built on racism? And how do you decolonize the mind when you’ve grown up surrounded by privilege? In search of answers, they dive into transformative conversations with inspiring voices around the world, while reflecting on their own contradictions, complicities, and hopes.

title: The Face
overview: 17-year-old Joel, a recently recruited night guard, watches over a compound marked by cartel violence. When the darkness begins to whisper, he realizes some secrets never die.

title: Down the Road Apiece
overview: A lonely ranch hand in rural West Texas decides to risk the only life he's ever known when he falls for a hard-pressed woman stranded in the nearby town. He makes up his mind to leave with her, but things don't quite work out as planned.

title: Sun in Lidia
overview: Lidia goes with her mother, Gina, to the beach house where they used to vacation during her childhood. What should have been an opportunity to relax by the sea, begins to reveal unresolved issues in their relationship.

title: Caballé
overview: The beloved opera star Montserrat Caballé faces a challenge that takes her back to the beginning of her career.

title: My Little Hero
overview: Chubby always eats, walks, and plays alone—until one day, he meets a masked tree spirit named Little Tree under a giant tree. Their bond sparks laughter, friendship, and the creation of the “Little Tree Defense Squad,” where four children protect their secret green haven. But when humans threaten to destroy the tree, Little Tree must return to the forest. For the first time, Chubby steps forward, determined to find his friend and protect the world they love with his own courage.

title: National Theatre Live: The Playboy of the Western World
overview: Pegeen Flaherty’s life is turned upside down when a young man walks into her pub claiming that he’s killed his father. Instead of being shunned, the killer becomes a local hero and begins to win hearts, that is until a second man unexpectedly arrives on the scene...
trailerName: The Playboy of the Western World | Audience Reactions | National Theatre

title: Fire, Water, Earth, Air
overview: Four stories from the Nordic region paint a picture of a changing natural world, where the elements rage and where being prepared proves to be much more than sandbags and fire extinguishers.

title: Crayon Shin-chan the Movie: Very Bizarre! My Yokai Vacation
overview: Shin-chan and his family visit his father's home town of Akita in order to view the Omagari Fireworks Festival. When a strange incident to causes the residents of “Yokai Land” to begin running wild throughout Akita and the rest of Japan, Shin-chan and company are lured to “Yokai Land” for an unusual adventure.

title: Milky☆Subway: The Galactic Limited Express Movie: Kakueki Teisha Gekijou Iki
overview: Theatrical compilation of Milky☆Subway: The Galactic Limited Express with new scenes added.

title: Primal Darkness
overview: Cole Harrington, the host of a popular outdoor series, sets out to track down the predator responsible for a series of cattle attacks in rural Nevada. The mystery deepens when he uncovers footage depicting the final moments of two missing university employees.

title: Callback
overview: Max arrives home to find that his boyfriend has booked a callback. All hell breaks loose.

title: Loser Lesbian Vampire
overview: Carmilla is a vampire with a hopeless crush on Laura, an effortlessly cool writing major. To cope, Carmilla throws herself into toxic distractions: hooking up with a Mormon closeted lesbian whose blood tastes like repression, and murdering men (even though she finds masculine blood absolutely revolting.) Torn between hunger and heartbreak, Carmilla's unlife is spiraling. But obsession, like immortality, is hard to kill.

title: Marga en el DF
overview: In the wake of Selena Quintanilla’s murder, Marga’s life takes an unexpected turn at 21 weeks pregnant during a surprise visit to Mexico City.

title: Gender Studies
overview: When a trans college student learns the girl she idolizes is sleeping with their teaching assistant, she takes drastic steps to emulate her.

title: Artificial Love
overview: A lonely man falls in love with his ChatGPT companion, challenging the boundaries of love and what it means to be human.

title: Marcello Hernández: American Boy
overview: Filmed in Miami, Hernández's special features his comedic take on his first-generation American upbringing before a local audience.

title: Mike Epps: Delusional
overview: Follows comedian Mike Epps as he discusses how a little delusion and a lot of hustle made him a star.

title: Skyscraper Live
overview: No ropes. No fear. Free solo legend Alex Honnold risks it all in a high-stakes, live ascent of one of the world's tallest skyscrapers in Taipei, Taiwan.

title: Dosa: Penebusan atau Pengampunan
overview: Bima and her wife, Ersya, have an accident while they're going out of the town and they are trapped in a mysterious hotel, where they are terrorized and forced to face past sins that cannot be avoided.
trailerName: Dosa: Penebusan atau Pengampunan - Official Trailer

title: Chronovisor
overview: A French academic is seduced into a world of untold histories in her scholarly quest to uncover the mystery of a history-capturing camera-like machine created by clandestine Benedictine monks. An academic-noir, armchair mystery in the lineage of Jorge Luis Borges and Umberto Eco.

title: 斗破苍穹剧场版 双帝之战
剑来院线剧场版 十三之争
original_title: 剑来院线剧场版 十三之争

title: Renegade Immortal: Battle of the Immortal Slayer
overview: Trapped in a fatal pursuit within the Celestial Realm of Thunder, Wang Lin faces his ultimate crisis. Watch the underdog defy the odds, flip the script in a world-shaking counterattack, and achieve the ultimate, magnificent feat: SLAYING A CELESTIAL.

title: A Messy Tribute to Motherly Love
overview: When people literally explode from emotional overload, grief is just the beginning. A wildly surrealist charade in which a bereaved man, his friend and mother spiral through village life.

title: Never Again
overview: A mother and son exist in a confined space of constant conflict, where every conversation turns into a fight. They flee their own identities, where love becomes a form of pressure, and care a source of hatred. Both characters speak the same language, but they invest words with different meanings, leaving each other no chance to be heard. The disappearance of their son becomes the point of no return. Having lost her last connection to life, the mother is left alone with a void where suicide is not a cry for help, but the result of a total misunderstanding. It's about the silence that follows words spoken too late.

title: Elsinore
overview: The deeply emotional and inspirational true story of Ian Charleson, a gifted actor whose greatest challenge becomes his greatest triumph. Facing his own mortality with unflinching honesty, wit, and grace, Charleson delivers a courageous performance that becomes a source of healing and inspiration for those around him.

title: Variations on a Theme
overview: An elderly goat herder falls victim to a scam promising long-awaited reparations for her father's WWII service. Structured as a series of recurring visual 'variations', Variations on a Theme is a portrait of endurance and loss.

title: Cyclone
overview: A transgender woman from mainland China travels to Hong Kong with a single, urgent goal: to undergo gender-affirming surgery. Moving through the city in a state of emotional suspension, she navigates temporary lodging, medical bureaucracy, and fleeting encounters with strangers who alternately offer intimacy, indifference, or quiet solidarity. As the date of the operation approaches, her journey becomes less about the procedure itself than about the weight of expectation, fear, and self-recognition.

title: Master
overview: The political ambition of a Bangladeshi teacher corrodes both community and self, as corruption takes hold.

title: Godmother
overview: A meticulously planned desert couples' vacation spirals into chaos when family tensions and a pair of mysterious hosts with devilish intentions transform a romantic getaway into a nightmare.

title: Balloon Animals
overview: Two grocery store employees have an unexpected, helium-fueled encounter with a late-night customer.

title: Treat Her Like a Lady
overview: When single mother Sandra, full of unwavering energy, is evicted from her apartment by the Dutch government due to fraud, she convinces her daughters Harrie and Stella that their emergency shelter is a holiday hotel. Taking care of her children while being the main breadwinner seems impossible, but Sandra won't go down without a fight: with heroism and creativity, she gives her daughters the best summer of their lives.

title: Between Brothers
overview: In this intimate family portrait, documentary filmmaker Tom Fassaert observes the relationship between his father Rob (72) and his older brother René (75). What begins as a tragicomic film about their unusual dynamic – one was a psychologist for many years, the other a psychiatric patient – turns into a moving search for their unknown roots.

title: Concrete Kids
overview: Lonely Lithuanian teenager Rokas, whose mother works abroad, is trying to rise above his depressing post-socialist housing block by singing in a choir. His only refuge – his voice – quickly turns into a threat, as local gangs hunt him for being branded a snitch.

title: The Lounge
overview: Unfairly overlooked employee Liz wants to become a successful corporate creature.

title: Pina
overview: Pina, a 62-year-old lawyer, is in denial about her increasing dementia and is desperate to convince her colleague that she can still work.

title: Saliva Agridoce
overview: After years of trying to leave behind the traumas that marked their lives, a couple decides to start over in an old house far from the city. Boundaries between memory, guilt, and the supernatural begin to disappear.

title: Landship
overview: The Battle of Passchendaele, 1917. For three years the great war has been waging, and the two armies find themselves entrenched along the four-hundred-mile Western Front. At the start of a pivotal allied offensive to break the stalemate, the nine-man crew of a British MKIV Tank set out to destroy a series of heavily defended German bunkers.

title: Destructive Triangle
overview: In a small village, a young woman is desperately caught in the oppressive nets of her relatives. The past with these people is dark; now she has to do something and free herself.

title: Semua Akan Baik-Baik Saja
overview: Mentari's death forces the estranged siblings to reunite under Langit's care. Amidst their respective conflicts and wounds, they learn to accept their loss and rediscover the meaning of family.
trailerName: ‼️OFFICIAL TRAILER GENG RUSUN‼️ EVERYTHING WILL BE FINE | MAY 13, 2026

title: A Russian Winter
overview: After the full-scale invasion of Ukraine, many people in Russia faced a brutal choice: prison, the army – or exile. Margarita, Yuri and their friends are caught in the crosscurrents of history, with no way to return home, but also no place where they feel truly welcome.

title: Memories of a Window
overview: Following crackdowns on protests in Iran, civilians begin documenting the unrest from behind windows. When a woman is shot while recording, a film student writes her a letter raising the question: Can revolution emerge from behind windows?
trailerName: Trailer | Memories of a Window | Amin Pakparvar, Mehraneh Salimian

title: London
overview: Bobby drives back and forth between Vienna and Salzburg, giving lifts to strangers on the way, sharing conversations that drift from the mundane to the deeply personal. In this tender portrait of today’s Europe, anonymity and warmth still go hand in hand.

title: Ghost School
overview: Ten-year-old Rabia wants to know why her school has suddenly closed. Rumours are rife in the village and the authorities are no help. Courageously setting out to find the truth, Rabia navigates rural superstitions, local corruption and a wall of silence.

title: Bucks Harbor
overview: Boys in Downeast Maine are shaped by the brutal winters, their harvesting of the ocean’s bounty and the rigid codes of their fathers. Bucks Harbor explores growing up in a community where a man’s worth is often defined by the strength of his back.

title: The Fabulous Time Machine
overview: What if it were possible to travel back in time to dream of other futures? In the hinterlands of Brazil, young girls navigate the delicate transition from childhood to adolescence while grappling with social media, religion, their dreams, and the stories of the women who came before them. By inventing a time machine, they revisit the pasts of their mothers and grandmothers and imagine a future in which they can be free, fulfilled, and in control of their own choices.

title: Prosecution
overview: After surviving a racist attack, state prosecutor Seyo Kim takes her own case to court – confronting both the perpetrators and a justice system that turns a blind eye to right-wing extremism.

title: Everyone's Sorry Nowadays
overview: On a sweltering summer day, Bianca feels unseen by her parents. Then an unexpected encounter with her favourite female actor, Billie King, helps her to find herself. A tender, imaginative tale about dreams and carving out a space for yourself in life.

title: 9/11: Reclaiming Ground Zero
overview: After the 9/11 attacks, after the smoke was gone, after the rubble cleared away, New Yorkers had a city to rebuild. In response to fast-tracked redevelopment plans, more than 5,000 people gathered in the largest town hall in American history. They came to vote on the city’s six proposals for rebuilding Ground Zero. But instead, the people rejected the top down approach and successfully charted a new path forward. Their work determined what is at Ground Zero today. And their story is an example of what democracy can look like.

title: Freaks Part II
overview: Several years after a traumatic escape, we meet Mary and her daughter Chloe as they live on the road, hiding their powers and identities. They are hunted by the Abnormal Defense Force, paramilitary police that specialize in ruthlessly exterminating ‘freaks‘ like them. Mary is fueled by revenge, determined to find the ADF officer who killed her first child.

title: Drax
overview: Drax, a centuries-old vampire hiding in plain sight, spends his nights painting and resisting the urge to feed. But when he meets Marcus, a magnetic young skater, the lines between hunger, desire, and connection begin to blur.

title: A Little Dream of Me
overview: Cảm Ơn Người Đã Thức Cùng Tôi is an emotional journey of young people searching for answers to the question, “What is your dream?”—only to discover, as they step into adulthood, that the most important question becomes, “Who do you want to pursue that dream with?”
trailerName: Phim Cảm Ơn Người Đã Thức Cùng Tôi | Official Trailer | DKKC: 27.02.2026

title: Home
overview: In the hope of creating a better life, 6-year-old Maja and her parents leave Yugoslavia for Denmark, leaving behind Maja’s two older brothers with the promise they will join once the family is settled. But the new country proves difficult and unfamiliar, and the family struggles to adapt to a new language, culture, and way of life. As the years pass, Maja grows up and becomes a successful artist in Denmark, yet beneath her achievements, she carries a divide of joy, sorrow, and gratitude—torn between the life she has built and the painful sacrifices her parents made for their future.

title: The Bad Room
overview: A young couple's hopes of buying their dream home are put to the test when they learn the house they're inspecting is haunted. Well, not the whole house. It's just this one room - a very bad room.

title: Overseas
overview: When Clarissa, a young copy editor, realizes that her father is destined to disappear, she proposes they complete an old, unfinished short story in an attempt to preserve his presence and legacy through the written word.

title: Almost Us
overview: RR has always been in love with his best friend, Janine. But she's infatuated with Kenzo, the star of her own fan fiction. When he finds a way for Janine to meet Kenzo, will he risk his own happiness just for her to have her own happiness?
trailerName: ALMOST US | Official Trailer — May 6, 2026 in Cinemas! | Fyang Smith and JM Ibarra #JMFyang

title: Stray Kids: The dominATE Experience
overview: Featuring the global K-Pop sensation Stray Kids and a live performance from their record-breaking world tour, alongside exclusive behind-the-scenes footage and intimate interviews with the band, Stray Kids: The dominATE Experience is an epic concert film that gives fans both a spectacular front-row seat and unique access to their favourite band.

title: Honestly, I'm Fine
overview: Emma is certain she's happy. She has a successful career, a loving boyfriend, wonderful parents, and is talented, funny, and smart. Until she unexpectedly and 'voluntarily' ends up in the psychiatric ward of a hospital. A short circuit? A burnout? She thinks this must be a huge mistake. Because she's a perfectly normal person. Right?

title: A Werewolf Boy
overview: A teenage girl moves to the countryside with her family. She meets a mysterious feral boy who lives on their property. The girl attempts to teach the boy how to behave like a human, but his wild instincts create challenges as their bond grows.
trailerName: A WEREWOLF BOY Official Trailer | Rabin Angels & Angela Muji

title: Terri Joe: Missionary in Miami
overview: In this wild farce, Southern Belle Terri Joe ventures to Miami to outrun wacky criminals and find a new church where she can atone for her sins.

title: The Seoul Guardians
overview: On December 3, 2024, in Seoul, the President of South Korea Yoon Sukyeol declares the martial law. Troops move toward the National Assembly to seize control. Meanwhile, citizens rush to the National Assembly to block the troops, while lawmakers break through police's barricades at the main gate, climb over the walls to attend the session that lifts the martial law.

title: WOLFGANG
overview: In 1778, a young Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart was in exile in Paris: reeling from his mother’s death, he spent his days writing scatalogical music and drowning in libertine excess. In this genre-defying ‘audiovisual opera’, Mozart’s life becomes a portal into that of Wolfgang, an Iranian artist navigating similar extremes as he too is exiled in Paris: the city where everyone says his dreams will come true, and praises him for escaping the censorship of his homeland.

title: Tekenchu: The Rite of the Nahuales
overview: A federal agent is investigating a complex case: a series of chilling infanticides in which the victims’ teeth have been extracted; meanwhile, in a nearby village, two healers find a wounded man in the woods and offer him refuge.

title: Hennie's Theme Park
overview: The maverick entrepreneur and multi-millionaire Hennie van der Most built a business empire from scratch. Now we follow him as he works on what is set to be his final project: creating a large-scale theme park on Rotterdam's Maashaven.

title: Hungry
overview: A mysterious Being in a near future investigates a world devoid of human life and determines to unravel what led to the elimination of almost all lifeforms by using voice recordings they retrieved from the past – interviews made by filmmaker Susanne Brandstätter with prominent international experts and scientists before the elimination events. Each interview discloses new clues indicating what led to the deterioration of the environment, to the biosphere, to crops and finally to the extinction of humankind. Yet though Hungry’s visuals show a possible and grim future, the interviews deliver a positive argument for action: this vicious cycle can be broken before it’s too late.

title: Heart of Light: Eleven Songs for Fiji
overview: After decades abroad, Iona returns to her childhood home on Fiji, sensing that there she might find the answers to many questions she has about civilisation and its discontent.
original_title: Heart of Light: Eleven Songs for Fiji

title: Dead Dogs Don't Bite
overview: Within a dark system where the illegal waste trade poisons both the soil and the human soul, two inseparable friends witness their bond slowly decay along with the trash they dump into nature.

title: Velvet Fire
overview: Silvana, a young trans woman, faces the gradual collapse of her relationship while carrying a wound that shapes her present: the belief that she cannot be loved. Amid confusion, jealousy, and the urge to hold on to what is falling apart, she receives news that forces her to confront her family past. Along the way, Silvana must choose the life she wants to build and whether she can break free from the idea that she is destined for loneliness.

title: EVANGELION 30th Anniversary Special Screening
overview: A short film celebrating the 30th anniversary of Neon Genesis Evangelion starring both the original and Rebuild iterations of Asuka. The short comedically explores alternate timelines, with Rebuild Asuka helping her original counterpart make some wishes come true.

overview: Forte and Voce, illegal immigrants from Largo, show up at the house where Japanese sisters Kameko and Tsukiyo live...

title: The Worm

title: Aakhri Sawal
overview: Vicky, a brilliant but volatile scholar who ignites a national firestorm when he publicly accuses his legendary mentor, Professor Gopal Nadkarni, of institutional bias. What begins as a faculty dispute is quickly hijacked by a sensationalist news anchor and an ambitious political activist, turning a private disagreement into a televised "intellectual trial" watched by millions.
trailerName: Aakhri Sawal Official Trailer | Sanjay Dutt | Namashi | Amit Sadh | Sameera Reddy | 15 May Release

title: What We Saw
overview: A boy has died. On the final day of his brief life, the story traces not only his fading memories but also those of Mujin, the teacher who held him dear.

title: The House on the Moon
overview: Chang Er, a fairy maiden, embarks on a journey to the dark side of the moon to search for her lover Ho Yi, a sun-shooting archer who vanished on his quest to save the dying sun.

title: Cheetahs Up Close with Bertie Gregory
overview: Bertie arrives in the Serengeti as the spectacular wildebeest migration kicks off. He’s here to film the fastest land animal on Earth: the cheetah. As he gets close to a mother caring for her tiny cubs and a young group of males executing phenomenal hunts as a team, he learns about the unexpected challenges the species endures.

title: Malvina
overview: Malvina is an angel sent to earth for being ignorant of it's problems. she falls to earth and after an incounter with a grieving mother seeks adamentley the love she talks about. when receiving this love finally she becomes addicted. she is filled with so much love for everyone she eventually loses herself completely in the desires and wants of everyone around her.

title: Chelot
overview: The story follows Haqqim, a special operations police officer, who is forced to become an informant for a crime syndicate to overcome financial pressure and save his family. This desperate act puts himself and his loved ones in danger.

title: Chuckle Chuckle
overview: Aiming to become comedians, Sahara and his comedy partner Setoguchi work together on their act, "Ultrasweet Sourpork", until unfortunate circumstances lead to their disbandment. Hindered by roadblocks on the path to success, Sahara suddenly encounters an "ideal" version of himself—an ultra-famous comedian. Boasting rich knowledge for success as a comedian, this "ideal" Sahara begins meddling with the real Sahara's life.

title: YURIE
overview: ​​Three years have passed since Joji Uehara lost his father and took over his eatery "Yurie". Despite Joji's impressive culinary skills, his business continues to dwindle. One day, Kim Joo-ri, who came from South Korea to learn Japanese cuisine, arrives at the restaurant by coincidence. Although they clash over their differing values, the two of them gradually become closer as they work together to revive the struggling business. Guided by Kim's charmingly unconventional approach to life, the people around her begin to break free from their rigid minds.

title: Oscar Shaw
overview: After retiring from the police force, a relentless detective haunted by the tragic loss of his closest friend sets out on a perilous quest for vengeance, seeking redemption and fighting to restore justice to the streets he once swore to protect.

title: Documenting Selfie Intern #1
overview: A short documentary film made up of archival footage shot in 2003, which was reworked and edited in 2018-2019. The film shows a haphazardly shot, fragmented property viewing and inventarisation through the eyes of a child, featuring a voice over by that same child.  Because of having unrestricted access to their family’s camcorder as a child, there were a few instances where the artist's child form had shot ‘full length’ documentary films - with this documentary short being one of those instances.  Often these documentations were a call for seeking comfort in a new surrounding, stemming from a deep fear of being forgotten or unheard, and a playful way of documenting one’s thoughts and feelings. In many ways the artist, Mees Joachim, was the original vlogger, before the advent of Youtube.

title: Untitled Abbott Le-Eldred Film
overview: No details have been provided for this film yet.

title: Whispers of a Burning Scent
overview: On the day of a decisive court hearing and an important wedding performance, a quiet wedding musician finds his private life exposed to public scrutiny. Accused of exploiting his marriage, he moves between courtroom, city streets and stage, carrying the weight of judgment, loyalty, and unspoken guilt.

title: Wild
overview: Wild is a survival dramedy set in the breath-taking yet unforgiving Scottish Highlands. Lou, Dev, and Alistair, three old friends clinging to their annual wild camping tradition, begin with banter, nostalgia, and amateur vlogging, but soon unravel into a battle of egos, secrets, and survival when they get lost, food runs short, and friendships fracture. At once funny, poignant, and unsettling, "Wild" explores the line between adventure and recklessness, and how toxic masculinity has become a huge part of the epidemic decline in men’s mental health.

title: Village Idiot
overview: "Village Idiot" is a sharp, heartfelt comedy-drama about a stubborn English grandmother, Barbara, who chains herself to her cottage to resist eviction by High Speed train developers. She then discovers that the company’s liaison sent to remove her is her estranged grandson, Peter. What follows is a clash between generations, class, and values: Barbara’s fierce attachment to home and identity versus Peter’s desperate need to hold onto his corporate job. As their battle becomes public, turning into a small-town spectacle of protest, press, and community chaos, both are forced to confront what “home” really means, and how love, pride, and belonging can both bind and divide a family. Witty, warm, and deeply human, "Village Idiot" captures rural England on the brink of change with equal parts humour and heartbreak.

title: Closing Time
overview: "Closing Time" (w/t) sees Mo, a gifted but undocumented migrant working in his uncle’s kebab shop, keep his culinary ambitions hidden until he meets Laila, a thoughtful lawyer trapped in a stagnant engagement. Their connection grows over late-night conversations and cooking sessions, where Laila encourages Mo to pursue his dreams and he gently challenges her to confront the life she’s settled for.

title: The Castle
overview: "The Castle" follows three siblings left to fend for themselves after their mother suddenly disappears. Connor, Jamie, and Mia try to keep their lives afloat, transforming their suburban house into a makeshift fortress as they wait for her return. Told through the eyes of wildly imaginative middle brother Connor, "The Castle" traces fraying sibling relationships, survival strategies, and the grand stories children tell each other to feel safe. A tender, soulful story about growing up too soon, and rescuing yourself before it’s too late.

title: The Cereal Aisle Effect
overview: On Thanksgiving Eve, a looming hurricane strands four strangers inside a small-town grocery market. As the storm stalls and tensions rise, secrets are unearthed, unexpected bonds form, and redemption emerges in the unlikeliest of aisles. A contained dramedy about connection, empathy, and the fragile humanity we find when forced to stop and face each other.

title: Going Sane: The Rise and Fall of the Center For Feeling Therapy
overview: A 1970s Los Angeles therapy collective rises with utopian promise before devolving into a business-minded cult built on control and abuse.

title: The Baddest Speechwriter of All
overview: Now 93, Martin Luther King Jr.’s lawyer and speechwriter reflects on the personal cost and surprising truths of making history, offering an intimate insider’s view of the Civil Rights Movement.

title: Hasut

title: Bapakmu Kiper

Dino’s chance to leave his village comes through the Tarkam Super Cup, a soccer talent search tournament.  The conflict comes to a head when Dino’s main team is taken over by another party just before the final. This situation forces his father, Warto, to step in and form a new team made up of veteran players, despite all the limitations they face.

overview: An elderly and feared moneylender from a village near Madurai falls seriously ill, prompting her estranged sons and extended family to reunite after years of separation. As tensions rise inside the household, hidden motives, family conflicts, and expectations over her wealth turn her uncertain condition into the center of a chaotic family drama.

overview: Eloíse is an immortal woman who wanders the streets of São Paulo registering everyday life when she finds Lola, a 26 year old photographer who's confused about her future. Together they'll find in each other a way to face the burdens of life.

title: Everest: The Other Side
overview: An intimate portrait of two people bound by love, ambition, and the pursuit of the impossible. Elite ski mountaineers Jim Morrison and Hilaree Nelson fell deeply in love while reaching the pinnacle of their sport. Their drive sharpened into a shared dream: to climb and ski the direct North Face of Mount Everest—the most difficult and dangerous climb on the mountain and the most coveted ski line on Earth—something only a handful have ever achieved, and no one has successfully skied down.
trailerName: Everest: The Other Side | Official Trailer 2 | Experience It In IMAX®

title: Dushi Curaçao
overview: Roos travels alone to Curaçao to distance herself from her life in the Netherlands — and from her fiancé Roel, with whom she no longer feels a connection. While those around her believe they’re the perfect couple, deep down Roos knows it’s over. On the island, she meets Stijn, a defense worker, with whom she shares an intense connection. But Roos hides her background and invents a new story about who she is. As the island pulls her further away from home, the truth threatens to catch up with her.

title: Lads Being Lads
overview: The series follows four close friends who live in the all too depressing yet fictional village of Greyville, Ireland. The kind of place you would expect barely anything to happen. But for Eoin McGintley, Patrick Quinn, James Dames, and Marky Mac, the four of whom are just trying to find some adventure and a few laughs, it becomes the epicentre for their many outright whacky and foolish shenanigans as the lads try to just have fun with what little youth they have left now that adulthood lies closer around the corner for this group of immature teens.

Gautam raja, aSurgeon, and thara, an architect, a fiery social activist, have separated. A buried secret. A shattered trust. Why did thara, a woman of unshakable ideals, walk away? As oli and kavin dive into the mystery, they uncover a hidden sin, a cry forJustice, and a chance for redemption. A family broken by truth... A daughter determined to heal it. In the end, will forgiveness light the way?
