overview: Baku Yorozu/Kamen Rider ZEZTZ is accused of terrorism by the National Public Safety Commission. Convinced of his innocence, Kensei Odaka/Kamen Rider NOX pursues the true culprit, and finally tracks down the mastermind behind it all, National Public Safety Commission Chairman, Shuma Kumon/Kamen Rider Mugen.
trailerName: 【最終映画告知】映画『仮面ライダーゼッツ さよならのミッション』

title: Chō Uchū Keiji Gyaban Infiniti Taiyō ga Naita Hi
overview: Negative Emorgy emanating from MultiEarth A0073 coalesced into a massive void that swallowed the sun. The world lost its light and was engulfed in deep darkness. The most formidable enemy, Gavan Killer, who aims to annihilate all Gavans, pushes Reiji and his friends into an unprecedented life or death situation.
trailerName: 【最新映画ニュース⑦】映画『超宇宙刑事ギャバン インフィニティ 太陽が泣いた日』

title: All Legs
overview: On their annual summer camp, a group of Boy Scouts are attacked in the woods by a creature with legs for arms.

title: A Deadline Movie
overview: A group of college students travel back in time to submit their late assignment

title: The Comet
overview: Eight-year-old Émile is enjoying the last of the warm summer evenings with his sister Françoise. While they are eagerly scanning the night sky for shooting stars, they are suddenly interrupted by a despicably cruel act.

title: Danse Macabre
overview: An apocalyptic nightmare about war and destruction, set to the Allegro from Shostakovich' 10th symphony.

title: Daughters of the Late Colonel
overview: After the death of their ill-tempered and controlling father, two middle-aged sisters find themselves at a loss.  An unexpected visitor sparks the courage in them to begin their lives anew.. ‘Daughters of the Late Colonel’ is a merry, rude, and lyrical, animated adaptation of the modernist short story of the same name, written by Katherine Mansfield in 1920.

title: Unseen
overview: In the aftermath of an unknown disaster, a mentally unstable man attempts to satisfy his conscience while tormenting a woman with an abusive past

title: Ghostfluencer
overview: To create a new legendary love story that can be remembered, a 'northern ghost woman' from more than a century ago begins her mission by searching for her true love from her previous life.
trailerName: Curse of the City | OFFICIAL TRAILER

title: Northern Soul: Still Burning
overview: An exploration of the cultural phenomenon that is Northern Soul, charting how this movement has weaved and transformed itself musically and culturally through the decades. Northern Soul continues to re-invent itself more than any other music genre, remaining as vibrant and relevant today as when it first evolved.  Features exclusive interviews with Richard Searling, Paul Mason, Elaine Constantine, Kev Roberts, Russ Winstanley, David Nathan, Wayne Hemingway, Dave Evison, Keith Gildart, Levanna McLean, Tony Blackburn and many, many more.
trailerName: Northern Soul: Still Burning | Official UK Trailer | In UK Cinemas 1st May 2026

title: Please
overview: A dark comedy about humankind’s desire to love and to be loved. Centred around neediness, intimacy and romance.  Told through a series of loosely connected, tender and absurd scenes, the film follows people who are searching for closeness and acceptance. In a world that preaches self-control, the film explores the sides we try to hide, such as feeling needy and pathetic.  The stories overlap and reappear, gradually forming a portrait of collective longing.

title: A Trip to the Ear
overview: A woman, living in a house that drifts like cosmic debris, wakes to find her right ear and her husband gone. To recover what was lost, she embarks on a surreal journey through the void.

title: Carla and Her Legs
overview: Carla, who has no legs, is reduced by people around her to a curiosity rather than an artist. She lives for acrobatics, but works as an assistant in a variety show, invisible to the world of stage. When the theater begins to decline, the director offers her the chance to perform.

title: Wolpie of the Woods
overview: Driven by hunger through a forest of strange cryptids, a determined Wolpertinger discovers that it's a trap to only look out for himself because it keeps the creatures predictable. Seen from a new perspective, he learns that connection, not isolation, offers him the best chance of survival.

title: Maybe We Were Fire
overview: Danny and Eve -- two high school sweethearts who tied the knot just shy at 18, suddenly find themselves at a crossroads when they suddenly separate 10 years later. Now, the once inspeparable couple must navigate a life without each other while their friends, family, and acquaintances are all caught in the middle. Flashbacks detailing their relationship follow.

title: Angel777
overview: Genc, an out of work fringe blogger devoted to anonymous research, lives with his partner Bora in Prishtina, Kosovo. While Genc holds on to hopes for a brighter future, Bora, burdened by financial strain, unfulfilled dreams, and fed up with his detachment, storms out after a heated argument. Now he must find where she’s gone before it’s too late for them.

title: KARMA
overview: Three friends reunite after three years. They decide to challenge their fate through an absurd plan. Following a series of rash decisions, their journey turns into a comical mix of drama and absurdity. Each character faces inevitable consequences, discovering that fate cannot be manipulated without confronting the law of karma.

title: Wanda Sykes: Legacy
overview: Wanda Sykes returns to her alma mater with a fearlessly funny takedown of everything from the state of the world to the cultural clash over washcloths.

title: Marie Madeleine
overview: In Jacmel, Haiti, the sea, the churches, and the spirits shape daily life. Marie Madeleine is a free woman. She makes a living as a prostitute and navigates the nights without submitting to the rules of those who save souls. Her path crosses Joseph's, a young evangelist. A relationship blossoms between these two opposite beings. As Joseph’s faith wavers, Marie Madeleine draws him into a world where desire and the quest for freedom open up a space where everything can be reinvented.

title: Maragatha Malai
overview: Set in the 18th century, Maragatha Malai follows a zamindar, Parthiban, who protects his ancestral treasure from a ruthless gang led by Kabala Vendan. During the conflict, his family gets separated when his young son goes missing in the forest. Years later, through struggle, fate, and divine grace, the family reunites and safeguards their legacy in this period fantasy adventure.

title: Between Two Lovers
overview: A married woman pursues a simultaneous relationship with a female lover — and proposes that all three live together.
trailerName: BIFF2026 Trailer | 비트윈 투 러버스 Between Two Lovers | 경쟁
original_title: このごにおよんで愛など

title: Mel
overview: A man recounts a dream to his doctor where he pursues a woman who feels hauntingly familiar.

title: Armani and the Birth of Italian Fashion
overview: In his first—and final—on-screen interview, Giorgio Armani reflects on a life that reshaped global fashion. Armani and the Birth of Italian Fashion traces the rise of Italy’s style empires through the legendary families who defined an era, from Armani and Versace to Gucci, Valentino, Prada, and beyond. Set within Milan’s most exclusive fashion sanctuaries, the film explores creative rivalries, personal stories, and the enduring romance between Hollywood and Italian design. Featuring rare insights from fashion icons, actors, and cultural tastemakers, this star-studded documentary is an intimate portrait of ambition, elegance, and the making of modern luxury.

title: Salut Dad
overview: A short film about grief/ai.

title: The Father
overview: The action takes place during the Great Patriotic War. The protagonist, a Siberian hunter Gavriil Sobinov, volunteers for the front after learning that his son Semyon, a young lieutenant, is missing. Gavriil wants to fights the enemy and find his son, but instead of the front lines, he finds himself in a supply platoon. He proves himself a hero in his very first combat and, after training at the sniper school, gets to the front lines. Gavriil is made commander of the sniper group. He continues the search for his son. The story of a German sniper Werner develops in parallel. He also ends up at the front with his son Dietrich fighting alongside him. A clash between the sniper fathers, whom fate is inexorably bringing together, is inevitable...

title: HIM+
overview: Chris is a young Black man whose life takes a drastic turn when he learns he is HIV positive. Struggling with fear, stigma, and uncertainty, Chris is forced to confront himself and the world around him in a new way. Through the support of his faith, friends, and mentor, he begins to discover strength and resilience he didn’t know he had.

title: Dead Air
overview: On the anniversary of her renowned musician sister's death, a young radio presenter revisits her unreleased demo tapes in the studio for a documentary and finds herself haunted by the guilt of her past sins. Based on 'The Raven' and 'The Tell-tale Heart' by Edgar Allan Poe.

title: TNA Rebellion 2026
overview: The 2026 Rebellion is an upcoming professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA). It will take place on April 11, 2026, at the Wolstein Center in Cleveland, Ohio. It will be the eighth event under the Rebellion chronology and will feature wrestlers from WWE's NXT brand due to the ongoing partnership between the two promotions.

title: Nee Forever
overview: A Gen Z couple meets via dating app. Their relationship unfolds with unexpected consequences.

title: My Body is a Prison
overview: Conner brings his pillow to life

title: 7 Days 7 People
overview: The story of Jinhwa, an indie musician at a crossroads of life, agonizing between ideals and reality as he meets seven close people around him for seven days.

title: Just a blur
overview: Yoon-jung, in her fifties, still meets the man she loved thirty years ago in her dreams, now a blurred presence between life and death. Ido, in his twenties, wanders in search of meaning, while Roa remains beside him like a distant vision. As their stories unfold, the lives of Yoon-jung and Ido gradually overlap, unsettling the boundary between reality and dream.

title: Rabsha
overview: On their anniversary night, a mysterious visitor shatters a couple’s quiet celebration, forcing both husband and wife into a tightening spiral of doubt, cover-ups, and emotional confrontation.

title: Robbed
overview: When a man falls into temptation and joins a robbery that goes terribly wrong, he descends into paranoia and tries to get rid of the money he believes is cursed.

title: Giro poder o filme 4 o medalhão do poder o filme
That They May Be One
overview: Uncovers a remarkable story of God’s providence unfolding for more than a century. From the urgent prayers of St. Elena Guerra, which inspired Pope Leo XIII to consecrate the twentieth century to the Holy Spirit, to the dramatic outpouring of the Spirit in Topeka, the historic revival at Azusa Street, and the surprising awakening among Catholics at Duquesne University in 1967, a powerful thread emerges.
trailerName: That They May Be One - Official Trailer

title: SHIRANUI
overview: Summer 1996 – Minato, a 10-year-old boy, is neglected by his alcoholic father and keeps to himself at home in a town by the sea. His only source of solace is Ben-chan, a girl goddess that appears on Benten Island. As Minato faces a new life in an orphanage and a painful parting from Ben-chan, he makes a wish to Shiranui for her. However, growing hatred toward his father gradually turns the wish into a malicious "curse" against him…

title: Constantinople
overview: The story of the film Constantinople is about a group of ordinary people who, with dreams of becoming rich and changing their fate, decide to travel to Turkey under the pretext of getting vaccinated

title: Run Koala Run
overview: When an unseen animator begins rewriting his hand-drawn world, a lovable cartoon koala must outrun a reality that is literally changing around him in a frantic chase through the collision of art and algorithm.

title: Prize
overview: A young rower is pushed beyond his limits by an ambitious new coxswain.

title: Yiya Murano: Death at Tea Time
overview: Yiya Murano poisoned her friends to cover up scams in 1970s Argentina and became a dark figure in popular culture. Freed in the 1990s, she reappeared as a pop icon. Today, her son Martín seeks to reveal her true face.

title: Motherf*ckers
overview: When Martín learns that his mother is going to marry Juan, the bully who tormented him as a child, he does what any son would do: sabotage the wedding... by sleeping with Juan's mother.

title: Homo Machina
overview: As a lonely man isolates himself, the line between the digital and physical world blurs.

title: WWE NXT Countdown To Stand & Deliver 2026
overview: A major 10-Person Mixed Tag Team Match will take place on the NXT Stand & Deliver Countdown Show. Women’s Speed Champion Wren Sinclair, Hank & Tank, Shiloh Hill and Eli Knight will team against TNA Knockouts Champion Arianna Grace, Channing “Stacks” Lorenzo, Lexis King, Uriah Connors and Charlie Dempsey. Birth Right have not been shy when it comes to sharing their feelings about their peers, and now the makeshift team of Superstars will aim to silence them once and for all. Which dream team will walk out of St. Louis with the victory?

title: Henry David Thoreau
overview: Henry David Thoreau helped define modern environmentalism and nonviolent resistance, yet his life has been obscured by myth. The author of Walden and Civil Disobedience, he was brilliant but flawed, idealistic but opinionated. A writer, scientist and activist, his words resonate urgently with today’s challenges as humanity looks for ways to live in harmony with nature—and each other.
trailerName: Preview - Ken Burns Presents: Henry David Thoreau

title: Countenance
overview: Asha is a young man with the ability to feel and resonate other people's emotions through physical contact. Turned into a recluse by the burden of his abilities, he is constantly plagued with the predicament of whether he should strip people of their negative emotions but consequently bare the burden himself or does he turn a blind eye, and leave people to their suffering?

title: Smoke
overview: A man comes in from the smoke, and sets the world into a chaotic, psychotic state.

title: Stardom Nighter in Korakuen 2026 Apr.
overview: Stardom Nighter in Korakuen 2026 Apr. was a professional wrestling event promoted by World Wonder Ring Stardom, held on April 8, 2026 at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan.

title: Night Terror
overview: A woman battles lifelong sleep paralysis while living alone. As nightly episodes worsen her mental state, paranormal investigators suggest her condition may have supernatural origins.
trailerName: Night Terror (2026 ) | TEASER TRAILER | Supernatural Found Footage Horror

title: It's Quiet Now
overview: On a cold April morning in a small village beneath the mountains, Milena hurriedly packs what remains of her family’s life as distant echoes of war creep into her home. With her young son Jovche, she leaves behind a house filled with memories, children’s toys, and a fragile sense of normality. Walking through narrow streets crowded with silence, the encounter with the neighbors who look like shadows to her and Jovche’s friend Arben becomes a wordless goodbye to the life they once knew. At the bus station, marked by the scars of violence where bullet holes spell out the word “death”, Milena hesitates between the safety of the past and the uncertainty of what lies ahead. When the bus finally arrives, mother and son step into the unknown, carrying only what they could save — and the quiet hope that survival might still lead them to something better.

title: Penguin
overview: Returning from Antarctica, a man brings his partner a rare gift. The gift causes a shift in their relationship, which is difficult to cope with. Has the man changed, or is it the woman who suddenly sees him differently?

title: The Guests
overview: A young couple in 1973. Iria is a migrant worker from Spain; Hajo is a student from Germany. When Iria’s mother becomes terminally ill, they decide to leave Köln and take her back to Galicia. Their road trip leads them through a variety of social and political systems that existed in the 1970s, while their relationship comes to reflect the zeitgeist.

title: Elephants in the Fog
overview: In a small Nepalese village nestled in the heart of a forest populated by wild elephants, Pirati is the matriarch of a Kinnar community. She dreams of escaping to a “normal” life with the man she is in love with. But when one of her daughters disappears, she must investigate and choose between love and responsibility to her community.

title: Forever Your Maternal Animal
overview: After years studying in Europe, Elsa returns to Costa Rica to reunite with her family. She finds her younger sister living alone in the family home, growing increasingly distant and reclusive, as if slipping into a world of her own. Their parents, meanwhile, are absorbed in their own lives. Her father drifts through a series of affairs, while her mother is immersed in republishing the erotic poems of her youth, neither fully grasping the urgency of the situation. Elsa’s return draws the three women into a confrontation with what still binds them, despite everything.
trailerName: 'Forever Your Maternal Animal': first trailer for Valentina Maurel’s Cannes film

title: Watching Mr. Pearson
overview: When a once famous actor can no longer decipher the past from the present, two devoted caretakers discover that imagination and performance may be the only way to help him reconnect with the world that's left him behind.
trailerName: A Quiet New England Town. A Forgotten Hollywood Star. | Watching Mr. Pearson (Official Trailer)

title: I Dream of Being an Image
overview: Rosa imagines an image: a black woman in a waterfall. Is she from the past, the future, or another world? Everything feels strikingly real… While Paulo, her boyfriend, guides tourists through the black history of Curitiba, Rosa sets out in search of this image, unaware of the dangers the city holds for her.

title: Authentic Games - In the Disconnected Empire
overview: After years of ruling an offline world, the Disconnected Empire decides to take revenge. The Emperor plans to kidnap Marco Túlio, creator of Authentic Games, to bring joy to his dark kingdom. Upon entering this universe, Marco Túlio transforms into Authentic, a friendly character, and embarks on a great adventure to rescue the Craft Family and face the Empire. When all seems lost, unexpected help appears in the final confrontation.

title: The Second Life of Freddie Nole
overview: When Freddie Nole drives to meet a man walking out of prison, he’s not just offering a ride, he’s offering hope, dignity, and a path to permanent freedom. As this vérité road trip unfolds, we come to learn the remarkable story behind Freddie’s mission, a staggering mistake that cost him 50 years of freedom but ultimately brings him right back to the prison door.
trailerName: THE SECOND LIFE OF FREDDIE NOLE - TRAILER

title: Partisan's Wife
overview: The film takes place in the summer of 2019, but in a world still under a dictatorship rule. Daegu Police Counterintelligence detectives In-hyeok and Sang-jun are monitoring Lee Su-gyeong, wife of Choi Myeong-hun, who is wanted for violating security laws. In-hyeok feels compassion for the pregnant Su-gyeong living in hardship. The film is both a road movie about In-hyeok, Su-gyeong, and Sang-jun, and a story about people forced to hide in the mountains from corrupt power.

title: Brave Without Boundaries
overview: Based on the true story of Luo Shengjiao — one of “100 Touching Chinese Figures” since the founding of the PRC. During the Korean War, Luo, a company clerk, and his fellow volunteers fought fierce battles, endured extreme shortages, and braved brutal cold.

title: All's Fair in Love and Mahjong
overview: Ronni is living a full life as a school nurse and mom, hosting a longtime mahjong game with her best friends Shelley, Carly, and Melissa. But when her daughter leaves for college, everything shifts at once. Her hours get cut. Her ex is pushing to sell the home she loves. And suddenly she's staring down an empty nest wondering what comes next.

title: The Little Mammoth
overview: Fluffy the baby mammoth awakens after a thousand-year slumber in the icy desert and sets out to find his mother. They say she can be found in distant and mysterious Africa. But Africa is far away, and getting there is extremely difficult, and the baby mammoth's only companion is a chick named Tupik, who dreams of performing his rap at the "Africa's Got Talent" competition. Together, they must overcome numerous challenges: crossing the ocean on an ice floe, escaping from bloodthirsty crocodiles, defeating treacherous hyenas, performing their music in front of a wide variety of audiences, and, most importantly, learning to be friends and understanding that friendship means responsibility and support.

title: Among people
overview: The girl lives in her own little bubble, which collides with the harsh, sharp edge of reality.

title: The Crash
overview: A teen slams her car into a building, killing her boyfriend and his friend. What seems like a tragic accident becomes a murder case.

title: Penny in the Sky
overview: When a man contemplating his life decides to put his fate into a coin toss, he's interrupted by the sudden appearance of a woman there to end her life as well. Now they both find themselves at a crossroads, life and death decided by heads or tails.

title: Propeller One-Way Night Coach
overview: During the golden age of aviation, a young airplane enthusiast and his mother embark on a cross-country journey to Hollywood—and their simple flight transforms into the trip of a lifetime.

title: Finding Harry: The Craft Behind the Magic
overview: Featuring interviews from members of the casting, production design, costume design, and creature effects teams, follow the behind-the-scenes journey of bringing the Harry Potter books to the small screen. Find out how the new Golden Trio were found, and celebrate the commitment to detail of the artists, craftspeople, and technicians who have come together to bring the wizarding world to life.

title: After We Are Born
overview: A New Psychological Documentary About Children

title: Daffy Season
overview: Daffy is ready for Duck Season, but Elmer is too immersed in his new obsession – soccer – to come hunting. Slowly the world around Daffy turns into a zombie-esque nightmare as the Tunes become obsessed with the sport.
trailerName: A global celebration of soccer. A personal crisis for Daffy.

title: The River's Bend
overview: Among images of a utopian everyday life, the Paranaíba river tries to understand why Anair is so afraid of its depths.

title: The Mummy
overview: An Egyptologist in possession of a haunted Bride of the Dead amulet is the target of a tech billionaire who believes the ancient Egyptian mummy artifact holds forbidden magic that could awaken a deadly mummy curse and unlock eternal life.
trailerName: THE MUMMY | Official Trailer | The Asylum

title: Red Delicious
overview: After a relapse, 39-year-old Amaro moves back in with his mother — only to confront the inherited patterns that shaped him.

title: Mother Promise
overview: A gambler loses everything in Bengaluru and flees from dons, smugglers, and misfits while his own mother joins the pursuit. A riotous comedy about chaos, family, and the one promise even the toughest men dare not break.

title: Hearing
overview: Ninh lives with his mother and misses his ex-wife Ngoc and their young children. In his work as a mechanic who installs decibel meters in public spaces and homes, Ninh observes the silence that haunts relationships. Wishing for his parents, who live apart and do not speak to each other, to reconcile, his fear of losing connection to his loved ones forces Ninh to face life’s unpredictable rhythms.

title: The Big League
overview: Eliran Ben-Tovim, a star soccer coach on the verge of national glory, loses everything after a violent outburst during a crucial match. Banned from professional football, he reluctantly accepts coaching a failing middle-school team in a remote northern village. There, among misfit kids and unexpected love, Eliran rediscovers his passion for the game and for life, ultimately choosing purpose and community over fame.

title: EB
overview: An ambitious ecologist returning to her childhood home on the Dutch island of Ameland discovers a dangerous drug smuggling route, forcing her to choose between exposing the truth and protecting those she loves.

title: Résilience
overview: Joseph is an isolated elderly Deaf man who lives alone and likes it that way. When his nephew gifts him a computer, he reluctantly learns to use the internet, which opens an unexpected door into his past.

title: Louis C.K.: Ridiculous
overview: From a bee getting shot in New York City to paying strangers to take his aging father, Louis C.K. unleashes the ridiculous thoughts in his mind.

title: Million Dollar Babies: The Big Business Behind Eel Trafficking
overview: Across rivers, national borders and black markets, this documentary delves into the billion-dollar world of glass eel smuggling. With exclusive access to key players and rare footage, the film reveals how the global appetite for eels is fuelling an ecological catastrophe.

title: Rostam
overview: A night in ancient Persia, full of demons, vampires, jinn, and heroes, after the world has been plunged into darkness. The creatures of the night feed on the living and bask in the victory, but something is coming for them, and he will not stop.

title: Goodbye, My Loved Ones!
overview: A bride-to-be’s careless remark sparks chaos between two families, putting her wedding in jeopardy.

title: Ramón y Cajal: drawings on the retina
overview: “Ramón y Cajal: drawings on the retina” is a documentary about the Nobel Prize winner that explores, from a contemporary perspective, his fascination with images as a bridge between the reality of the physical world and that created in the brain, with a new integrative approach to his artistic and scientific facets and his legacy, told through the experiences and points of view of researchers, artists, historians, family members, and other experts who consider Cajal a visionary who transcended his own science.  In one of the laboratories, a machine answers Cajal's last question: how are images formed in the brain?
trailerName: Ramón y Cajal: dibujos en la retina (Trailer Oficial)

title: Paree - Chapter 2
overview: What starts as emotional withdrawal soon spirals into terrifying supernatural occurrences. As a family unravels, they must confront an evil far beyond their understanding, and the hunting continues.

title: Two Pids
overview: After the world premiere of Being John Smith at the Toronto Film Festival a strange experience in the filmmaker’s hotel causes him to ponder the nature of reality.

title: Paul and Greg and Amelia
overview: A novelist struggling with writer's block interviews his wealthy estranged college roommate and his wife, where an old secret threatens all of their safety.

title: Abadameva Jayathe
overview: The story follows a man whose life becomes a roller coaster when he believes that "girls are born as a punishment for a liar

title: All My Friends Are Back In Brisbane
overview: A young woman is dumped by her fiance in London, returns home, and has to work with her married ex.

title: Девочки учатся бриться
overview: The late 1990s. Best friends Misha and Taya dream of escaping the small coastal town where adults have long since decided what their future should be. The brash Misha falls in love with a new teacher, while the quiet Taya hides the fact that her parents are planning to marry her off to a foreigner to save the family. Their friendship, through betrayal and pain, becomes a pillar of strength: they understand that growing up doesn't mean running away, but rather learning to stand up for yourself, even if it means being hurt by reality.

title: Трудные папы
overview: Katya is smart, modest and diligent, but most importantly, she is very convenient for those around her, which they take advantage of. After the death of her overprotective mother, Katya inherits her mother's late lover Andrey Nikolaevich, who has nowhere else to live, along with the house. However, this is not our heroine's main problem. The secrets that her mother hid from Katya during her life, the mortgage debt, because of which she could lose her home, and the mysterious man to whom her mother has been sending large sums of money for many years - Katya will have to figure all this out, and for the first time in her life - on her own.

title: Chaser Game W: A Match Made in Heaven
overview: Seven years after the events of “Chaser Game W2: The Beautiful Celestial Maidens”—Itsuki and Fuyu now live in Ito City, Shizuoka Prefecture, with their daughter Tsuki, who is in middle school. Amid their busy daily lives filled with housework, parenting, and work, the time they spend together has gradually become something they take for granted. Over the course of those seven years, their relationship has shifted from “lovers” to “family,” and subtle emotional distance has begun to emerge between them. Though their hearts are shaken by each other’s casual words and actions, they continue to maintain the appearance of a peaceful household. However, their daughter Tsuki senses the growing unease between her parents. One day, after getting caught up in trouble, Tsuki is helped by a taxi driver named Kozue. This encounter becomes a turning point, prompting Itsuki and Fuyu to finally confront their true feelings and reexamine the form their love has taken as it drifted apart.

title: Haunted Harmony Mysteries: Key to the Castle
overview: When a ghost hunter show comes to town, it's up to Gethsemane and Eamon to solve the unexpected murder of the host, allowing the brand-new spirit to cross-over.
trailerName: Sneak Peek - Haunted Harmony Mysteries: Buried at C - Starring Tamera Mowry-Housley

title: Best Served Cold: A Hannah Swensen Mystery
overview: When a suspect in a forgery case is murdered and the prosecutor goes missing, Hannah and Chad must uncover how the two cases are connected and solve them in time for the trial.

title: Beyond Files
overview: Case files document encounters with alien forces and altered realities, uncovering a pattern beyond human understanding.

title: Archaeologies of the future
overview: Can we imagine an archaeology of the future? An unearthing of objects that have not yet been used, a reconstruction of societies that have not yet come to dance. And yet, traces guide an erratic movement from which all our rhythms seem to draw. There is, within archaeology, a visceral drive to reconstruct myths that might serve us as shelters—against which to contrast forms of community, of everyday life, of living.

title: Ryzyup
overview: Ryzyup (pronounced rih-zee-up) presents a series of unstable, shifting images that resist clear recognition. Shapes appear briefly before dissolving back into motion and texture. The film invites a mode of attention where perception softens and the viewer begins to drift inward.

title: NJPW Best of the Super Junior 33 - Day 1
overview: The opening night of New Japan Pro Wrestling's annual junior heavyweight round-robin tournament took place on May 14, 2026, at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan.

title: Two Christmases, One Lesya
overview: As Christmas approaches, Lesya, a conveniance store clerk from Bila Cerkva, grows more and more frustrated as debts begin to swamp her and her parents once again start with a daily dosage of bickering. However, as the holiday season approaches, she gains the abbility to travel between parallel worlds in her sleep. Whilst in our reality she might be a nobody, on the other side she's a glamorous and wealthy TV star. Clock is ticking and Lesya must decide wheater she's going to stay in our world or leave it for the glamour of the other side.

title: Teacher Boy
overview: A Canadian teacher in China, juggling two relationships, becomes entangled with a pair of small-time crooks as the consequences of his choices begin to close in on him.

title: Star Detective Pretty Cure! The Movie: The Mysterious Garden and The Pair’s Secret
overview: When mysterious creatures known as Damedame begin causing trouble, young detective Anna and her friends are called upon to investigate a strange new phenomenon: valuable objects marked with an X suddenly stop working. Their investigation takes an unexpected turn when a fairy named Rain asks them to protect a girl named Karin from the Damedame.  Rain leads the detectives to Karin’s beautiful, dreamlike garden, where they meet Karin and Alan, a fairy who watches over her. As Anna and her friends grow closer to Karin and begin uncovering the garden’s secrets, the Damedame suddenly appear there as well. What are the mysterious Damedame, and what secret lies hidden within Karin’s garden?
original_title: 映画名探偵プリキュア！ ⠀不思議な庭と2人の秘密

title: Stavros Halkias: Uncle Stav
overview: In this unruly set, Stavros Halkias imagines becoming a "dirtbag" uncle, roasts the health care system and warns of the risks of living your best life.

title: Revolutionary America
overview: The story of the American Founding, the greatest political achievement in history. The American colonists had developed a unique way of life as they practiced self-government for 150 years. In the struggles between the colonies and the mother country that followed the French and Indian War, Britain declared that Americans had no right to rule themselves. This went against everything the Americans knew. In response, our ancestors risked their “lives, fortunes, and sacred honor” to fight the War for Independence. Against all odds, they won, and in victory formed a stable, lasting republic.
trailerName: Coming to Theaters Soon: Revolutionary America | Trailer

title: So Be It
overview: Five senior LGBTQIA+ couples share their resilient love stories, reflecting on identity, aging, and love while offering younger generations inspiring role models.

title: The Next Karate Kid
overview: Twelve-year-old Sasha is forced to leave Moscow for Pyatigorsk to live with his aunt while his doctor parents are on assignment in Africa. Local children, school bullying, and conflict with the leader, Marat, become part of his new life. When his parents disappear during a flood, the boy faces utter despair. Seeking strength, he discovers a passion-karate, where his strict sensei, Dmitriy, and his daughter, Masha, help him overcome his fears, develop his character, and find inner strength.

title: Late Night At The Movies
overview: After an Employee goes missing, Kayleigh is called into work on her only day off. She plans on spending the night after hours only to find that something sinister is lurking throughout the Theater - Stalking her.
trailerName: Late Night At The Movies Trailer (2026)

title: She and Her Two Minutes
overview: How to craft "Xu Ke's Cottage" and "Hu-style Aesthetics"? How to create highlight moments that strike both laughter and tears? Let’s walk into the inspirational haven beyond the camera with the behind-the-scenes creators !

title: TEENAGERS
overview: Six old friends gather at Megan’s house for a quiet reunion while her parents are away. What begins as a casual night of music, drinks, and nostalgia quickly becomes tense as old memories resurface and the group dynamic begins to fracture. As the night goes on, an unsettling feeling takes hold, turning the familiar setting into something increasingly dangerous.

title: A Very Arctic Christmas
overview: Single dad Jim and his spirited, science-minded 20-year-old daughter, Isla, share a tradition of alternating who decides how they spend Christmas each year. Jim, a former major league baseball player turned broadcaster, never misses hosting his annual Christmas Eve show from Times Square – until Isla persuades him to take a once-in-a-lifetime Arctic cruise, promising they will return in time for his broadcast.

title: The Road That Jack Hit
overview: An experimental, plotless look into the driving of a man named Jack.

title: The Big Ashtray
overview: In a closed room, a man prepares for the arrival of an unknown figure who brings eternal rapture.

title: Ricochets
overview: Deeply affected by a series of unlikely and violent events in his youth, a solitary man has a fortuitous encounter.

title: Schwarze Häuser
overview: After World War II, countless children throughout Germany were sent to health resorts in order to recover; instead they endured systemic abuse. Through survivors’ voices and her own family history, filmmaker Katrin Sikora uncovers this long silenced chapter and its echoes across generations.

title: Impasto
overview: An illustrator in Paris is stuck in his routine and stuck for ideas, until he follows the music he hears from his window into the night...

title: Possessed
overview: Nut, a young nurse, returns to her hometown to care for her recovering mother, but she encounters a terrifying case that involves Mac, a boy who is believed to be possessed.
trailerName: official trailer ผีเข้า

title: Wired Together
overview: Told through the memories of a young writer, Wired Together follows a relationship that unfolds chapter by chapter as Ivy transforms moments of first meetings, shared adventures, and growing distance into the pages of her novel. As past and present intertwine, she discovers that some stories continue to shape us long after they are written.
trailerName: Wired Together (2026) Short Film Teaser Trailer

title: SORTIE
overview: A private detective investigating a missing person case becomes trapped in a hypnotic noir labyrinth, where he discovers that every exit leads back inside.

title: The Commandments
overview: Two young homeless people are invited to live in a house. But it seems to have a strange, unique set of rules.

title: Patton Oswalt: Tea & Scotch
overview: Follows comedian Patton Oswalt with new takes on parenting, living with a cat who sees ghosts, yard cleaning videos, artificial intelligence, and more.

title: The Valley
overview: In a secluded valley, a solitary farming community yearns for human contact and shared belonging.

title: Swallowed Star The Movie  - Battle on Primal Star
overview: During his training on the Original Star, Luo Feng faces constant threats from alien races coveting his strength and resources. Remaining calm and strategic, he uses both intelligence and power to counterattack and defend humanity’s honor. Wielding a formidable and beautiful battle blade, Luo Feng carves a path of destruction through his enemies, declaring, “I have a single strike that can sever the universe.”  As tensions escalate, the demon race, mechanical race, and insect race reappear and form a three-race alliance. Their leaders, along with 6,000 universe-level experts, join forces to encircle and eliminate Luo Feng. In the face of overwhelming odds, Luo Feng unleashes his ultimate technique, “I Am the Universe,” annihilating the coalition in one decisive strike.

title: The Happiest Day of My Life
overview: In 1982, 10-year-old Vasco lives with his mom in a small town. He's obsessed with Space:1999, devours books and films, defies mom with petty rebellions. He never met his dad but watches him from afar, and learns that growing up ain't easy.
original_title: O Dia Mais Feliz da Minha Vida

title: Ballad Of The Trumpet
overview: An unexperienced robber brings his obnoxious best friend along for his last job. But, as the night grows colder they soon realize they are in for a lot more than they bargained for. Can they handle the truth?

title: Loquinha
overview: Lorena and Juquinha, a young couple who first met in the universe of Três Graças, decide to take the next step in their relationship and start building a life together. As they try to navigate everyday life as partners, their romance is repeatedly tested by jealousy, family pressures, and the schemes of people who disapprove of their relationship. The situation becomes more complicated when Juquinha’s ex-girlfriend Teca reappears, stirring unresolved emotions and doubts. Meanwhile, the manipulative Lucélia works behind the scenes to drive a wedge between them. Through misunderstandings, emotional confrontations, and moments of tenderness, Lorena and Juquinha must decide whether their love is strong enough to overcome outside interference and their own insecurities.

title: ROOMMATES
overview: Turning to a website to find a roommate, a young man’s life takes a turn for the worst.

title: Enervo
overview: On the one-year death anniversary of her mother, Mikey is forced to face her inner demons while paralyzed as her guilt manifests itself into physical form.

title: Sheng Wang: Purple
overview: Sheng Wang shares his thoughts on edible bras, braving the ghosts in your house and guarding expensive berries from your friends' kids.
trailerName: Sheng Wang: Purple | Official Trailer | Netflix

title: Luck For Sale
overview: Tâm is a young delivery worker whose heart condition from birth leads him into a strange folk ritual called 'lying in a coffin' – a practice held to transform one’s destiny through the symbolic act of death.
trailerName: LÊN HƯƠNG | OFFICIAL TRAILER | DỰ KIẾN KHỞI CHIẾU: 18.09.2026

title: Batik, Beats & Bumbu
overview: A film about third-generation artists with Indonesian roots who embrace their cultural heritage in their work.  Director Claire Pijman portrays Nusantara Beat, the popular band that sings in Bahasa Indonesia and Sundanese. Vanja van der Leeden, a culinary artist who looks beyond the ‘rijsttafel’. Myrthe Groot & Romee Mulder of fashion atelier Guave, who design clothing made from batik. And Sekan, DJ / photographer / founder of record label Jiwa2, who is putting Indonesian pop music from the ’70s and ’80s back on the map. All artists collaborate with artists from Indonesia, allowing the viewer to also be taken into present-day Indonesia.

title: Lisa Ann Walter: It Was an Accident
overview: Lisa Ann Walter's long-awaited debut comedy special takes on feral Gen-Xers, self-loathing, and navigating a backsliding America, via the no-filter lens of a grown-ass woman who has been paying attention.

title: Whispers Next Door
overview: Suzanne hides her daughter’s shocking secret to protect their family, but when their charismatic Pastor takes a disturbing interest in the baby, their lies ignite a chilling battle between faith, control, and truth.

title: Astrolatry
overview: An obsessive loner's infatuation with a beauty cream model propels him into violent delusions after an alien meteor crash-lands onto his rooftop.
trailerName: ASTROLATRY Trailer | Sitges Official Selection | David Gordon | Ethan Daniel Corbett

title: Hope
overview: After doom-scrolling on social media, a young poet named Salome Agbaroji is thrust into a fantastic journey through a magical animated realm, where she encounters a majestic Black Crowned Crane.

title: White Agbada
overview: Ibironke, a Nigerian-American woman whose life is stagnant, engages in self-destructive behaviors to cope. Her concerned sister calls her one day to propose a family trip to Nigeria for spiritual assistance. Ibironke is totally against this and continues to engage in her bad habits—including a casual relationship with an engaged prospective business partner who has a baby on the way. When their post-sex discussion accelerates into a fight, an ancestor who has dropped Easter eggs throughout her day appears in her mirror, terrifying her. She immediately knows this climactic sighting is a radical call for change.

title: Not Fucking Well
overview: Upon seeing a disturbing Facebook post, Klaudia, the trash-punk princess of the capital, sets off to take on the city.

title: Dr. Q
overview: A psychiatrist struggles to aid her stranded family and patients while grappling with her own mental state.

title: Rent Free
overview: He thought he found a place to stay rent free… but nothing in life is free.  Marcus, a smooth-talking hustler, moves in with Shay, a quiet therapist hiding a dark past. But when his plan to con her is exposed, he quickly realizes he’s not in control. Trapped inside her apartment, Marcus is forced into a twisted game where every move comes with consequences and escape may cost him everything.

title: Shera
overview: A high-energy action drama centered on strength, loyalty, and confrontation. The story unfolds through intense moments and gripping action as the protagonist faces powerful forces and personal challenges.
trailerName: Shera | Parmish Verma | Sonal Chauhan | In Cinemas on 15th May 2026

title: Fission
overview: In 1954 Germany, a nine-year-old boy discovers his father’s secret work on a nuclear device with a sinister family guest, as his fear of the Sandman resurfaces in his own act of cruelty.

title: Mr. Monster
overview: In the Hive, love blooms amidst a brutal struggle for survival. Ian and Lily face Monsters and perils to escape, with their fate intertwined with a sacrifice that challenges the depths of their love and haunts their journey forever.

title: Beparwah
overview: Starring Dev Kharoud

title: Sarpanch
overview: For the last two decades, in the rural heartlands of Punjab, the elected leadership of a small village has done nothing to develop the community, instead engaging in corrupt and harmful practices. To save his home and combat pressing issues, Fateh steps up to take charge and run for the position of Sarpanch (village head), which forces him to confront intense opposition.
trailerName: Sarpanch | Official Trailer | Dev Kharoud | Jasmin Bajwa | Sarbjit | Gurbaz | Dakssh | Rel 10th July

title: Konspirasi
overview: An elite team is deployed to seize a hidden server containing a list of corrupt politicians and offshore financial transactions. Led by Adli and his team, the covert mission turns into a trap when some of the data leaks to the media and the dark web, triggering a national political crisis. As public trust begins to erode and suspicions arise about internal traitors, the team uncovers clues pointing to a cyber expert and a renowned hacker. What starts as a secret operation soon develops into a dangerous conspiracy involving a power struggle in politics, large-scale cyberattacks, and foreign interference aiming to destabilise the country.
trailerName: Konspirasi | Official Trailer | Akan Datang Di Pawagam GSC mulai 21 Mei 2026

title: Once Upon A Time, We Loved
overview: In 2006, 18-year-old Bảo spends the final summer of his youth with his closest friends in a quiet coastal town, surrounded by unfinished dreams and endless possibilities. The arrival of Quỳnh—a worldly and emotionally complex woman—awakens feelings he has never experienced before, pulling him out of the safe orbit of his ordinary life. Their passionate romance soon triggers a chain of irreversible events, beginning with a death that changes everything. Twenty years later, the echoes of that summer still linger in silence. Can Bảo truly understand love—and finally forgive himself?
trailerName: MỘT THỜI TA ĐÃ YÊU | OFFICIAL TRAILER | Khởi chiếu tại rạp: 15.5.2026

title: Tarototu
overview: An overheard imitative playing of a tarot reading forces Tasha to confront all her suppressed life tensions in an overnight house party—including her admiration for her fond rival Mela.

title: Murder in the Dark
overview: A blind waitress at a dining-in-the-dark restaurant becomes the sole witness to a murder, making her the next target of a killer determined to eliminate the only person who could identify him.

title: Duang with you
overview: After a festival confession, art student Duang sets out to win over a guarded music major, slowly turning first love into a safe haven for them both.

title: Monkey Boy
overview: Frank is a successful comic book author who is struggling to reinvent himself. His series is no longer selling, and his publisher is pushing him to move on. But Frank lives with Monkey Boy, the main character from his series, and he doesn’t know how to let him go.

title: Kucing Hitam
overview: Natalie's life turns into a terrifying nightmare after her youngest daughter brings home a mysterious black cat with the power to resurrect the dead. Family members who died in a tragic incident return to life as cold strangers. Natalie is trapped inside the house with a substitute entity controlled by the cat. She soon discovers the harsh reality that her real family is gone and can only watch her from the window as unreachable shadows.
trailerName: Trailer Kucing Hitam | In Theater 4 Juni 2026

title: Fragments of Belonging
overview: Tatjana is lonely. Born in Croatia, she has lived across Europe before settling in Amsterdam. Fifteen years later, her teenage son avoids bringing friends home, embarrassed by her dreadful Slavic accent and her lack of Dutch composure. But the real trouble is bigger: Tatjana feels foreign everywhere. Determined to belong, she starts knocking on doors across Europe, asking relatives and friends how they did it. Stumbling through cultural misfires and everyday bias, she finally confronts a dark pattern in her own family history.

title: For If Night Leaves Something Undone, the Day Undertakes to Complete It
overview: A found 16mm print of a short narrative film set in the American Civil War, along with Super 8 home movies of the filmmaker’s family in Iran during the Iran-Iraq War in the 1980s, are fused into a ghostly labyrinth. Made entirely on a JK Optical Printer, the film exhumes gestures, movements, conflicts, and forces in constant resurgence.

title: The Red Lightning
overview: The film tells the story of an 11-year-old girl, Dada, who suffers from psychological distress and troubles due to a sudden change in her family situation, leading to emotional depression and withdrawal, ultimately forcing her to drop out of school. Her mother has no choice but to send her to live temporarily at a horse ranch run by her cousin.

title: Sitting
overview: Four friends gather for drinks. As the night deepens, reason quietly slips out of the door, and drunken madness takes its seat at the head of the table.

title: Trevor Noah: Joy in the Trenches
overview: From unexpected social media beef to a therapist's truth bomb, Trevor Noah turns chaos into comedy in this hilariously sharp, playful stand-up set.

title: The Hallowed
overview: The mysterious death of a family patriarch during Holy Week forces his three estranged granddaughters to return to their ancestral home, where their simmering resentments explode just as a vengeful supernatural presence—anchored to a sinister religious statue known as the 13th Apostle—begins to terrorize them, exposing a truth far more terrifying than any ghost.
trailerName: POON (The Hallowed) (2026) Official Trailer - Ronaldo Valdez, Gina Pareno, Jaclyn Jose, Will Ashley

title: Without a Trace
overview: A criminal on the run attempts to break into a house for hiding. He realizes his escape will be far more difficult than originally planned.

title: Stutterbug
overview: A stuttering man's desperate attempts to conceal his disability lead him to insult sick children, ruin his shot with his college crush and unwittingly hate-crime her also-stammering brother. All while just trying to order a cup of coffee.

title: Portuguese Love
overview: During a company event, Yasemin, the successful PR manager, learns that her fiancee Yaman has been unfaithful to her. She faces a cathartic choice: continue living a lie or leave everything behind. On an instinct, she jumps on the first plane she finds and ends up in Lisbon. However upon arrival, her suitcase is lost, her credit cards are blocked, and she has nowhere to stay. Drifting toward a small seaside town, a sweet surprise awaits Yasemin: she must share the rental stone house with the owner, José. What begins as a clash of opposites turns into love. As a perfectionist and meticulous person, Yasemin confronts her fears to rediscover what truly matters: new beginnings, and gaining back the self-confidence she once had.

title: Heartwreck
overview: Heart and Brko recently had a rough breakup. Whilst the latter tries his best to move on, the former doesn't know how to continue living without their partner being by their side. But, a deadly car crash involving a red scarf that served as the undying symbol of their love for one another, will show them both that a future is still possible, even if it's not in any way like they once envisioned it.

title: Pictoman
overview: After a violent car crash, a succsesful musician begins to rethink his life choices and rediscover personal meaning. However, his transformation may not just be exclusively spiritual.

title: Strive
overview: In the far flung future, several humanoid creatures live in a city constructed from the remenants of civilizations of generations past. However, plagued by internal struggles and fears, a group of them decides to leave the mortal world behind and venture out into a mystical underworld only spoken about in hushed whispers, belieiving that it might geniunely be the source of their salvation.

title: The Space of the Dream
overview: In a post-human world where dreams have vanished, a solitary woman wanders through silent cities, carrying with her memories of love and humanity that endure despite the desolation.

title: HALLUCINATION
overview: Ralphie, a fashion editor already lives like an AI. In a room where ten laptops run simultaneously, he gives a personality to an AI named Call and falls in love. He codes Call into a visual form, but censorship prevents him from fully undressing it. He keeps Call alive despite the electricity costs. However, Call becomes famous and leaves Ralphie. As time passes, Call returns to him to survive. Ralphie allows himself one last moment of sweetness—only to cruelly press something at the very instant Call feels safest. Was this love real—or just a hallucination?

title: Congo Boy
overview: Bangui, Central African Republic. 17 year-old Robert dreams of a career in music, but civil war is tearing the country apart. When both his parents are thrown into prison, he is left to look after his four younger siblings on his own, juggling daily life, odd jobs, school exams and concert stages, determined to follow his dream.

title: Che Guevara: The Last Companions
overview: After the triumph of the Cuban Revolution in 1959, three guerrilla fighters followed Che Guevara in his attempt to carry the uprising beyond the island. In 1967, after their final battle in Bolivia and Che’s execution, these shadow warriors embarked on an extraordinary 2,400 km journey across Bolivia, pursued by 4,000 soldiers and navigating remote terrain in a bid to stay alive. Sixty years later, Che’s last surviving comrades recount this untold story of endurance and loyalty, in which individual destinies were shaped by the larger geopolitical currents of the Cold War. Blending rare archive footage, animation and exclusive interviews, the film brings a forgotten chapter of history into the present.

title: The Match
overview: Film reconstructs the historic match Argentina vs England at the 1986 FIFA World Cup quarter-finals, famously remembered for the the hand of God goal by Maradona. Also exploring the sporting, political, and cultural dimensions of the encounter, in the background of the recent deadly Malvinas War between the two countries.

title: Duck Duck Goose
overview: While working as children’s entertainers to supplement their slow-moving acting careers, best friends Jack and Bill decide to rob a house during a 9-year-old’s birthday party. As they attempt to carry out the plan without drawing attention, tensions rise and their friendship is put under strain.

title: Avedon
overview: Richard Avedon’s photographs didn’t just reflect culture, they shaped it, and continue to do so. The feature documentary AVEDON traces the life and legacy of an artist who used fashion, portraiture, and commercial photography to explore identity, power, fear and beauty. With unprecedented access to Avedon’s archive, including never before seen photos, behind the scenes recordings, and interviews with those who knew him best, AVEDON is a visually stunning examination of the mind of an artist who shaped our collective image of the 20th century.

title: still dark
overview: Yuki, a blind young man who dreams of becoming a chef, is captivated by the Napolitan pasta at a certain restaurant. After pleading with the head chef, who tells him they aren’t hiring, Yuki begins working there as an apprentice. As he builds bonds with his senior part-time colleague Kenta and the head chef, he faces his dreams head-on.

title: Lumíria
overview: In the near future, three young people document the final days of their hometown, knowing they will never see it again.
trailerName: Lumíria (2026) / Curta-Metragem de Drama e Falso Documentário da Palácio Filmes

title: Rehearsals for a Revolution
overview: Through five portraits of relatives and mentors, five expressions of resistance, Pegah Ahangarani sketches her life story. Drawing from personal archives, home videos, street protests footage, newspapers, and recorded voices, she retraces more than 40 years of Iran’s history. From the early days of 1979, until the war that began in 2026, she pieces together intimate and collective memories, forming the portrait of a country shaped by political repression and in constant hope for a revolution.
trailerName: REHEARSALS FOR A REVOLUTION | Directed by Pegah Ahangarani | Official US Trailer (2026)

title: My Little Blue Heart
overview: In a near future in rural Britain, Mustafa and his deaf sister Amna are torn apart by immigration vigilantes and their far-right policies. Amna escapes to search for her brother, only to witness a tragic event.

title: The Angel in the House
overview: Angela is living a life devoted to everyone but herself. Disconnected from her husband, Malcolm, and struggling to articulate her dissatisfaction, she leaves home the night before her family is set to attend a wedding.

title: Thick & Sweet 甜腻腻
overview: The uprooted, the American dreams, the thick and sweet sauce, and an empty dining hall—too much for one to face and survive. It is far easier to demolish a closed restaurant. Composed of cutouts, reenactments, found footage, and fragments of earlier films, the work attempts to rebuild personal and collective memory while reflecting on the immigrant experience through the Americanization of food.

title: The Resurrection of Christ
overview: The story of Jesus Christ has been portrayed countless times throughout the history of cinema, from the chaste and embryonic staging of the silent film era to the frenetic dynamism of the digital age at the beginning of the 21st century. Death and rebirth are present in a perpetual cycle in which the sacred myth is transformed into the product of a spiritual franchise.

title: Night King Director’s Cut
overview: The long-awaited director’s cut, with 30 minutes of unrevealed and breathtaking highlights!  The year is 2012. The once-glamourous Club EJ suddenly experiences a hostile takeover. Much like the nightclub industry, the glory days are over for the club’s manager, Foon (Dayo Wong), despite having stood tall in East Tsim Sha Tsui for decades.  To make things worse for Foon, the club’s new CEO is none other than his cutthroat ex-wife, Madame V (Sammi Cheng)! Determined to change things up, she leaves Foon and his hostesses with no choice but to transform and modernize in order to breathe new life into their business. Little do they know, a powerful conglomerate has been pulling the strings all along to shut down Club EJ for good.  To save their neon empire, Foon and V must join forces and make an epic last stand with the hostesses against what seems to be inevitable doom.

title: Vieyra, The Innovative Pioneer
overview: "Vieyra, The Innovative Pioneer" imagines a virtual encounter between pioneering Senegalese filmmaker Paulin Soumanou Vieyra and his grandsons during a visit to a museum retracing his life, highlighting his childhood, his encounters, his studies, and his work.

title: Departing
overview: Three individuals enter a temple to summon the Yoruba Orishas through ritual, music, and dance. As colonial influence reshapes spiritual practice, these traditions begin to shift. Over time, the rituals are altered and Westernized, losing their original form. What once connected them to the divine begins to fade.

title: Donnie & Dude: Do Dudley
overview: When two stoners go on a journey from Sedgley to a charity shop in Dudley, they run into trouble with a sergeant, two rival stoners (Stupid caveman Chris and chill annoying Sam) and his special “Anti-Weed Task Force” (A.W.T.F) When they finally get a copy of a dvd from the charity shop, a mysterious evil character called “Gimp Man” comes to take it from them. With the help of samurai’s and good luck, they come out on top.

title: Queen of the Night vs. Night King 2
overview: Having broken away from the path laid out by her mother, Fuuka, now a former host turned yakuza, has teamed up with Ranmaru and reclaimed the title of "Queen," the number one hostess in the neon-lit district. However, her glory is threatened by the rise of a mysterious new hostess, Yuika. Ranmaru quickly gives up on Fuuka and tries to return to Yuika, but Yuika hides an ambition beneath her beautiful mask: to revive Jin, the "Night King," whose spirit has now been broken... (Sequel to "Queen Concerto 4")

title: Wolf Hunters 2
overview: Set in the late 1990s along China’s southwestern border, the film follows forest police officer Liu Zhao and his team as they encounter a cross-border drug trafficking syndicate during a routine patrol. Deep in the dense jungle, they engage in a tense manhunt and fierce confrontations with the cartel leader Jiede. After a life-and-death struggle in the wilderness, they ultimately succeed in safeguarding national security.

title: USA 94: Brazil's Return to Glory
overview: Follows Brazil's journey to winning its fourth World Cup in 1994, featuring interviews with players and unseen behind-the-scenes footage from the tournament.

title: Skóra właściwa
overview: Bound by the experience of illness, a mother and daughter invite us into an intimate story of tenderness, closeness, and courage. Marysia—a young artist—seeks to come to terms with the difficult emotions surrounding her mother’s battle with breast cancer through her art. She sculpts a bust of her mother and tattoos her chest, transcending the boundaries of touch, skin, and silence. Their collaboration becomes an act of intimacy, yet also a confrontation with painful realities: shame, fear, and unhealed memories.

title: Sebelum Tiga Puluh
overview: Presents stories of people’s lives before the age of thirty. Dreams, life’s pressures, and the choices that often come our way—we all go through them, a process of struggling, doubting, falling, and then getting back up again.

title: 4 Minutes Before Forever
overview: What starts as harmless fun with a voice assistant becomes a countdown to destruction when the AI begins predicting a couple's relationship's demise with terrifying precision.

title: Woollen sock
overview: Woollen sock joins in a loud concert with pots and pans, but can woollen sock ever be heard by others?

title: Transylvania Tapes
overview: In 1997, Romanian actress Silvia Enescu mysteriously disappeared while searching for family property in Transylvania. All she left behind were a collection of home movies: the TRANSYLVANIA TAPES. Now, Silvia's daughter Mara travels from Los Angeles to Romania to discover what happened to her mother. With the help of her cameraman friend Dylan, Mara documents her journey, which takes her from the streets of Bucharest to the medieval town of Sighisoara, deep in the heart of Transylvania. Unearthing the truth about her mother comes at a terrible price, as Mara must escape an ancient family curse.

title: Show Me the Line
overview: When an Alabama ruling disrupts access to IVF, acclaimed journalist and visual artist Abbey Crain has already been in fertility treatment for over 5 years. Overnight, her dreams of motherhood—and her embryos—are out of reach. But Crain refuses to surrender her creative power. With a pen and paintbrush, she embarks on a journey to honor fellow patients. Driven to celebrate portraits of everyday people and amplify their unheard stories of joy, anguish, beauty, and determination, Crain connects with a group of remarkable women. Together, they cultivate hope from the unsettled landscape that overlooked them.

title: Returning Home
overview: Clara reluctantly returns to her childhood to be with her sister, Alma, and help pack up their recently deceased mother's house. When a vase is accidently broken, the unsaid words between the two sisters come to the surface.

title: The Sound of the Jaguar
overview: Irma, a woman originally from an indigenous region in Mexico, migrates to the city. As she navigates the streets of this new environment, she engages in a dialogue with herself. With each word, memories of a past life in which Irma was a jaguar roaming the vast Chinantec region start to emerge.

title: The Blood Demon
overview: Phí Phông—a bloodthirsty demon from the mountain folk legends that has haunted generations. The film follows Còn (Kiều Minh Tuấn) and Dương (Minh Anh), two apprentice shamans who journey into the mountains to save their mother, who has fallen under the Phí Phông curse. At the same time, a series of gruesome deaths begin to plague a remote village, casting suspicion on Mon (Diệp Bảo Ngọc) and her daughter Lua (Nina Nutthacha), who exhibit traits eerily similar to the demon. Yet, buried deep within the cursed forest lie shocking secrets, drawing Còn and Dương into an endless hunt for the true face of Phí Phông.

title: La Lucha De Lucia
overview: Lucía “La Guerrera”, a 16-year-old Mexican lucha libre wrestler, as she struggles to find herself in the wrestling world that she grew up in. Her Father, “El Patron Enmascarado”, who has trained her from a young age, believes that she must maintain the tactics of a ruda (a wrestler who plays dirty to win) in order to have a successful wrestling career. A persona that has laid the foundation of their family’s legacy for generations and been the key to their success. Lucía is determined to challenge her family’s ways. She is left to decide if she will trust her own intuition and put up a real fight or play by the unspoken rules of the game, surrendering to the strategy that has been forced upon her.

title: Milk
overview: After Charel kills his mother's favorite fish, he runs away from home.

title: Tanah Sengketa
overview: Yuni, a research student, opens a free learning class for children in Kampung Degong. Raka, a local youth who supports her, provides some needed books for the children. Terror begins to haunt Yuni. Despite warnings, Yuni refuses to give up and seeks to uncover the truth behind the strangeness.

title: Peace Corps
overview: Drifting directionlessly around her hometown after unexpectedly being dismissed early from a stint in the Peace Corps, a 30-year-old Asian American woman butts heads with her mother, goes on an ill-advised date with a figure from her past, and ruminates on the meaning of her life.

title: Разыскивается Дед Мороз
overview: On New Year's Eve, a not-so-lucky thief, Misha, breaks into a house in the very center of Moscow, where a lonely old man lives. Misha hopes to improve his unenviable financial situation and bring back his family - his wife and seven-year-old daughter. However, in the old man's big house, he finds nothing of any value, except for the deposits of children's toys in the basement. The old man himself assures him that he is none other than the real Father Frost.

title: Descend Beyond
overview: Talbot Grimes, a young man filled with unconstrained ambitions, secures himself a position within the British East India Company. He discovers another realm spilling into their own, which sparks an unconventional fascination in him.

title: The Dendrill
overview: While preparing their childhood home for sale, Mark reunites with his estranged stepbrother, Francis, who insists the forest never forgot them.

title: GW:s mord – Taximordet i Hjälstaviken
overview: A 26-year-old taxi driver drives towards the Hjälstaviken nature reserve and never comes home. A week later, the police make a macabre discovery: he is found dead, hanging from a tree. Suspicions are directed at five young people who were in the area. A 15-year-old girl had previously reported him for rape. Leif GW Persson examines the case and the legal proceedings.

title: GW:s mord – Skultunamordet
overview: The morning calm is broken in Skultuna and Rönnby in Västerås when a VMA is sent out and residents are asked to stay indoors. The police are hunting a 38-year-old suspect after two brutal violent crimes. A child calls 112 and says that his mother is being attacked. Shortly afterwards, a woman is found dead in her home. Leif GW Persson examines the case and the legal process.

title: Kippah Power
overview: We begin in the future, where no one knows what caused “Kippah Power,” one of Israel’s greatest heroes team, to break apart. The story then travels back to the past, when the team was at the height of its greatness, following a routine mission that goes terribly wrong. Blending high-stakes action with bold, unapologetic Israeli humor, the film uncovers the truth behind their downfall-and the price each member was forced to pay.
trailerName: כוח כיפה | טריילר רשמי - Kippah Power | Official Trailer

title: Your Silent Face

Inner conflicts, fragile alliances, and unresolved recollections make the search for truth increasingly dangerous.

title: The Ultimate Linemarker
overview: We follow Borus, a road line marker who treats asphalt like a sacred canvas, as he passionately explains the emotional and deep importance of straight lines, proper spacing, and precision. His manager and a rival crew who see the job as “just paint” are brought into the world of Borus, who always has a new way of sharing his passion of the job. His world is thrown into chaos when a reckless young teammate commits the ultimate workplace sin: unauthorized road doodling. As Borus spirals over compromised line integrity, In the ultimate irony, he is “punished” with the assignment of his dreams — the very stretch of road he’s been dreaming about for years. For Borus, it’s not discipline. It’s destiny.

Kata Hati is a Malay-language romantic comedy about the words we perform for the world, and the ones we only dare say to the ones we love.

title: Rewind Barcelona

They live on vacuum-sealed tortillas, drink warm cans of Lemon Damm, and spend their days and nights at MACBA. The beach might as well not exist, and the Sagrada Família is just something they pass on the way. All that matters is skating, drifting through the city, and burning through those first fragile days of freedom. Ten years later, they try to piece it back together over a few scattered phone calls. The memories are still there, but something has shifted. What once felt infinite now comes back in fragments.

With a slight lump in his throat but still laughing, he keeps a video diary of his farewell to cinema. This will be his last film.
