overview: In her room, Katie talks to her therapist, Dr. Klein about her feud with Vicky Treehorn at school when her intentions turn sour and her victim mentality after calling her boyfriend might not be what it seems.

title: To Become Ghosts
overview: A group of communist militants debate becoming a clandestine organization at the beginning of a new wave of state repression.

title: The Hot Seat
overview: World Cup winners from France 1998 and France 2018, plus a crew of comedians, face off in a no-holds-barred comedy roast hosted by Paul de Saint Sernin.

title: Diables rouges : génération Adorée - Le carnet de Rodrigo
Central Market
overview: In the unhealthy environment of a downtown market, people are disappearing without a trace. An air of mystery surrounds the Central Market, until the real reason behind the events is revealed.

title: THE HUM
overview: During his class, Leo, who struggles with ADHD, fights to write a single word while the sensory overload of the room pushes him to his breaking point.

title: Pipes
overview: Although Hassan has retired from his job at the water authority, his neighbors are used to him always helping them out. This time, the situation is serious: The entire town is without water, and tensions are rising among the population with every passing day. Hassan would like to help them all, but he also needs time to mourn a friend who recently died under unclear circumstances. Lebanese director Karim Kassem skillfully works with various cinematic genres to create an elegant double portrait of an aging man and the town of which he has been a part all his life. He does so with a sense of nostalgia, subtle humor, and an almost meditative melancholy, mixed with a touch of detective work.

title: Stitches
overview: Three isolated men submit to rituals of healing—an AI cleanse, a live stream of penance, and an experimental drug trial—each descending into madness as their pain becomes performance in a world obsessed with watching.

title: Somnus 4076
overview: In a post-war future, humanity sought refuge in the TechLink — a neural device used for healing scarred minds. But one of the system’s creators, Markus, has twisted it into a tool of control, in pursuit of creating a perfect society, trapping the population in a false utopia. Samantha, a former ally and co-creator of TechLink, returns to the lifeless city to confront Markus and free the minds held captive. Battling through illusions and memories, she faces her former friend in a brutal, reality-warping showdown. To save humanity, Samantha must destroy the system from within — risking her life to restore what TechLink stole: free will.

title: Luminary
overview: In the year of 1879, whilst working on the lightbulb, Edison struggles between his work life balance, his inventions and his wife. His predicament worsens as his wife falls ill and investors threaten to pull funding. Edison must choose between returning home to support his wife or to further ignore her and complete his work.

title: Washing Machine Time Machine
overview: LAUNDRY DAY JUST GOT A WHOLE LOT CRAZIER.

title: What Does This Mean?
overview: Sal and Mike explore an art museum and figure out what "art" means to them.

title: CASE 0 : TOMORROW
overview: In an abandoned, timeless government archive, an unprecedented case is opened: the trial of "The Future" on charges of existential fraud against humanity through a perpetual, unfulfilled promise—only for investigators to discover that the accused might have never existed at all.

title: Tainted Blood
overview: A vampire is overwhelmed by her greed of blood.

title: Kick Rocks
overview: A  self-loathing man sits on a park bench and talks to a squirrel.

title: Grindr Presents: Madonna LIVE in New York
overview: Madonna is performing LIVE! Starting off Pride Month by welcoming the community back to the dance floor, and debuting new tracks from Confessions II.  Motha is delivering, and we’re only four days into Pride. Grab your friends, turn up the volume, and join us for a night of music, celebration, and pure queer joy. The dance floor is officially open!

title: I Love Paris
overview: After being transformed into a vampire, a Parisian singer pursues stardom at the cost of her soul.

title: Rubberhead: The Life & Monsters of Steve Johnson
overview: Known for his intense work ethic, perfectionism, and obsession with breaking new ground, Steve Johnson has created iconic creatures and effects for some of the most beloved genre films in cinema history, working with everyone from John Carpenter, David Cronenberg, and Sam Raimi to James Cameron, Steven Spielberg, and Guillermo del Toro. His drive and ambition also led to heartbreaking acts of self-sabotage, divorce, and a serious drug addiction.

title: Longtake Onetake Mistake
overview: Actor Lee Yong fails even his thousandth audition. Just as he is about to give up on everything, a flyer catches his eye: "7 Days Until Submission Deadline for the Bucheon International Fantastic Film Festival." He seeks out Chang-kyung, a former film director living in seclusion after a devastating failure, and proposes a reckless plan — to make a film in just seven days. With no budget, no crew, and no future, wounded souls begin gathering one by one. Soon, the bizarre filming of a period fantasy begins: a woodcutter turned into a bloodthirsty monster and a fairy transformed into a ghost bride.

title: L’amour aurait suffi même à Nietzsche
overview: “Love is not made to console, no doubt — it is made to save. But we know all too well that one is only ever saved once. And only for as long as that once endures.” Inspired by The Eternal Return, Michel Surya’s novel, the film is a portrait of the book itself.

title: Minnesota Mao
overview: A cutting look at the strange connections between Governor Tim Walz—aka "Minnesota Mao"—and Chairman Mao Zedong, the former dictator of the Chinese Communist Party, based on interviews, archival footage, and news and social media.

title: Mirage
overview: Mirages have been reported along the Spanish coast. A young French woman travels to San Sebastián to observe these visual aberrations. There, she meets a mysterious Portuguese woman who tells her a story from her youth: of obsession, and a gaze that can turn the world inside out.

title: Mother, You Have Not Died Yet. But You Will. And When You Do, You Will Finally Be Alive Again.
overview: In the Indian township of Durban, where post-apartheid violence still simmers, Lishana cares for her dying mother. Through her photographic practice, she reflects on life and death, past and present, navigating between the tangible and the mystical.

title: The Crowd
overview: A filmmaker accidentally comes across a ruined village where silent souls refuse to revive the past. The remnants of a film shot years earlier constitute the only clue to understanding what once happened there.

title: Permanent Trespass
overview: Two “professional mourners” meet within the ominous setting of an Art Nouveau villa. Who — or what — is being mourned? From Beirut to Sarajevo, what first appeared to be an intimate encounter gradually transforms into a singular confrontation with History.

title: Foam of Worlds
overview: A mother and her young daughter live on the island of Sant’Erasmo, Venice. As the waters continue to rise, each responds in her own way to the ecological emergency, to the risks of destruction and disappearance that compel us to care for all living things.

title: The Clearing
overview: Sumatra, early twentieth century. The exploitation of rubber by Dutch colonisers leads to the sexual enslavement of female workers. Archival and contemporary images intertwine in a documentary fabulation that plunges into the depth of a long-erased history.

title: Letters from an Inner Exile
overview: A photographer’s journey between past and present, as she develops a project on the concentration camps of the Spanish dictatorship, gradually reveals a cartography of the memory of the defeated.

title: Sugar
overview: Oscar, a young sex worker, spends the night with an older client who introduces him to GHB and promises care. As the drug takes hold, reality fractures and past and present collide — until the night turns dangerous.

title: Economy-Man: Black Friday
overview: Distraught with emotion after letting Mr. Knoflick destroy half the universe, Economy-Man sits at a crossroads, knowing he must stop Knoflick before the entire economy is destroyed but searching for a team who can help him beat this seemingly unassailable foe. Meanwhile, three other lost heroes lives intersect with his: Loggo, searching for his best friend, who thinks he is dead; Fry-Man, grieving after giving up the mask after the tragic death of his girlfriend, Gwel; and Bob the Soap, a once proud warrior who finds himself lonelier than ever. The four heroes, shrouded with loneliness, will band together to stop Knoflick from destroying the economy, but can they defeat him and his army before it's too late? The entire Economy-Man saga has led to this.
trailerName: Economy Man: Black Friday | Official Teaser 2

title: Chants fantômes
overview: This film-poem is composed of visual and sonic fragments in which landscapes, everyday gestures and distorted songs weave an inventory of loss. Between silence and vertigo, the past resurfaces. Pain, resistance and beauty persist within the absences carved out by colonialism.

title: JON BELLION - LIVE FROM FOREST HILLS STADIUM
overview: The full recording of 2 sold-out nights at Forest Hills Stadium in August 2025.

title: Chicken Soup
overview: Lili, a young French woman, lives in New York between odd jobs and coffees with friends while overstaying her visa. A chance encounter with two police officers tips her — and the film itself — into another dimension.

title: Christmas Pop-Up
overview: Desperate for a fresh start, an unlucky-in-love set decorator takes a job designing a Christmas Eve pop-up event for a jaded celebrity chef, hoping to escape her current hell - living with her ex and his new girlfriend - before they get engaged on New Year’s Eve.

title: Diary of the Future
overview: To be fifteen, armed with a MiniDV camera, filming one’s adolescence in the 2000s in order to rediscover it later: friends, desires, holidays… Twenty years on, the tapes are unearthed and the diary rewritten in the future perfect, with all the fervour and tenderness of that time.

title: Only the Serpent Knows
overview: Two brothers reunite in their childhood home to speak about the incest one of them suffered there as a child. Over the course of a single day, their conversation intertwines the most difficult questions with the boldest theories, delving deep into our religious and mythological history.

title: Starlight & You
overview: Lily and Peter is a modern romantic drama about timing, connection, and love tested by real life. When a quiet online connection pulls two people together, distance, delay, and unexpected loss challenge what they're building. As they choose to show up for one another, their bond deepens into a love shaped by family values, resilience, and emotional truth. Warm, intimate, and universally relatable, Lily and Peter is a character-driven love story made for audiences who believe the strongest romances are earned.

title: If Everyone Goes Away
overview: For forty years, the filmmaker’s mother devoted herself to others, first as a primary school teacher and later as the disability coordinator within her school. Her decision to leave the public sector becomes the occasion for a generous portrait that reveals a system in crisis.

title: Death Drive
overview: A delivery driver who killed someone, ten moments of that day.

title: Problems of the Entire World
overview: Serene, but eclectic. Intimate, but global. Gen Z couple of leftist climate activists finds out they’re expecting. Anxious in an overloaded world it’s them who must face the question. Where can we find anchors in a world full of uncertainty?

title: A Requiem in Bishkek
overview: An Indian refugee living in the capital of Kyrgyzstan, witness to the political instability surrounding him, drifts into a melancholic and elegiac meditation on his condition as a foreigner. Film stock is his last refuge.

title: Pool Party
overview: On a hot day, when digital activity suddenly stopped, Adek whined to her family, asking to play in the inflatable pool. But sadly, there was no running water in their house.

title: Nobody Else
overview: Amid a worsening economic crisis, Andre, a scavenger struggling to survive, finds himself pushed to his breaking point. Desperate for money, he makes a decision he never imagined he would have to make. But when circumstances force him down the same path once again, an unexpected conversation with a transgender sex worker uncovers old wounds and a painful truth that changes the way he sees his life forever.

title: How to not have sex
overview: Three high school friends reunite after 10 years and confront a case of sexual misconduct that none of them were ready for. As layers of denial resurface, the film traces the thin lines that lie between sex, persuasion, and consent.
trailerName: Teaser out | How to not have sex | Sudharshan Narayanan | Anshulika Dubey | Richard Linklater | Tape

title: Nike - Rip the Script
overview: Everything in a Hollywood studio was running strictly according to a meticulously crafted commercial script—until the unstoppable instincts of world-class footballers took over. Completely tearing up the director's playbook and shattering the rules of the set, elite athletes and internet culture icons stage a chaotic takeover. A high-octane, unpredictable visual feast celebrating the raw, rebellious, and untamable spirit of the beautiful game.

title: Himalayan Gold
overview: A young village girl's journey to collect the rare Himalayan herb Yarsagumba turns into a desperate fight for survival when she encounters a ruthless gang of robbers in the mountains.

title: Mereka Benar-Benar Ada
overview: A proof that supernatural beings exist. We do not need to see them or hear their voices. Through our voices, we can know that they are real and that they truly exist

title: Chirag Panjwani: Dr. Panjwani
overview: A stand up comedy special about Chirag's father and his father's bravery.

title: Adaraneeya Tharuwak
overview: A singer’s journey to fame becomes a journey of love, loss, and a final promise to the woman he could never forget.
trailerName: Adaraneeya Tharuwak - ආදරණීය තරුවක් | Official Trailer | 2026 Sinhala Movie

title: What The Living Do
overview: After her girlfriend Sylvia dies of a heart attack, Ysabel — a Filipina folk healer — casts a spell to bring her back to life. But when Sylvia's body continues to rot despite resurrection, Ysabel's desperation is put to the test.

title: The Indies
overview: In 17th-century Europe, Alejandro, a young Spanish nobleman, is tasked with delivering the portrait of the Infanta of Spain to Louis XIV, still a child. It is intended to seal the alliance between the two crowns. Fascinated by the promises of the New World, lands to be conquered and new trade routes to be opened, Alejandro is escorted by two French soldiers. As the portrait advances, the trio descend deeper into a Europe ravaged by wars and uprisings. The journey to the French court is long and arduous, and the path back to civilization and the modern world emerging remains uncertain.

title: My Father's Table
overview: A wife diagnosed with a condition that stops her from cooking! Cooking for the first time in his life is hard enough... But penalty points if it tastes bad, and 10 points mean DIVORCE?!

title: FIELDS OF THE SILENCE
overview: Joel Tuinstra's next film for the 2027 HOCO film fest

title: Night Shift
overview: A museum guard's night takes a deadly turn when criminals force her to aid a diamond heist in exchange for her husband's life.

title: Ramón Vázquez
overview: His name is Ramón Vázquez. He comes from La Pampa and wants to reach Soto, near Córdoba, to reunite with his father. He has not seen him in thirty years. The difficult journey gives rise to a series of encounters on the threshold. And the light blinds.

title: Her Husband's Double Life
overview: Carrie's world is shattered when her husband is found critically injured in a car crash with another woman by his side--a woman who also claims to be his wife. Carrie discovers that someone will stop at nothing to erase her from the picture.

title: Khrōma
overview: In a world full of whimsical nature and perfection, a man embarks on an obsessive, artistic journey to recreate the world that was introduced to him.

title: Passion
overview: John's life was always centered around his girlfriend, he did everything for her. When she dumped him, he was lost, he had a hole in his heart to fill. Will he find a passion to drive forward his life? Or will he let the emptiness consume him?

title: Last stop for the circular ticket
overview: Around Lake Como, a voyage interrupted by a series of brief, successive stops, as fleeting as musical phrases. Someone enters and leaves a telephone booth. Water and the lines that contain it.

title: Each Other
overview: Enemies at school. friends at home. Two brothers navigate childhood with and without each other.

title: In Search of the Blind Eagle
overview: Three young present-day activists kidnap and interrogate Juan José Pérez García, a former psychiatrist who used “science” to justify political torture during the dictatorship.

title: Homo Sive Natura
overview: In the remote forests of eastern Cambodia lives a community of indigenous inhabitants. An unnamed forty-year-old businessman arrives with seemingly selfless intentions: he claims he is merely a tourist seeking to discover the life of his “brothers”. In actuality, however, he is gathering information for the possible expropriation of their land. Italian globetrotter Giovanni C. Lorusso lives up to his reputation as a filmmaker balancing on the line between fiction and documentary. Through unique locations, mesmerizing camera work, and immersive sound design, he captures the slow inner transformation of his protagonist along with the rich cultural and spiritual life of a community facing a modern form of colonialism.

title: Six Days To Pay
overview: After Eddie Wayne gets into debt from a notorious gang, he has six days to pay his debt or he gets killed.
trailerName: Six Days To Pay - The Final Trailer (Official)

title: 33 Steps
overview: Thirteen years after Milan Daniel suffered a serious head injury in a racially motivated attack, his assailant is set to be released. What feelings does this moment awaken in a traumatized man who, though he survived, will forever suffer the consequences of that fateful day? Straddling the line between fiction and documentary, the feature debut by Slovak directors Šimon and Anna Domček is an exceptionally cohesive mosaic of fragmentary pieces of everyday life, memories, dreams, and subjective perceptions. Besides exploring the experience of someone seeking to escape the shadows of the past – shadows that weigh heavily on future generations as well – the film also takes an unusual approach to the subject of racial intolerance.
trailerName: 33 kroků (2026) CZ HD teaser trailer /KVIFF - soutěž Proxima/

title: Bára - Diary of a Rockstar
overview: Bára Basiková is an icon of Czech rock and other music genres. To what extent can her public, media-distorted image differ from the person she really is? The answer comes in the form of the latest long-term documentary study from Helena Třeštíková, whose empathy, coupled with admirable self-reflection and openness on the part of the protagonist, gives rise to a fascinating film portrait: over the course of fifty years we follow a woman who demonstrates remarkable strength as she faces the challenges of both her professional and private lives.​
trailerName: Bára Basiková (2026) oficiální trailer /KVIFF - Zvláštní uvedení/

title: The Friend's House is Here
overview: Pari and Hanna, roommates and friends, live in modern-day Tehran. Pari is a curator and director of an independent theatre group; Hanna is a dancer, who wants to get out of Iran as soon as possible. The situation of both women becomes more complicated, but their friendship is strong in the face of political oppression. The Friend’s House is Here is a rewarding cinematic experience, conveying a sense of freedom and hope, even though it originated under the exact opposite conditions. Just a few days after the June War in Iran, the crew, headed by directing duo Hossein Keshavarz and Maryam Ataei, took to the streets of Tehran to make a film about a generation that no longer wants to live according to imposed rules and is striving to achieve one of the fundamental human rights, the right to freedom of artistic expression.

title: A Report for Minerva 2
overview: The lives of a mismatched group of guests and employees become entangled in a run-down hotel. Some have come in search of peace and a brief escape from their daily routine, while others long for change – or even love. A lonely clarinetist crosses paths with a young man looking for a romantic adventure, an unhappily married couple, an idiosyncratic hotel staff member, and also an alien sent from the planet Minerva 2 in order to report on the state of Earth. A mosaic of fourteen interwoven stories emerges through fleeting situations, awkward moments, interior monologues, and quiet observations. This experimental film by Miroslav Krobot and Lubomír Smékal is loosely based on the stage production of the same name by the S 23 Theatre Company, whose non-professional actors put together stage performances based on the dialogical acting method.
trailerName: Zpráva pro Minervu 2 (2026) HD trailer /KVIFF Zvláštní uvedení/

title: This Is How the World Ends
overview: When a war breaks out between humanity and the AI Machine States, the world is thrown into a state of confusion.

title: Drifters
overview: In an attempt to escape their problems, three struggling college students take an impromptu trip to Japan. As they aimlessly roam this foreign country, the struggles of everyday life, and their lives back home, begin to resurface.

title: Abnormal business
overview: When a group of five teenagers, working for a paranormal investigating company, enter the haunted home of a random Dutch man, they realize the horrors of what they are about to face.

title: Worst Contact
overview: Movie night is interrupted by a pesky alien invasion.

title: Wonderland
overview: Wonderland follows Luke, a York tour guide struggling with creative burnout. Before he can leave the city for good, he has to give one last tour, only to discover it’s been booked by his estranged brother Ellis. As the tour continues, the lies that sit between them are exposed.

title: Thou Shall Not Commit Adultery
overview: When Cassie, a Christian feminist icon and bestselling author, is blackmailed with videos of her affair, she must fight to protect her brand and marriage. But as her trusted assistant's betrayal escalates, Cassie faces a terrifying choice.
trailerName: Official Trailer: Thou Shall Not Commit Adultery

title: Epitaph
overview: Shortly after breaking up, Marcelo and Camila end up locked inside their apartment. The time they spend together after the breakup awakens a series of memories in each of them.

title: Love Whisper
overview: set against dreamy summer nights, camcorder footage, and coastlines, “Love Whisper” captures the quiet ache of longing, youth, and the moment every love song finally starts to make sense.

title: Deep Within
overview: A man struggling with inner conflicts embarks on a journey where the boundaries between reality and the subconscious gradually begin to blur.

title: The Galoshes of Fortune
overview: A pair of magical pink shoes gives a homeless woman the fame and luxury she always wanted. However, she quickly discovers that her dream life is just an illusion.

title: Hanuman Ansh
overview: A grieving boy seeks God to meet his departed mother, and in finding the divine, learns to serve humanity with miracles of love, food and silent blessings, becoming Hanuman Ansh, Neem Karoli Baba.

title: Pushers
overview: William and Birk are two first-year high school students, eager to experience everything youth has to offer. In an attempt to get noticed, Birk proposes a bold strategy: selling cocaine. With dreams of status, parties, and romance, their friendship is put to the test.

title: The Rapture
overview: With the world set to end in two days, cousins Roo and Joo are unexpectedly reunited when Roo slips into a church to confess their sins, hoping to make peace before it's too late. Reminiscing on a lesson their koro taught them both growing up,“when the rapture happens you gotta go home”, for Roo, that means it's time to go home. But for Joo, home is a little bit more complicated.

title: ARROGANT
overview: The French submarine, the Arrogant, is trapped at the bottom of the ocean. On board, the crew believes they are living their last days. But a nuclear engineer, Eric, accompanied by his rat, also known as the General, seizes power to try to save the crew, at the risk of establishing a dictatorship.

title: A Place Like Home
overview: A son reconstructs his childhood home in a film studio to understand why his family fell apart. Can one change their fate by reliving the past?

title: Rak
overview: Having gone blind, Rak returns to live with Elsa, his ex-wife. Faced with a reality he cannot see, he slowly withdraws into the memory of what is no more. The poetic emancipation of a bird in its cage.

title: ฝุ่นและการเติบโต
cast: รัฐวุฒิ ยังเจริญ

title: No Survivors
overview: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, it follows a young man seeking revenge against the "White Tiger" bandits who destroyed his family.

title: Djinn Wedding
overview: When four estranged siblings reunite in their remote Anatolian village for their sister’s wedding, long-buried memories begin to resurface. As the celebrations unfold, two of them are drawn back into the unbreakable bond they once shared. Family secrets slowly come to light, leading them on a journey through grief and the invisible ties between generations.

title: Made a reality...
overview: While filming for a renovation of some former nuns' quarters... "Subject 1" found a notebook in which anything drawn would become reality...

title: Dos historias: En un mismo lugar
The First Tone
overview: The tale of three villages and the power of sound.

title: Missing Pieces
overview: This story follows our protagonist Henry's battle with grief and depression. Trying to use faith and forgiveness to move on with his life.

title: Cecilia, Manuela y el Mar
overview: Manuela,  a 75 year old woman, has been married to Cecilia her entire life. For some time now, Cecilia has been battling Alzheimer's and is becoming increasingly disoriented. Hoping that the sea will refresh her memory, they take a short trip to the beach.

title: The Heist
overview: Three teenage boys feel like robbing a house so they do, to lackluster results

title: The Vanishing Tour
overview: When a struggling band is carjacked and stranded in the desert, they seek shelter at a mysterious compound that houses a dangerous secret.

title: Backrooms (Gorilla Tag Movie)
overview: A lonely museum worker named Mark accidentally discovers the Backrooms, an endless maze of strange yellow rooms hidden beyond reality. After escaping, he becomes obsessed with uncovering its secrets, but the experience begins to destroy his life and sanity. When a terrifying presence appears to follow him into the real world, Mark and his friends venture back into the labyrinth in search of answers. As fear, paranoia, and death consume the group, Mark is forced to confront a horrifying truth that changes everything he thought he knew about the Backrooms—and himself. A Gorilla Tag fan film of the movie "Backrooms".

title: Schrödinger's Man
overview: In the midst of an existential crisis, Y. ostracizes himself to live the rest of his days in  solitude - locked in an underground bunker, with a system designed to euthanize him at a  random time.  Both dead and alive, his fragile peace is shattered by a series of apparitions.

title: Possessive Intelligence
overview: While developing a villain for a new hit game, Charlie accidentally creates an Intelligent and Dangerous AI

title: Emergence
overview: From turbulence to stillness, light and matter pass through a succession of transformations. Amid shifting particles and luminous forms, chaos gradually gives way to revelation.

title: Speaking Dead
overview: When a massive terror threat paralyzes downtown Seoul, former forensic scientist Jang Jae-wook arrives trailing a mysterious suitcase—containing a dead body instead of explosives. The dark shadow of a decade-old military incident comes to light, revealing a massive web of corruption spun by a deeply entrenched cartel of power. As the dead begin to speak, the buried truth is finally dragged into the light.

title: Hanahaki
overview: Hanahaki tells the story of an impossible love between a noblewoman and a commoner who, due to various circumstances, cannot be together. The word Hanahaki comes from Japanese and represents unrequited love, in which the character suffers with flowers growing inside her because the romance cannot be fulfilled.

title: Flow
overview: In Flow, a Chinese American young woman navigates lifelong pressure and expectations, working out what it means to live on her own timeline.

title: Diamond Made Man Part 2
overview: ​Diamond Made Man Part 2 :​For the first time in global cinema, the protagonist, Doctor E. Sreehari, pilots the legendary Golden Mecha robot from within, engaging in a colossal, high-stakes battle against the antagonist atop a massive asteroid.  ​Boasting cutting-edge technology, mind-blowing visual effects, and a deeply poignant cosmic romance, 'Diamond Made Man Part 2'is set to hit the silver screen.  Diamond Made Man Part 2 - The Sequel Narrative.  Hero : Doctor E. Sreehari MBBS  Actress : Vasudha  villain : Hayagreeva  Productions : Sampreeth Productions

title: Left Behind
overview: A deaf man searches for understanding.

title: Stroke of Dreams
overview: Two best friends share joyful, summer rituals before the start of their first college semester.

title: A New Creation Story
overview: Since the ancient world, Creation Stories have been told to help us not simply imagine the way the world was formed, but our divine place within it. Blending animation, poetry, music, stories rooted in various cultures and live elements, A New Creation Story celebrates Black Trans community and retells the making of the Universe — taking us on a journey from before the first molecule was crafted until the precise moment where everything has truly come to be.

title: Lumalalí Garawón
overview: Isiatinu is a young woman passionate about the art of drumming, in a community where this practice is forbidden for women. After facing discrimination, she decides to flee into the wilderness, guided by her ancestral spirits who seem to be calling her.  Throughout her journey—during which she communicates through the distant beats of her own drum—Isiatinu faces challenges that help her gain strength and determination, training until she masters the instrument enough to convince her community of her talent.

title: Unrequited Love
overview: An experimental poetic short exploring queerness, vulnerability and society’s ideas around the romanticism of love. This project centers societies’ forced delusions around romance and sexuality.

title: Blood Moon
overview: Across a single night, a ghost and a vampire drift through a haunting, music-driven meditation on belonging, finding love, tragedy and resurrection in a living–dying–living world.

title: Flower Power - Dutch Women Painters of the 17th Century
overview: In the 17th century, advances in the natural sciences and the invention of the telescope led Dutch women painters to closely study nature and include reptiles and insects in their art. Women such as Maria Sibylla Merian, Alida Withoos and Maria Moninckx advanced botany and zoology with their highly detailed paintings. Almost forgotten, now their works hang in many important museums around the world.

title: Jaffa's Stories 2
overview: A sequel to the theatrical film "Jaffa's Stories", based on the books by Menachem Talmi and the TV show adaptation.

title: Made With Love
overview: Director Max O'Connor Hurni crafts an intimate portrait of his family, tracing its history, exploring how it shaped his identity, and reflecting on his experience growing up with same-sex parents.

title: Let's Make Noise
overview: When the government tries to take away women’s right to vote, Stella joins forces with Carlotta and Marco to raise awareness. In doing so, she meets Prof. Zanetti, once an inspiring woman, now embittered after a life of lost battles.

title: Dear Ajayi
overview: In 1990s Nigeria, two estranged sisters forced to live under the same roof while caring for their paralysed mother navigate grief, ambition, love, and the fragile bonds of family.
trailerName: DEAR AJAYI I Official Trailer HD I 2o9ine

title: Les Audacieux.ses
overview: François, Renée, Gisèle, Sylvain. These seniors do not have much in common, but their lives have been shaped by episodes of abandonment, rejection, or fear. Some still live in invisibility, afraid of how others will look at them. Loneliness weighs heavily. For others, living with HIV has worn down their bodies, and old age arrives more quickly. Then there is a hope: that of a house in Lyon where they will finally be able to be themselves. A place where it will be possible to grow old without ever having to hide again. There is that family we choose for ourselves. The feeling that a new chapter is opening—the last one—filled with promise, and with the boldness of all those first times we finally allow ourselves, so late in life. But when it comes to becoming visible, the fears accumulated over a lifetime are never far away. And they come to pull our courageous dreamers back from their dream: should they take the leap?

title: Angela Allen: The Woman Who Saw Everything
overview: What do such classic films as The Third Man, The African Queen, The Misfits and Labyrinth have in common? Present during the filming of all of them was Angela Allen, acting as “continuity” – noting every shot and memorising all the details before her, working closely with the director, crew and actors to achieve a consistent and convincing world in front of the camera. She is one of the last witnesses to a truly golden age of cinema. Angela – who celebrated her 97th birthday in February 2026 – began her career as a 19-year-old on several British films, and then in 1948 was assigned to the second unit in Vienna for Carol Reed’s The Third Man. title: For Peace of Mind

When her mother, Gigi, unexpectedly arrives, she brings with her the generational discord Kya has been quietly working through. Rather than resist her mother’s presence, Kya learns to move with it. She seeks refuge in healing rituals with a circle of women she trusts, guided by a powerful healer named Martha, whose ancient medicine, Rapé, loosens something long buried in Kya and begins to soothe her generational wound. Through tears and sacred smoke and the roar of the ocean, her journey is revealed. And she finds the courage to hold her mother’s story, her grandmother’s story and her great-grandmother’s story with tenderness.

title: When The Lights Brighten
overview: History repeats itself, as a mother watches her daughter become enveloped in the world of theatre, causing a rift to grow between the two.

title: Fists of Mothers
overview: An action film about what happens when two mothers have an awkward conversation about a playdate that turns violent. A fun ride about Black maternal rage, a release for what we’re unable to do in real life — be angry, be messy in the face of both spectacular violence enacted on us and our families as well as the micro-aggressions that have a hidden violence that cuts deep.

title: Voicemail
overview: The central protagonist of Voicemail is the phone. A conversation happens between voicemail audio from the artist’s late mother and a transcription of his silent responses in the subtitles. The dialogue centers around missed calls, unanswered texts, busy schedules and the concerns of a loving parent.

title: Vape Glow
overview: Told entirely from the perspective of a recalled vape pen, Mike puffs around a dark vacation rental, illuminating it during an unusual blackout.

title: Glass Bricks
overview: Finessa Jawn — a trained dancer and life-long performer — gives us a look behind the curtain into the world of drag, walking us through the process of building a persona and embracing who you are regardless of society's expectations.

title: Closing Hour
overview: A young woman is stalked by a man who is becoming increasingly infatuated with her.

title: Authors of the Estate
overview: In North West London, two estates take their story into their own hands, asking what if a council house can become a publishing house in this tale of ownership, creativity, and the power of community.

title: Angels Pull Your Hair
overview: Angels Pull Your Hair is a narrative short about Danielle, a young Black woman grappling with the lasting impact of being raised by a mother with untreated mental illness. As Danielle struggles to make sense of her past, she’s haunted by the fear that she’s inherited her mother’s condition — a fear that takes form in the figure of a faceless sleep paralysis demon

title: Invention 13
overview: On a cold, windy night, a frustrated pianist encounters strange obstacles while trying to learn  Bach's notoriously intricate Invention 13.

title: Toy Story: 30 Years and Beyond - A Special Edition of 20/20
overview: Exploring the 40-year legacy of Pixar through the lens of its innovative and wildly successful franchise "Toy Story"; Pixar Animation Studios in Emeryville, Calif.; interviews with original cast members.

title: A Part of Me
overview: A Friendship crossing twenty years.

title: The Crew
overview: After retiring from the business, ex thief Johnny Valentine, runs into an old acquaintance and decides to throw away his comfortable life for one last job.

title: Flaccid
overview: A surreal feminist satire sees history’s greatest patriarchs - Adam, Genghis Khan, Henry VIII, and Napoleon - undone by Lilith and a mischievous Goddess of the void. Through rich tableaux, symbolic food rituals, and playful myth-making, the film exposes the fragility beneath dominance and reimagines softness as a radical force.

title: Veerabhadrudu
overview: Binu and her father travel to Chennai for her liver transplant, but the gold meant to fund her treatment is stolen, trapping them in a corrupt legal system. As corruption and judicial delays claim Binu's life, her father invokes the guardian deity Veerabhadrudu through a ritual. Suriya, as Veerabhadrudu, descends in the form of advocate Saravana, emerging as a divine force to deliver justice

title: Fare Thee Well
overview: Loco wakes up in bed with a stranger. They turn to a therapist for help. Suddenly, after an argument, Loco dreams of his wife. When he wakes up, he finds a terrifying creature in the bathroom.

title: Love/Bug
overview: A couple, affectionately naming each other Love and Bug, test the limits of their love living with each other for fifteen months.

title: In The Closet
overview: Before a friend's birthday, a group of friends notices one of them is acting weird.

title: 1939-1940: A Strange Defeat
overview: In late summer 1939, the French learned that Adolf Hitler had attacked Poland. On September 3, France entered the war, twenty years after the carnage of World War I. Although France was considered the world’s leading military power, with a vast empire and a powerful ally in the United Kingdom, everyone was overcome with a sense of dread. Yet the fighting would not begin until May 1940 and would end with France’s defeat in June. How did the French people experience those few months—among the most decisive and darkest in the country’s history?

title: Repor-TFM (Arbeitstitel)
overview: In search of the genre-specific nature of student life, the intrepid reporter Marie Behles sets out to find answers. Through her investigative reporting, she gathers insights into life at the Institute of Theater, Film, and Media Studies in Vienna and asks the questions no one else dares to ask. We report on an optimism that is cruelly shattered.

title: Igor and After
overview: This year’s gallery of artistically inspiring portraits of uncompromising eccentrics (among them The Hanging of Stuart Cornfeld, Robert Richardson: The White Devil and A Pint of Ink) features another unobtrusive stand-out in the shape of Igor Luther, a key figure of Slovak and European cinematography. Ivan Ostrochovský’s perspective is rare, dynamic and also meditative, while Luther himself co-authored the project during the last few months of his life. Works such as Juraj Jakubisko’s Birds, Orphans and Fools, Volker Schlöndorff’s The Tin Drum and Andrzej Wajda’s Danton, in the persuasive words of their creators, wouldn't have the same timeless energy today if it weren't for Luther's visionary endeavours.

title: Ekte kjærlighet
overview: Upcomming movie based on Norways most sold frozen pizza. Grandiosa

title: The Smith Family Movie
overview: The Smith Family Movie is a high-energy,  Live-Action holiday comedy-adventure centered around 12-year-old Aaliyah Smith (played by breakout star Pink Pinkett Jones). The story kicks off during the family’s chaotic, ultra-loud annual Christmas party, where Aaliyah is struggling to get her eccentric relatives to notice her passion for music. To bring everyone together, her aunt surprises the family with an all-expenses-paid winter vacation to a luxury holiday resort.

title: Reverse Myself
overview: A man who drowns in a pond and becomes trapped in another dimension attempts to recover a device stolen by his evil vibrance and restore his erased memories—driven by a single goal: to find his way back home.

title: Crash
overview: After surviving a tragic car accident, a man with a learner's licence and a dead phone must find his way home while battling the grief of losing his cousin.

title: It's FRIDAY
overview: On a sweltering May night, five seventeen-year-old friends gather for a pre-party drinking session, intending it to be their ultimate escape. However, the party spirals out of control when Laura suffers severe alcohol poisoning. Fearing the consequences and desperately seeking refuge, the group locks themselves in an empty house against the clock. In the suffocating confinement of this claustrophobic isolation, each girl's selfishness and secrets are laid bare, transforming the medical emergency into a brutal psychological examination that will test the limits of their loyalty and forever alter their relationships.

title: The Absurd Story of Gialappa’s Band
overview: Forty years after their beginnings on the frequencies of Radio Popolare, Gialappa’s Band retraces its professional history in a film directed by Walter Veltroni.With his attentive and original perspective, the director takes us through four decades of comedy, invention, and irony, recounting the journey of Giorgio Gherarducci, Marco Santin, and Carlo Taranto, three leading figures who revolutionized the language of entertainment in Italy. L’assurda storia della Gialappa’s Band explores the creative universe of the legendary trio and the mark left by their unique brand of comedy, capable of transcending generations and becoming an integral part of Italian popular culture.

title: Night of Blood
overview: Six strangers enter a cash-prize endurance challenge at the Val Verde Hotel, a location infamous for a fatal explosion and rumors of being haunted. Instead of being stalked by a physical, masked serial killer, the contestants face immersive, supernatural scares when the hauntings at the hotel turn out to be all too real.

title: EROS
overview: Beatriz is trapped in a vicious cycle where she doesn’t feel seen. All of that changes once she meets Sofia.

title: Another Iced Coffee
overview: Two friends meet for coffee, but a chance encounter with a drunken stranger sends their night in an unexpected direction.

title: Pet Shop
overview: Pet Shop works as an experiment on regret and suffering.  A juxtaposition of a dog in a pet shop and a window. Narrated from the perspective of God, or the Devil, the text recounts discussions a person has had with Him. The person accuses Him of destroying his life. This could be for a sin, a murder, or for falling in love with a person of the same sex.

title: Decorruption
overview: Alex and Maya use Time Travel to stop Harold from winning the election and becoming a Dictator

title: Lesbian Cleaning Service
overview: Between meticulous flower arrangements and sanitising sex toys, they must face the inevitable questions and washes of pain that come with falling in and out of love.

title: Ashamed
overview: Before his childhood best friend leaves for good, a closeted married man has one last chance to show the truth — or stay trapped in a life that was never really his.

title: Finding Your Laughter
overview: In this deeply personal documentary, Arlieta has gone against all popular advice and quit her day job to care for her father, Milton. She has to learn how to laugh in the midst of a disease that is not very funny, using improv to affirm and validate his experiences. Inspired by her father’s own artistic career, Arlieta turns to comedy to process her emotions. It’s challenging for her and her “bonus mom” Charmaine to watch Milton decline, but they support each other and find healing through laughter.

title: Charip: Lightning in the River
overview: When gold mining threatens their ancestral territory in the Peruvian Amazon, the Wampís Nation rises to defend land, rivers, and sovereignty, confronting global extractivism with resistance and territorial control.

title: A Life in Art: Through the Eye of Dr. Leslie King Hammond
overview: The life and work of Dr. Leslie King Hammond, a renowned art historian, teacher, curator and artist, exposes a side of the art world rarely seen. Through studio visits and museum exhibitions, Dr. Hammond untiringly dedicates her life to assisting artists of color find their way to success through humor, ingenuity and the incredible creativity she and her extended artist family embody. Her insistence on excellence and vision to rise above and transform the struggles she faces becomes contagious.
trailerName: A Life in Art: Through the Eye of Dr. Leslie King Hammond – Official Trailer
original_title: A Life in Art: Through the Eye of Dr. Leslie King Hammond

title: Spinoza
overview: In 1656 Amsterdam, young Jewish philosopher Bento de Spinoza watches his world collapse when his closest friend is executed for printing forbidden ideas. The city is gripped by plague, fear, and religious zeal, and Bento's growing habit of questioning sacred truths makes him a danger to both Church and synagogue. Amid this turmoil, he meets Rembrandt van Rijn, the once-celebrated painter now sliding into debt and disgrace.

title: Toy Story 5: Zhuazhou
overview: Promotional short film for "Toy Story 5" produced by Shanghai Animation Film Studio. The short tells the story of a bond between a boy and his Buzz Lightyear spanning over decades.

title: The Seeds We Carry
overview: A short documentary weaving intimate portraits of community farm stewards in Southwest Philadelphia. Through the rhythms of planting, cooking and sharing food, the protagonists reveal how everyday acts of care and resistance nurture belonging, foster cross-cultural kinship and preserve a sense of home amid the pressures of gentrification and displacement.

title: Think Again! I'm the Hidden Boss Mom
overview: PTA moms target and frame a "nobody" mom's son. She's humiliated and cast aside as a bigger secret emerges—until they learn she's the secret billionaire behind the school. Now she decides their fate.

title: Legacy
overview: What happens when you merge ballet, WW2, Incest and the gays?

title: Cucumber John
overview: After a devastating war in the wild west, cucumber farmer Cucumber John sets out for new beginnings in a new land. He is met with dangerous individuals who want to take his cucumbers and use them for their rival pickle business right under his nose.

title: Justice
overview: The online child safety taskforce, "Predator Puncherz", document their latest and most infamous sting operation.

title: Devils Lake
overview: When a group of kids go to the small town of Devils Lake for a bible camp, they are soon thrust into a cosmic reality of paranoia and terror following the mysterious death of their camp counselor.

title: Beneath the Blue Ice
overview: Tasha, a college student, finds herself caught between Layson, a devoted hockey player who loves her, and Aaron, who is only using her. As loyalties are tested on and off the ice, she has to decide who truly has her heart.

title: Fractured 3
overview: When Red and Chloe alter the past to save their families, they return to a fractured present where they are suddenly parents to teenage daughters, their oldest allies have become vicious enemies, and a stolen temporal pocket watch threatens to wipe Wonderland off the map forever.

title: Sang Suraksha
overview: How difficult it is to find work in Indonesia, which means many people are forced to work to survive on minimal wages.

title: Static
overview: After their father mysteriously vanished during their childhood, siblings Cali and Derrick follow the last known trace of him to a familiar landmark. But as the boundaries of reality begin to dissolve around them, Cali finds herself trapped within a vast, endless liminal space that feels hauntingly familiar.

title: Jia
overview: In the haze of a California summer, two best friends must reckon with their feelings for one another.

title: We Bark in the Same Tone of Voice
Computer No. 03
overview: The disappearance of a USB drive with unknown contents prompts an investigation into its whereabouts.

title: Fix
overview: When Victoria, a pharmaceutical executive, discovers her long-lost brother Damian is homeless and struggling with addiction, she takes a bold step-secretly administering an experimental drug to help him get back on his feet. All seems to be going well until the drug runs out.

title: Little High
overview: A heartbreak comedy about female friendship, accidental kidnapping, and a TikToking police officer set across one bright, terrible Nairobi afternoon.

title: 40 Wacks
overview: When a group of friends wander into a long abandoned home they soon discover that a evil spirit is among them.

title: RIO DREAMS
overview: On his 18th birthday in 90s Rio, a young man and his best friend join a jiu-jitsu gym to protect themselves from local threats. While one believes in dreaming beyond reality, the other rejects hope, convinced his future is already set.

title: Choked
overview: Shakona doesn't always want to be treated so nicely... sometimes she wants to feel like the world does: chaotic. Yet she can't get her devoted and loving boyfriend Eddie to meet her needs, so she goes to where all good decisions are made: a hookup app. Just as it seems like Shakona is finally letting go, she has the chance to take power into her own hands.

title: The Essentials 2

title: Everybody Hates Chris: Reunion
overview: After years apart, the original cast of Everybody Hates Chris reunites for a heartfelt and comedic look at how their lives have changed since the 1980s. Chris returns to Brooklyn for a special community event, only to find himself navigating old friendships, new responsibilities, and the same chaotic family energy he thought he’d outgrown. Blending nostalgia, humor, and modern-day challenges, the reunion brings the beloved characters back together for one unforgettable celebration.

title: Blood and Filth
overview: A wild Israeli horror-comedy, with neither boundaries nor responsibility, combining  a dysfunctional family, demons, murders, a dark legend and a lot of chaos.

title: OnlyFans: Inside the Machine
overview: Amber Haque reveals how OnlyFans models suffer widespread exploitation and coercion at the hands of their managers.

title: The Mirror's Echo
overview: A grieving teen discovers that her deceased twin sister is communicating through her vanity mirror, but the entity reflecting back is far from a sibling.

title: Our House
overview: Charls Carroll stars as a Revolutionary War soldier washed ashore from the past and resurrected.

title: Cheese Dreams
overview: Two rival cheese makers go head-to-head at their annual county village cheese fest.

title: A Última Fita
overview: Five young people rent a vacation house and discover VHS tapes containing brutal crimes from the 1990s.

title: She Saw Us
overview: When four friends discover a cursed two-headed doll in a remote forest, they unleash a vengeful witch who traps them in a place from which no one has ever escaped.

title: Ace and Cody vs. The Fry
overview: In the spirit of Scott Pilgrim vs. the World, Ace and Cody vs. The Fry is a high-energy, hyper-stylized short film that turns the most trivial moment—the last fry in the bucket—into the most important battle of two best friends’ lives. The second that lone fry is spotted, Ace makes the first move, setting off a breathless chase through a sprawling park that transforms the fields into a full-blown war zone. As the pursuit escalates like a video game fight, Ace and Cody are pushed to increasingly ridiculous heights in a showdown where everything seems to hinge on a single french fry.

title: SOS: A Misstep that Changes Life
overview: A young trainee teacher begins his journey into the teaching profession with hopes and ideals. His convictions are put to the test when he finds himself caught in an emotional triangle involving a female student and a male LGBTQ+ student, both deeply devoted to him. As affection turns into an increasingly complicated bond, he must confront difficult choices between professional responsibility and personal emotions.
trailerName: Full Trailer for the film SOS: One Wrong Step, A Life Changed

title: Wrecked
overview: Driven by her ambition to win a scholarship to study abroad, a college student leads her close-knit group of friends into an abandoned junkyard to film the season finale of their ghost-hunting channel, hoping to create a viral sensation. But what begins as a quest for views soon turns into a deadly nightmare.
trailerName: กองกอย - Official Trailer

title: Quaternité
overview: An experimental film, developed from an interactive installation and composed of 64 episodes. Its structure is based on coin tosses and the ancient Chinese "Book of Changes," where chance determines the order of events, editing, and the very logic of the narrative. The film follows the journey of several people through different spaces, the flow of unpredictable events in their lives, and the unexpected intersections of their destinies.

title: Vamps: The Tide of Rayburn
overview: When fierce mermaids and manipulative sirens invade Rayburn with deadly melodies, Theo and Morana must unite their factions to stop a subaquatic takeover, unaware that a dark evolution awaits Milo and a shifting tide threatens to wash them away forever.

title: Ultimate Racer
overview: As graduation approaches, two students at a prestigious racing academy must come to terms with what may be their final race together and the end of their rivalry.

title: How to Get Filthy Rich with Gary Stevenson
overview: In this provocative state-of-the-nation film, Stevenson travels across the country meeting those most affected by the widening wealth gap, alongside multi-millionaires and billionaires who sit at the other end of the economic spectrum.  Having made millions during his career in finance, Stevenson now campaigns against the expanding divide between rich and poor, and examines what he believes is driving inequality in Britain today.  The documentary sees him engage with economists, financiers, public sector workers and individuals from across society, going head-to-head with critics of his views while also hearing from those who support his proposed solutions.  At the heart of the film is Stevenson’s belief that meaningful change requires a wealth tax, with the super-rich contributing more to address what he sees as a broken system.

title: The Dream Machine
overview: Victor Neff moves into a new apartment and discovers a strange machine in the basement. Made of scrap metal, wires, and old television sets, it allows him to enter other people's dreams. But dreams are not empty, they are crowded with secrets, fears, and the dreamers themselves. - Based on the critically acclaimed point-and-click adventure game by Cockroach Inc.
trailerName: THE DREAM MACHINE | Official Trailer | July 12

title: Aryabhatt Ka Zero
overview: A directionless young man from a middle-class family struggles to find his place in a world that has already written him off. As life tests his resilience, he embarks on a heartfelt journey of self-discovery, hope, and finding the courage to believe in himself.

title: Last Day of Season
overview: On her final day working in a greenhouse, Romanian migrant worker Ana is followed by a documentary crew manipulating her story. Under pressure from her father and boss, tensions escalate. As she realizes she’s losing control, a turning point at work forces her to attempt an escape.

title: JULY
overview: During a seemingly ordinary school vacation, eight-year-old Diego struggles to understand why his older brother, Nicco, has suddenly become distant. While Diego clings to the simple rituals that once brought them together, Nicco retreats further into silence, carrying a pain no one around him fully sees. As memories of happier Julys blur with the present, Diego is forced to confront a reality beyond his understanding. Through the eyes of a child, JULY explores the quiet weight of depression, the bonds between siblings, and the small acts of love that can become lifelines in moments of darkness.

title: Don't Bring A Knife To A Gun Fight
overview: Vito Tucco is testifiying against the prosecution. The Charge? Murder. His case gets slowly revealed as the prosecutor digs deeper an deeper

title: I Love You Too
overview: Ryan and Haven are a newly together couple and after Haven tells Ryan she is in love with him he must figure what love means and if he feels that way for her while she must try not to succumb to the pressure of not knowing his answer.

title: The Magic of Movies: Jessie Saves the Day
overview: When a young child faces a hospital visit, Jessie, Woody, Buzz and the Toy Story gang set out on a mission to help her feel brave, turning a moment of worry into one of comfort, courage and Disney magic.

title: Pass the Bottle
overview: A reckless addict is taken on an unexpected journey that forces her to fight for survival.

title: Sonatax
overview: Vasco, a young pianist, spends entire nights practicing after a mysterious musician shows him his true potential. His world changes as the piano consumes more and more of his life.

title: Watch Out, Kid
overview: A young man is drawn to a handsome guy, but his insecurities stand in his way.

title: Now and Then
overview: A college student, along with her peers in Japan, rally to change the country’s hostile immigration laws that have incarcerated asylum-seekers in deadly detention centers. Meanwhile, over a century since the 1923 massacre of Korean people during a massive earthquake in Imperial Japan, young activists today take on the torch to seek justice under a government that continues to deny this history. A filmmaker documenting these young activists on the ground begins to excavate the underlying history of discrimination that connects the massacre of a hundred years ago and the draconian refugee system in Japan. Through the process of listening to voices from the past and present, the landscapes in Tokyo begin to echo the unfinished business of the nation’s reckoning with its colonial history.

title: The Exhibitor
overview: As murders begin to surface around hotels and expos, suspicion around Vi begins to close in. With her past resurfacing and her behavior growing harder to read, one question lingers: What is she really hiding?

title: Venex Ti - the movie
overview: When a plane crashes on the mysterious island of Venex Ti, the passengers begin killing each other in a battle royale to avoid starving to death.  Everything changes when a mysterious portal appears, turning everything upside down.

title: Plane Film
overview: In an effort to continue using filmmaking as exposure therapy (after conquering her fear of the Tube in Tube Film), filmmaker Orla Smith tackles an even bigger fear: planes. On a trip to Porto, the camera is wielded as a shield against panic attacks. But this time, things don’t go exactly to plan.

title: Motherland
overview: Patria I is a medium-length film by Juan Ibarlucía and Magela Crosignani that reimagines the form of the Baroque oratorio within the post-industrial landscape of Argentina in 2026. Drawing on a south american reinterpretation of the myth of Cain, and employing music, poetry, performance, and installation art, the work takes the audience on a powerful sonic and emotional journey that spans an extraordinary range of human experience—from extreme violence to compassion and tenderness.

title: Goners
overview: Two brothers at odds must learn to get along to survive their camping trip.

title: Devil's Breath
overview: Upon a date with another man, John was drugged and all his money stolen. He has no choice but to turn to his brother, Frank, for help; a small-time gangster looking for his next fight.

title: Colors
overview: Different colors moving into harmony of Children's Corner, L. 113: IV. The snow Is dancing.

title: Rivals: Messi v Ronaldo
overview: As football entered a new era of global prominence, two players emerged who would redefine not just greatness but the sport itself. This film looks at two individuals who didn’t just dominate their era – they created one. For over a decade, their rivalry transcended clubs, countries and competitions, becoming the defining story of modern football – reshaping how the game was played, consumed and debated across the world.

title: Keu Na Januk
overview: A young man dreams of becoming a renowned photographer instead of taking a regular job, but while his father sees him as irresponsible and unsuccessful, only his girlfriend continues to believe in him as he struggles against a series of setbacks.

overview: Deep in an English forest, a man on the run returns again and again to the same moment of judgement, and the same impossible choice.

overview: As the main caretaker of her alcoholic father, a young woman experiences doubts as she prepares to leave her stagnant life behind for a boyfriend she may not fully trust. Based on "Eveline" by James Joyce.

overview: 1 Godfather, 2 Goons, 3 Euros and a whole lot of Greek Cult TV

title: The Town That Takes
overview: After his young son vanishes during a family road trip through a remote backwoods town, a desperate father joins forces with two detectives to uncover the terrifying truth behind the legend of CROATOAN. As the town's dark secrets unravel, they realize something ancient is hunting children.

title: 16 Pages
overview: A not so good in his mind director tries to get funding for his new film

title: Almari
overview: When a family discovers the enchanting powers of their old mysterious cupboard, their lives spiral into a web of desires, drawing both - foes and vices to their doorstep.

title: Les abeilles ne sont pas encore mortes.
overview: After receiving devastating news one morning, Esther, a silent young girl, goes through her daily routine while a darker reality gradually unfolds.

title: The Space Between Myself and Myself
overview: A young soul called "The Self" recollects the memory of his past while having an ego death in a possible future.
original_title: The Space Between Myself and Myself

title: Burnt Ends
overview: Ten filmmakers were tasked with making surreal short film segments that loosely involve a cigarette. The result is Lynchian chaos in anthology form - the good ends, the bad ends, the loose ends, and the burnt ends. A sprawling anthology about all things cigarettes.

title: Old Man River
overview: Old Man River continues Iyabo Kwayana’s exploration of lineage, memory and inheritance through an intimate portrait of her father, a 100-year-old political activist and nation builder from Guyana who helped found the country’s first multiethnic political party. The film sits beside him as he reflects on a lifetime shaped by political struggle, idealism, sacrifice and the contradictions within revolutionary movements.

title: Our Bodies Ours
overview: Our Bodies Ours is a short poetic animated film that explores the nuance and beauty of trans becoming from a diasporic lens. Leaning on the music of lyric, it reframes gender-affirming care as an intricate, intimate and meandering act. What does it take to stitch our bodies into their true and ever-changing shapes, to migrate between who we are and who we may become?

title: Un homme libre
overview: To make a quick buck, a young Quebec worker arrives in Fort McMurray. Obsessed with his ambitions, he finds himself in a difficult situation following a workplace accident.

title: The Philadelphia Sensei: Lovett Hines
overview: For decades, Philadelphia music educator Lovett Hines quietly shaped generations of artists from behind the scenes, nurturing creativity, discipline, individuality and community through music education. Now at 80 years old, his influence continues to ripple across stages, classrooms and cultures through the students and mentees whose lives he helped transform.  Blending intimate conversation, performance, archival elements and reflections from acclaimed artists including Christian McBride, Ahmir “Questlove” Thompson, Bilal and Robert Glasper, The Philadelphia Sensei: Lovett Hines explores the enduring impact of a Black mentor whose classroom became a launching ground for artistic excellence, self-discovery and cultural legacy.  At its heart, the film is a meditation on mentorship, lineage and the often unseen architects behind transformative art.

title: The Store
overview: In a forgotten corner of the city, an unassuming bodega serves as a gateway to ancestral wisdom. Patrons searching for everyday items receive something far greater — TEACHA brand products, unlocking visions of a world where Black people thrive beyond limitation. Blending afrosurrealism with the aesthetics of ’70s and ’80s urban culture and African and Caribbean spirituality, the Hood Botanica transforms the bodega into a portal of self-discovery. The silent store clerk, adorned with cowrie AirPods, serves as the quiet guide to transformation.

title: West Side Familia
overview: Through intimate portraits of this tight-knit community, West Side Familia follows the story of a Puerto Rican-led biker gang and community care group from the ‘70s grappling with the preservation of their public traditions and cultural identity in the hyper-gentrified neighborhood of Manhattan’s Upper West Side.

title: Death by Roux
overview: A married couple throws a dinner party for their neighbors, with a special gumbo recipe on the menu.

title: 66 Days
overview: Set in the village of Bazouriye in South Lebanon, "66 Days" follows filmmaker Joude Bazzoun’s return to her homeland after witnessing Israel’s 2024 assault on Lebanon from abroad. Through intimate conversations with her family, Joude uncovers the losses they have suffered as a result of the war. The film reflects on the importance of memory and tradition by exploring the ritual of a card game and family gatherings. 66 days quietly resists erasure, preserving the family’s stories and heritage while celebrating the defiant joy found in simple family traditions.

Welcome to “the Tropics”! Where the paradoxes of neocolonial daily life are at work in a suffocating economic and health context.

title: Amal
overview: Amal (Hope) is a film co-directed by Arab and Jewish filmmakers and inspired by true events. Amal is a mother who sets out to rescue her son Samer from his preordained fate. When her son is involved with a shooting incident in the village, Amal acknowledges that if the warring clan is not stopped, her son will become the next victim. She fights with all her might for a “Sulha” (reconciliation). But the threat of chaos looms large, and Amal faces powerful forces that tear her apart and engulf the entire village. In the end, fate proves stronger, and Amal is swept into the bloodshed she has fought so hard to prevent.

title: Heart Of Gold
overview: Mali Azulai (38), a bus inspector in Ashkelon, is on the verge of losing her job after a violent altercation with a teenage passenger. When she returns to an empty bus to retrieve the body camera she left behind, she finds an abandoned baby on the floor and decides to take him home. Her brother Shimon (32), a prison guard struggling through a marital crisis, joins her, and the two shut themselves away with the child. His presence stirs the siblings’ shared wound of abandonment, as long-buried secrets come to light. When the baby falls ill and a hospital visit becomes unavoidable, Mali is forced to choose, hold on or let go and face the cost.

title: I Can't Say No to Myself
overview: Zohar, a young dancer, arrives in Berlin to visit her best friend Shira. She meets Gillen, an insecure German poet, and together with Shira’s boyfriend, the four form a friendship that, for a moment, makes anything seem possible. But as the bond between Zohar and Gillen deepens, the bubble they have built around themselves begins to unravel. When a violent incident reveals sides of each other, they had never seen before, the two refuse to let go. What begins as an attempt to repair their relationship, culminates in an intimate and extreme event that will change them both. An intimate portrait of young people searching for belonging and meaning in the world, struggling with the gap between fantasy and reality.

After staging a shocking act of protest in Tel Aviv, Sasha ignites the "269Life" movement, which quickly becomes a symbol of radical activism. At the height of the struggle, he meets Maria, a fellow immigrant and outsider who carries the same sense of displacement within Israeli society. Their shared alienation fuels both a fierce global movement and an intimate love story. But as their actions spread across continents and inspire thousands, they find themselves unable to escape the heavy costs of living on the front lines of revolution.

title: (im)perfect strangers
overview: A group of longtime friends gathers around the dinner table, unaware that this evening will change their relationships forever.

title: Find Me, Okay?
overview: Saturday morning, Eden Yerushalmi and her best friend, Arbel, are dancing at the Nova Festival. Hours later, Eden is taken to Gaza while her sisters listen helplessly on the phone. What begins as a desperate hope for her return, becomes a journey through uncertainty, public struggle, and devastating loss. Through intimate access to Eden’s mother, sisters, and her best friend Arbel, Find Me, Okay?, follows the fight to bring Eden Yerushalmi home, the moment hope collapses, and the painful attempt to rebuild life afterward. A two-year portrait of love, grief, resilience, and the impossible task of moving forward after trauma.

title: Good Morning Gaza
overview: Or Brandes, a reserve soldier serving in Gaza as a tank driver and a psychology student, broadcasts an improvised podcast to fellow soldiers over the military radio network. From candid conversations about fear and denial, to feelings of revenge, through jokes and absurd banter, the soldiers open up with striking honesty. Using excerpts from the radio communications alongside intimate footage from combat, the film offers a rare glimpse into the inner lives of soldiers in the aftermath of October 7th.

title: I Am Neo
overview: Neo was three and a half years old when a devastating car accident left him with a severe brainstem injury. After five days suspended between life and death, he wakes up unable to breathe, speak, walk, or eat on his own. In the hospital, his parents, Lior and Galit, pick up a camera and never put it down. Shaped from hundreds of hours of intimate footage, 'I Am Neo' is a portrait of a child and his family slowly rebuilding their lives, revealing both the fragility of life, and the strength of the human spirit.

title: Heidi Wrangles Cats
overview: A young woman quits her day job to help Brooklyn's street cats. Along the way, she builds a social media following that financially sustains her rescue efforts.

title: Shipwrecked: Nightmare at Sea

Meanwhile, actors rehearse a play that strangely mirrors these lives. A portrait of unexpected encounters and the chance events that weave the fabric of our lives.

overview: In her desperate attempts at finding community during her college years, Adele decides to join The Girls--an exclusive sorority who are the source of dark and twisted rumors. But as the rituals begin, the lines between an elitist club and a cult blur and our heroine finds herself at a point of no return.

title: Beings

title: My Husband

Meanwhile, she is also desperately trying to get her pusher cousin Frederik to realize that he must visit his dying mother, Mona's beloved and all-embracing Aunt Tut. Will Mona succeed in getting Frederik to reconcile with his mother - and how? Can she match the intellectual Nikolaj - or is the class gap too great?

title: Lionheart

Issa has been by Luan's side since childhood, almost like a brother in a world where loyalty matters more than blood. A new beginning is not like putting on a clean shirt. You can change your address, your clothes and the company you keep, but the old rules remain. The body remembers how to stand. The eyes know who to trust.

title: Midnight City

title: Zenón and the Rebel Boats
overview: After being displaced from his home by the U.S. Navy to build a military base, Puerto Rican fisherman Carlos “Taso” Zenón pledged his life to fight against the military occupation of the island of Vieques. Alongside Puerto Rican fishermen and activists, Zenón organized countless efforts to halt U.S. war games in the Caribbean Sea. Never-before-seen archival footage reveals the artisanal strategies implemented by fearless fishermen to defy warships, inspiring one of the most influential environmental and anti-war movements in the Caribbean.

Along the way, he saves Jiehe, a girl with a music dream on the verge of despair, and she becomes a glimmer of light in his dark life. To protect the ones he cherishes and account for his past, he picks up the knife again. A thrilling gunfight breaks out in the dark alleys of the city, and he turns the tables time and again with his skills. Tearing off Huoshan's disguise, the truth from eight years ago comes to light.

The encounter between these two artists shines an even deeper light on the darkness within each of them.  Will they ultimately seize what they desire?  Or— will they sink into the abyss of art?

When the Dutch came to conquer Aceh, they encountered something far harder to subdue than any war fleet in the world: women fighting to defend their homes and protect their children.

As the night unfolds, Ayaan begins to question everything around him—including the passenger in his back seat, the city outside his window, and whether some rides are meant to end at all.  IN TRANSIT is a psychological thriller exploring isolation, choice, and the terrifying possibility that some paths cannot be escaped once they're taken.

title: Dead Parents Club
overview: Dead Parents Club is a hybrid documentary blending observational footage, experimental performance, and cultural analysis to challenge the pervasive "orphan trope" in popular culture.  While children's media like The Lion King, Frozen, and Finding Nemo frequently use parental loss as a narrative tool to spark a character's independence, the lived reality of grief is vastly more complex.  The film follows real individuals who have lost parents as they collaborate on a unique theatre production. By stepping into the roles of iconic fictional orphans like Simba and Frodo, the cast members weave their personal stories of trauma into the scripted scenes. The resulting performance offers a poignant, absurd, and unexpectedly funny exploration of identity and healing.  Moving between fantasy and lived experience, this documentary examines how we navigate profound loss, build deep connections, and ultimately learn to parent ourselves.

You'll be happy to know he made Sting of Death first, so Wild Rebels was a movie he made as an even more experienced filmmaker. As an added bonus, this movie also features the aptly titled "Do The Jellyfish" by Songwriting Hall of Fame inductee Neil Sedaka. Does this tune warrant TWO extended dance sequences? title: The Andersons

Jokes repeat word for word, objects reset, the world seems to glitch, and an unseen audience appears to be watching her every move.  As the cracks begin to show, Lisa steps beyond the sitcom stage and into a void where the making of the show is revealed: cameras, crew, and the presence of an audience. Desperate to escape, she fights her way back into the “show,” only to find the family reset, everyone frozen in their roles while the laughter never stops.
