After escaping death, she adopted the alias Minghui and lived in seclusion in a small town with her blind sister Mingzhu, running a coffee shop. An accident exposes their whereabouts, and former accomplices track them down, catching Mingzhu in a manhunt. To save her sister, Chao Xi is forced to return to the killing game, and her hidden identity is revealed amidst the gunfire.

title: Astonishers
overview: The reporters call them the 'Guardians of Tomorrow’,  the people call them the ‘ASTONISHERS’. The Man of Tomorrow, The Dark Knight, The Man Without Fear and your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man must confront their grief and stop the renewed Dark Lord of the Sith DARTH VADER and his group of Watchmen from reshaping Earth and its people to his will.

title: Léon : Au-delà de l’Or
overview: For one year, Léon Marchand allows cameras to follow him through competitions, studies, family life, and growing fame. Through an intimate perspective, the documentary reveals the man behind the champion as he searches for purpose after achieving so much at such a young age.

title: Nowhere to Lay My Eyes
overview: With her brother, Sanghee visits her mother on Jeju Island. It’s been 10 years. Her mother's restaurant has become a hit. Her stepfather is making a film about a "grass tomb". His daughter has just started painting. Previously unknown facts, needless advice and cheap compliments are passed back and forth. On the morning of her departure, the other family members watch one of Sanghee's films.

title: You Don't Belong Here
overview: Marius is the chief medical officer at a hospital in his small hometown, raising a teenage son, Ioan, alone after the death of his wife. He is a confident professional, who has no idea what his son gets up to at night.

title: Aks seir
overview: Two young men struggling with financial pressure take jobs at a cash-in-transit company and devise a plan to rob it from the inside. But when their scheme spirals out of control, they find themselves caught in a chaotic chase where nothing goes according to plan.

title: Sixteen Moments of My Life
overview: Ingrid Caven sings about 16 moments from her life in a unique concert at the Théâtre des Bouffes du Nord in Paris.

title: D'ici là
overview: High up in a valley in the Vosges, Lucien seeks peace in utter solitude. Aline, tracking a wolf, confronts her deepest fears. And young Jade grapples with her true nature.

title: Manhunt
overview: Inspired by the real 2019 Northern British Columbia manhunt when two teenage boys from Vancouver Island murdered three strangers and fled north through ghost towns and endless forest. Their flight, live-tracked across social media and news feeds, unfolded like a fever dream of the digital age: an openworld simulation of fear and fascination. Weeks later, their bodies were found by a river, the chase ending as abruptly as it began.

title: Siping
overview: A gripping story about a woman wagered in a high-stakes card game. But the stakes get even hotter when she’s won by the man who’s long been obsessed with her.
trailerName: SIPING Official Trailer | World Premiere this JULY 10 only on VMX

title: O Jacaré
overview: Reboleira, a suburb of Lisbon. After a robbery gone wrong, a car ends up crashed right in the middle of the neighborhood. The driver is arrested, but the €180,000 that were stolen have vanished. Within the area sealed off by the police, rumors spread and speculations run wild. Among the residents, a whole cast of colorful characters dream of getting their hands on the loot. Who will the first to get their hands on it?

title: No Eggs For Breakfast Today
overview: A young man attempts to destroy the evidence of his girlfriend's murder, only to wake up the next morning and discover that his efforts were in vain.

title: The Blessing
overview: Several people have barricaded themselves inside a bar. The music must never stop, otherwise something terrible could happen.

title: Somero
overview: The Four Seasons - part one: Two strangers are brought together during a lock-down, in the wake of a world changing natural event.

title: Isle Navigator: The Buried Baby
overview: The quake stole a mother's memory, but her child never forgot. Buried deep underground, how will he find a way to restore the memories she has lost? A segment of the Taiwanese animated anthology Isle Navigator, the film had its world premiere as a standalone short at the 30th Fantasia International Film Festival, where it was selected for the Satoshi Kon Award competition.
trailerName: The Buried Baby｜Official Trailer - 奇談島航「埋葬的孩子」預告

title: A Sweet Day
overview: When a young woman gets the chance to have a conjugal meeting with her imprisoned husband after a long time,  ​she decides to re-experience a romantic time in the apathetic and harsh atmosphere of the prison.

title: Jonás
overview: Jonás, a teenager about to become a father, has secretly decided to escape.

title: Bhootu Aaya Bhago
overview: Three friends find themselves trapped in a series of mysterious and supernatural incidents inside a hospital.

title: Reaper Road
overview: Two friends end up on a never-ending road that leads into the woods, trapping them in a hellish dimension.

title: Sludge
overview: Sinead Murphy’s debut film, Sludge, follows a young homeless woman living on the fringes of Irish society and deeply in love with her best friend. Haunted by fractured traumatic memories and visions of a dark-hooded figure, she struggles to hold onto reality as her friend is drawn into the orbit of a dangerous underworld. As her world unravels, she must confront the terrifying truth behind the figure that stalks her, and face the darkness within.

title: aunque solo 1 fuera
overview: Something in Cata has changed. Yet she drifts through the nights alongside her partner Rocco and his neo-rock band. But a positive pregnancy test forces her to face a reality she doesn't know how to handle. They escape to the countryside for the weekend, where her inability to communicate grows under the weight of guilt and fear. Back at their usual venue, everything reaches a breaking point, causing Cata to explode and Rocco to lose control on stage.

title: Pavers
overview: Les Pavés follows a street photographer wandering through Brussels, where unexpected encounters with homeless people lead him into intimate conversations. As he tries to preserve fleeting moments through his camera, he is forced to confront the inevitability of disappearance.

title: Mukhbir: The Story of a Spy - The Movie
overview: After the Sino-Indian war, a highly trained Indian spy enters Pakistan on a mission to gather crucial intelligence and stop Pakistan from launching an attack against India. Will he succeed?
trailerName: Mukhbir: The Story of a Spy

title: My Grandfather Charles Manson
overview: Sophia was always the good girl growing up and her father's rock, but her quest to identify her unknown grandfather results in a shocking discovery: He is Charles Manson, history's most notorious criminal; and he bears striking physical similarities to her beloved father. Sophia's discovery propels her into an underworld of Manson family members and unreliable narrators as she traces her grandfather's life. Along the way, her genetics unlock never-before-released records and audio recordings that illuminate Manson's pathology in startling ways. But the more Sophia uncovers, the more her relationship with her father is strained. For Sophia, there's no turning back. What has she inherited, and how will she reckon with her family legacy?

title: Bótharín
overview: With his beloved older sister in the throws of Alzheimer's and on her deathbed, an elderly man pieces together an uncertain truth which tosses their whole relationship into question.

title: In On The Joke
overview: Four friends challenge each other to a surreal competition consisting in devising elaborate pranks to play on one another, until yet another prank takes a horrific turn.

title: The Night Everything Changed
overview: When Tina's teenage daughter doesn't return home from a sleepover with her closest friends, she goes on a frantic hunt to find her before it's too late. In the process, she unravels dark secrets of a forbidden romance and a tryst among BFFs.

title: The Nation
overview: A First Nation Chief develops radical ideas about sovereignty.
trailerName: The Nation | Official Trailer (2026) — On Digital JULY 3

title: Destroy All Girls
overview: Alex bolts from her stifling home to ride with a band of inline street skaters. Bouncing around New York City with nothing other than skates and a camcorder, escape comes easy at first. But as family and identity collide, she's forced to face the one thing she can't outride – herself.

title: The General
overview: July 4th, 1976. Two hundred years after the signing of the Declaration of Independence, America has changed a lot. Far removed from the original ideals are some individuals. The youth becoming more and more opposed to the "freedom" promised, while others use their power for their own personal gain. It's enough for the Founding Fathers to be rolling in their graves, literally.

title: The Fox sisters
overview: Based on historical events, The Fox Sisters tells the story of sisters Leah, Maggie, and Kate Fox, whose experiences helped give rise to modern Spiritualism.

title: Unification of Japan 76
overview: Following the death of acting chairman Baba (Akihiko Kuwata), Kyowakai continues its hunt for Adachi (Atsushi Arai), while the Marugami-kai and the Special Investigation Unit closely monitor their movements. As expected by Himuro (Yasukaze Motomiya), Adachi contacts the Keihin Alliance's Sakagami (Yoshiki Kanahashi), prompting the Yamazaki Ichimon to stake out the group's key locations. Adachi attempts to strike a deal with Sunaga (Masataka Naruse) but flees when it falls through, escaping Teru (Yutaka Kyan) and Ryuji (Tatsuya Kishida). Himuro and Tamura (Yoshiyuki Yamaguchi) then change tactics by kidnapping Sunaga. Meanwhile, reports pour in that Yamazaki faction members are attacking the Keihin Alliance's affiliated groups, leaving everyone to wonder what Himuro's true plan is.

title: Darwin's Game
overview: Live-action film adaptation of *Darwin's Game*

title: Holiday Touchdown: A Bears Love Story
overview: When ambitious freelance reporter Avery Clark returns to Chicago to spend Christmas with her mom and new stepdad, she's hoping for a little holiday downtime before her next assignment. Instead, she lands a feel-good story profiling Darlene Donnelly, a beloved Chicago Bears superfan about to celebrate an incredible milestone: attending her 500th game. There's just one catch: Avery knows next to nothing about football or Chicago. Enter Darlene's handsome grandson Matt, a Chicago firefighter and die-hard Bears fan who, with a little gentle nudging from Darlene, agrees to show Avery what being a part of Bears Nation is all about.
trailerName: NEW! Holiday Touchdown: A Bears Love Story | Coming to Hallmark Channel This Countdown to Christmas!

title: Rumours of Madam Roach
overview: A woman is monitoring her neighbours through a pair of world altering binoculars, while the world around her deteriorates.
trailerName: Rumours of Madam Roach (2026) Official Trailer | Experimental Horror

title: Darwin '74
overview: A protagonist travels back in time during Cyclone Tracy to talk to their grandparents about intergenerational violence.

title: Sangkal
overview: Luna, a final-year university student, begins her thesis under the supervision of her lecturer, Mr. Garda, who initially seems kind and supportive. Behind his friendly facade, however, Mr. Garda abuses his position of power by sexually harassing Luna and threatening to delay her graduation if she refuses his advances. Deeply traumatized, Luna disappears without a trace. Her best friend, Laras, grows suspicious, only to find herself becoming the next victim of the same abuse.

title: Feather Dance
overview: Upcoming short film from Louise Dodge in collaboration with Bus Stop Films participants.

title: Hatchling
overview: Two blacksmiths discover a mysterious egg—and as the egg hatches—they must deal with the monster that comes out from inside.

title: Saturday Night's Main Event XLV
overview: Undisputed WWE Champion CM Punk joins forces with Cody Rhodes against Gunther and Sami Zayn, Danhausen competes in his first match at Madison Square Garden as he takes on JD McDonagh in a No Disqualification Match, and WWE Women's Tag Team Champions Paige and Brie Bella defend their title against Lainey Reid and Fallon Henley of Fatal Influence.

title: Unexposed
overview: Gunawan, a man widely admired for his kindness and impeccable reputation, is relentlessly pursued by a mysterious killer before ultimately meeting a brutal end. As the truth unfolds, however, it is revealed that the killer is not acting at random but is seeking revenge. Behind Gunawan's mask of virtue lies a sexual predator whose actions drove the killer's younger sister to take her own life. Shielded by his wealth, influence, and social standing, Gunawan escaped legal consequences. In the end, the mysterious killer becomes the one who delivers the justice that the law failed to provide.

title: Clay Life
overview: A struggling actor builds a clay figurine of himself that comes to life and quickly achieves everything he has always dreamed of.

title: Pirjo in Sweden
overview: When Pirjo Heikkilä embarrasses herself in public at a charity event, she begins to believe that she needs a change of scenery. Pirjo learns a surprising secret about her family that leads her to Sweden. Pirjo sets off on her journey convinced that her true life awaits her in Stockholm—surrounded by royalty, new friends, and greater human dignity. But the trip turns out to be anything but dignified. She faces one awkward situation after another and an endless need to appear more Swedish than she really is.

title: O'Slaughter Day
overview: The day before Christmas, the Veterinary Board receives a positive A test result from a wild boar shot by a hunter. The young veterinary officer has a disposal machine ready and starts touring the farms in his former home village. The very first farm in Kiuma village is home to the elderly and childless Ants and Minna. For the couple, their domestic animals are a substitute for their missing children and loved ones. At the same time, Ants' nephews arrive with their wives and children. The goal is to quickly deliver the gifts and drive back home to the city. But the farmer Ants announces the situation he is in with his animals, and now he needs the help of his relatives to slaughter the pigs.
trailerName: SEATAPP | Kinodes üle Eesti 25. septembrist | Teaser trailer

title: Sea of Glass
overview: 65-year-old Vangelio decides to go on holiday after her husband's death. In a run-down off-season seaside resort she meets Vicky, a young woman caring for her alcoholic father. When Vangelio protects Vicky from her father's violence, chaos erupts in their seaside town.

title: Dread
overview: Terror takes many forms. In five chilling tales, the mundane becomes monstrous and no one gets out clean.

title: As Long As It Snows
overview: As a child, Margo witnesses her best friend vanish into a snowstorm, marking her for life. Twenty years later, now a teacher, one of her students vanishes under similar circumstances. During the search, she meets a man who bears an unsettling resemblance to her childhood friend.

title: Ma the Matician
overview: Musician Pi has lost the story he once wanted to convey through his songs. With the core of his creativity gone, he drifts without direction. Heo-su, who loves mathematics, devotes himself to his research while extolling its beauty. He dreams of Paris, a city where mathematics coexists with history and the arts. Recognizing the extraordinary potential of both individuals, Lee harbors an ambitious vision: to build a multidisciplinary cultural and arts collective around them and orchestrate something on a grand scale.

title: Il était une fois le printemps
original_title: Il était une fois le printemps

title: Angelo Azzurro
overview: Short film directed by Tommaso Acquarone.

title: Tesztpálya
overview: Short film directed by Lydia Cornett.

title: A Fortress
overview: Antu has been living in her occupied school for months, which she and her classmates took over. As her mother’s birthday approaches and rumors of eviction grow, Antu is faced with a choice: she stay in the own world she and her friends have created, or return home?

title: Los Poderes
overview: Marco is 18 years old. While his mother insists on having him admitted to a rehab clinic, he is convinced that he only needs one last chance to turn his life around.

title: Silence
overview: After his stand-up routine goes awry, Luka goes to drink his sorrows away in a bar. There he meets a mysterious woman in a bar, with the two immediately hitting it off and deciding to go to the former's apartment together. However, as the night goes on, what was supposed to be a one time hook-up leads to the two discovering much more about themselves and they form a powerful spiritual connection.

title: Love Monster
overview: "Love Monster", the opening chapter of FENDI Couture Fall/Winter 2026-2027, a sensuous journey from Villa Borghese through Galleria Nazionale d’Arte Moderna e Contemporanea, extending the collection’s exploration of sensuality, freedom, and pleasure.

title: Bhootam Bhayyam
overview: Seven unemployed friends move into a cursed mansion and discover a mysterious coin. Using it in planchette sessions for quick cash, they awaken ancient forces. Now spirits and occultists hunt them as dark secrets emerge.

title: DON'DUT
overview: Aflah and his team began working on a personal documentary about Aflah challenging himself to lose weight. But as time went on, his goals began to crumble, his diet slowly lost focus, while Aflah’s desire to control the direction of the film only grew stronger. His team began to question whether this documentary was truly about change, or simply about Aflah wanting to make himself the center of the story.

title: Under The Rug
overview: A man hides a dead body in his apartment and he suspects everyone who comes to the door knows what he did.

title: Sensai
overview: A nymph who longs for the sky sets out to craft the dress that will turn her into a star, transforming her insecurities into creativity.

title: Uprising
overview: Through an AI-driven reinterpretation of Mexican Revolution footage captured by the country's cinema pioneers, this documentary offers a fresh look at a pivotal historical moment. It traces the movement's rise, peak, and fall, the birth of a new nation, and invites us to question the narratives that have shaped our identity and the present we inhabit.

title: Freedom 7
overview: On May 5, 1961, Alan Shepard became the first American in space. He was launched into a sub-orbital ballistic trajectory onboard a Mercury capsule, Freedom 7, the flight lasting approximately 15 minutes. This documentary provides an astronaut-point-of-view story of the project.

title: Scavenger
overview: Spring, 2019. Cody disappeared one night. He left his father $167 and Isaac a note... Now both men are picking up the pieces, never anticipating their paths will cross.

title: No Name, No Address
overview: Sérgio is a charismatic radio host who presents the show "The Sound of Love", where he reads letters from people seeking help with their relationships and offers them advice. However, when a letter with no return address arrives at the show, Sérgio begins to spiral into a frenzy of guilt and sorrow.

title: Take a Piece of Me With You for the Rest of Your Life
overview: Cornélia is on her way to meet her wife, Carmem, at a restaurant that holds special memories for both of them. As the meeting unfolds, small cracks appear in their conversation and silences, revealing hidden layers of their relationship and leaving the impression that not everything is quite as it seems.

title: J.
overview: David keeps seeing his ex in other people's faces.

title: cecelia
overview: Inspired by the filmography and thought of the filmmaker Cecelia Condit, "cecelia" is an experimental short film that follows the hazy memories that torment the protagonist as an alter ego guides her toward a painful truth.

title: Storm Bird
overview: A celebrated composer facing death, his working-class neighbour facing jail, and a sharp New York writer form an unlikely alliance over one charged weekend in Far North Queensland.

title: Fire Flower
overview: Yoko Hayasuke's journal is set in the wake of the tsunami and nuclear disaster after the Tōhoku earthquake. Something happened yet life goes on: Tokyo continues to expand, new soil replaces irradiated land.

title: Summer Meadow
overview: Hana works as an apprentice shepherdess, leading an isolated life in the Alps, far from the hustle and bustle of the world and the echoes of her native Lebanon. The arrival of Lisa, who has been sent to help her with the animals, forces her out of her solitude and invites her to reconnect with her own story.

title: The Illusion of an Everlasting Summer
overview: Filmed over twenty-five years, The Illusion of an Everlasting Summer traces the lives of two inseparable cousins, Guillermina and Belinda, as they grow up in the vast Argentine Pampas.

title: Revolutionaries Never Die
overview: Seeking to decode a final, unanswered invitation, a filmmaker explores why the renowned Lebanese director Jocelyne Saab reached out for a collaboration just two months before her passing.

title: September Afternoon
overview: A couple refuses to accept that summer is over. For a last time, they head to the coast with the intention of spending two afternoons together between sand dunes and sea water. The temperatures have long been too cold for sandals and shorts; the blustery autumn wind is no substitute for cosy rays of summer sun. On the way to the beach, they cross paths with a woman they know loosely. Upon arrival, they look in vain for a dune to take shelter from the wind; a small dam is built and defended hard against the tide, an attempt to erect a windbreak is made. These desperate struggles against the encroaching elements are merely a brief interlude before the situation unravels into a disaster of an entirely different magnitude. A contemporary cosmic catastrophe.

title: Small Talk
overview: Hoping to launch a career in the luxury world, Charlie enrolls at the last finishing school in Switzerland. Over the course of a summer, women from around the world learn the codes of elegance, etiquette and conversation meant to prepare them for elite social circles. As they refine their gestures and manners, a world of aspiration, discipline and self-transformation gradually unfolds.

title: In All My Journeys I Am Returning
overview: Karl and Petronella, a young Swedish couple, sail in search of fortune. The river carries them through desolate lands in the aftermath of the war of independence.

title: Armony
overview: Armony, a 55-year-old solitary truck driver, finds himself taking responsibility for his six-year-old niece Carlotta after the disappearance of his sister. By his side are Pamela, an elderly transgender woman, and Jenny, a neighbor who is expecting a baby. When social services threaten to take the child away, Armony is forced to fight with all his strength to obtain legal guardianship.

title: Yellow Mirror
overview: A defective lamp reveals a heartbreaking truth about what Homer believes is reality, and an AI-powered tablet befriends and controls Maggie. The Simpsons struggle to find the light through two dark tales of the curious and bizarre.

title: Harila - Nådeløse fjell
overview: Kristin Harila and Tenjen Lama Sherpa, two underdogs from Vadsø and Nepal, climb the world's 14 highest mountains in record time. They make history – before encountering massive opposition.

title: Determination
overview: An avant-garde exploration of the themes of high-art vs. low-art conflict. The film begins with the bleak slideshow of Almaty architecture with the robotic french voice narrating something in the background. After that, the director begins to dance while the texts suggests its own analysis and theories. Finally, the film closes with a visual collage blending footage from indie web series, french new wave films, archival footage of Cannes, and personal footage of milk being microwaved.

title: Back to Tottori
overview: The film follows Billie and Vega, six years after the events of the first film. The family is falling apart. Their father is gone, their mother is exhausted and unavailable, and Vega has lost her footing. Billie longs for the strength she and her sister once found together, what they called their superpower. When Vega herself makes the choice to be hospitalized, Billie decides to take action. With her father's analog camera as her companion, she embarks on a journey that is both physical and emotional. Along the way, she encounters people and situations that challenge her, but also give her strength. She must trust herself, improvise, and deal with the unexpected.
trailerName: Tilbake til Tottori - Trailer - Premiere 18. september 2026

title: Growth of the Soil
overview: It is late autumn. Isak fights to survive in the wilderness. One day, Inger appears over the mountain. Out of a meeting in need, love grows. In merciless nature, Isak and Inger fight to create a life together. With love as their driving force, they build the farm Sellanraa from nothing. When a dark secret comes to the surface, love is put to the test.

title: This is not an Apple
overview: Palestinian brothers Yahya and Reda live in a neighbourhood in Oslo where their role models are often local gangsters. What begins as a seemingly insignificant argument within the gang ends in an attempted murder that leaves Yahya with life-threatening injuries. Against all odds, he survives. The brothers are faced with the choice of taking revenge or choosing forgiveness.

title: Stay
overview: After experiencing several nightmares in which his mother dies, Diego begins to question the truth of his reality. When he realizes that the nightmares are actually memories, Diego must decide whether to stay with his mother in this reality or return to the reality where she no longer exists.

title: EVERY LIFE
overview: A 15-year-old boy wakes up in a mysterious attic and meets an entity who tells him the horrifying truth about the universe.

title: Rusuban
overview: Follows one day in the life of Tokko as she stays at home in a large house while her family is away.

title: Beyond the Apex: Part III
overview: The final installment in the Mikal Springer saga, will he redeem himself in the world of motorsport?

title: Killer Clown
overview: Decades after witnessing her mother’s brutal murder at the hands of the “Killer Clown,” Elizabeth Helmer (Sara Paxton) remains haunted by the crime that shattered her childhood. When she begins investigating the long-unsolved cold case, Elizabeth becomes the target of a terrifying copycat stalker, forcing her to confront painful memories she has spent a lifetime trying to escape. As she searches for answers alongside her father Reed (David Cubitt) and husband Dan (Hamza Haq), Elizabeth uncovers a tangled web of family betrayal and long-buried secrets.  As she closes in on the truth, Elizabeth must separate fact from manipulation and fight to survive before history repeats itself.

title: Wrecked
overview: Three friends run a ghost-hunting livestream channel. In a quest for viral content, they perform a ritual to summon "Gong Goi," a cursed spirit from local legend. What starts as a fun stunt turns deadly when a tragic accident occurs, and they choose to cover it up. Haunted by guilt and hunted by the supernatural, the trio must face a terrifying truth — or become part of an endless nightmare.
trailerName: ກ່ອງກ່ອຍ กองกอย Wrecked TRAILER

title: Raajinaama
overview: A random Wednesday. A routine office Zoom call. A life forced to start over.

title: Phutaniganjer Mahesh
overview: Arunava Bagchi, a young government officer and thespian risks everything to cast a real bull, inspired by Sarat Chandra Chattopadhyay's Mahesh, proving true art demands uncompromising passion and sacrifice.

title: Skin of Foam
overview: On a quiet night in the biggest city of Southern China, a small-town migrant carwash worker encounters a strange customer who forces him into a decision that might change his life.

title: Sounds from home
overview: When filmmaker Nathan Silver and his wife Nicole Fuentes moved halfway around the world, Nathan’s parents took up birdwatching and began sending them audio recordings from their bird identifying app. It wasn’t so much the birds you can hear on the recordings but discussions about the birds, life in the United States, and aging as a couple. From their new home in France, Nathan and Nicole began pairing these recordings with footage of the birds and life around them.

title: Bump
overview: An expectant mother's world fractures as she obsesses over what her child's future might cost the planet - and what the planet might cost her child.
trailerName: BUMP | Short Film | Official Trailer HD

title: Bloom
overview: Leo, a shy young florist, knocks on the wrong door during a flower delivery and meets Noah, a charismatic dancer. As their unexpected romantic bond deepens, Leo embarks on a journey toward love, adulthood and self-acceptance.

title: NJPW Yuji Nagata Produce Blue Justice XIX ~Aogi Futotsu~
overview: Blue Justice XIX ~Aogi Futotsu~ was a professional wrestling event promoted by New Japan Pro Wrestling (NJPW) that took place on September 6, 2026 at Togane Arena in Togane, Chiba, Japan.
original_title: NJPW Yuji Nagata Produce Blue Justice XIX ~Aogi Futotsu~

title: Newlyweds
overview: After murdering his bride on the night of their wedding, a panicked groom races down a road to dispose of her body before dawn. But as the miles disappear beneath his tires, unsettling phone calls, impossible visions, and a growing presence in the backseat begin to blur the line between reality and nightmare. Trapped alone with his guilt, he soon discovers that some truths refuse to stay buried.

title: Ravel: Piano Concerto for the Left Hand Anna Vinnitskaya in Strasbourg
overview: The Strasbourg Philharmonic Orchestra, conducted by Aziz Shokhakimov invites Anna Vinnitskaya, who won first prize at the Queen Elisabeth Competition in 2007, to perform Maurice Ravel’s Piano Concerto for the Left Hand. Ravel composed this virtuoso jazz-influenced work for pianist Paul Wittgenstein, who had lost his right arm in the First World War. Part of europiano, ARTE's special day celebrating the piano concerto across Europe

title: Nine on the Line
overview: When a new player appears on the horizon, the old order in the pool club begins to fall apart and the real game is played far beyond the table.

title: Terminal
overview: Jorge, a man in his fifties, returns to his mother's house after more than thirty years traveling the world.

title: Chunks
overview: An anthology film of six unique comedy shorts threaded together with your host, faded Hollywood starlet Ruby, and taking inspiration from the glamourous by-gone era of late nite public access weirdness.  With live action shorts featuring originals from Podcast About List, Sandy Honig, Nate Fisher & Will Senett, and two animated segments from Episode 1 & Jim Soper, and Nick Mullen & Saul Crinier.

title: Christmas Uncorked
overview: A sophisticated sommelier returns to her small hometown for Christmas and must work with the local tavern chef to put on the best holiday feast the town has ever seen.

title: El Charro Negro
overview: In colonial Mexico, El Charro Negro, a supernatural being, born of tragedy, hunts a ruthless Spanish oppressor.  His retribution becomes a symbol of hope for those fighting to reclaim their land and identity.

title: Dead Soldier II
overview: Reese Cadler has moved to a country-side town after being attacked by The Soldier, a gas mask wearing killer  whom, unfathomably so, has managed to survived multiple gunshot wounds and evade police. One year later, he’s come back, and the war is not yet over.

title: 2:LOVE
overview: A major tennis tournament is about to begin, and the tension is palpable. On the court, two ball girls crouch on either side of the net. Each believes her moment has arrived. They want to be the best ball girls in the tournament's history. The ultimate ball girl championship.  But when the match begins and the girls look into each other's eyes, they are surprised to discover another force beyond the net: attraction. A dynamic that begins as bitter rivalry transforms into a magnetic passion, during which the girls search for a way to escape the competition that stands in the way of their love.

title: Left ın the Dark
overview: On a dark night, Uncle Sabi, an elderly motorcyclist, offers a ride to a young woman he encounters by chance. When she disappears at the end of the journey, leaving behind an abandoned baby, the situation blurs the boundaries between compassion and responsibility. And leads to an unexpected confrontation.

title: The Eater
overview: Douglas' profoundly normal life is thrown into chaos when something starts rearranging his furniture.

title: La Chandleur

While getting ready for a date, he discovers that a fox has attacked the ducks in the coop. Determined to protect the last surviving goose, Albert cancels his dinner and spends the night waiting for the animal. But he realizes that what he is hunting is not just a simple fox, but a far more terrifying entity: the Chandleur.

title: 14th

title: On the Fence
overview: Stretching more than 5,600 kilometres across the country, the Dingo Fence stands as a symbol of one of Australia’s longest-running and most complex debates. On one side, livelihoods depend on protecting livestock. On the other, a native apex predator plays a vital role in the health of our ecosystems. On The Fence is a feature documentary that brings together graziers, scientists, First Nations voices and conservationists to explore the people, landscapes and ideas at the heart of this conversation. Rather than asking who is right or wrong, On The Fence asks a different question: are we willing to coexist with apex predators and learn from the mistakes of our past?

As he struggles to find his path, his performance in the ring declines, dealing a heavy blow to his confidence. title: All God's Colors
overview: An intimate Danish documentary that takes viewers inside Copenhagen's Enghave Kirke, a parish affectionately known as the "Queer Church." The film follows the daily lives of Viggo Julsgaard Jensen, a gay pastor who overcame a deep personal conflict between his faith and his sexuality to preach that God's love is inherently inclusive, and Bo Hagen Clausen, the church warden who openly brings his vibrant drag queen persona, Ramona Macho, into the community's life. Together, they foster a radical sanctuary of unconditional acceptance, hosting unique events like a Children's Pride. However, their mission turns the church into a volatile ideological battlefield, as the film captures the raw tension, protests, and fierce resistance they face from conservative religious groups while fighting for LGBTQ+ visibility within an ancient religious institution.

While friends argue, parents worry, a psychologist tries to figure things out, and casual acquaintances eagerly offer unsolicited advice, the couple must decide whether love is worth the sacrifice of other people's opinions.

title: Our Share of Sand
overview: After years apart, 12 year-old Maya returns to India with her mother to reunite with her father - a sandmining business man. Immersed in a world where labour, legacy and extraction collide, she forms a fragile bond with Kiran, a young worker. After a tragic event, a police investigation turns Maya into a key witness, with her father relying on her to absolve him. Torn between loyalty and a growing unease she cannot name, Maya begins searching for the truth. As her mother quietly unravels, Maya uncovers a pattern of silence, exploitation and repeated harm forcing her to confront her father's deception and the family's complicity she must choose to break.

title: Meat Finders 2
overview: A man buys meat without knowing anything. The meat was very rare, drawing everyone's attention...

title: Folkloric
overview: Pequi is an awkward saci who believes he's unlucky for having been born with his left foot. To fix this, he sets off on a fun adventure through the Folclórica forest with his friend Teobaldo and the brave curupira Ingá. Along the way, they face challenges and encounter magical creatures from Brazilian folklore.

title: Les métamorphoses, au féminin
overview: A schoolteacher reads aloud excerpts from the most poignant scene of violence against women in Ovid's Metamorphoses. As the ancient verses echo through the classroom, her students begin to recognize beneath the poetry  - the myths reveal themselves to be an unsettling mirror of contemporary reality.

title: Del Sentimiento Trágico de la Muerte
original_title: Del Sentimiento Trágico de la Muerte

title: Obitus
overview: After a devastating flood, a mysterious parasitic outbreak engulfs a remote village. As Luna and her father, Damien, struggle to survive, they're forced to confront the brutality of nature and the darkest side of humanity. Filled with separation, loss, and horrifying truths, their journey changes their fate forever.

title: Preta - Eu Não Ando Só
overview: An intimate portrait of Preta Gil, crafted from never-before-seen footage and moving testimonials that reveal her strength in the face of life and illness.

title: America America 2
overview: America America 2 is an upcoming Kannada romantic entertainer film directed by Nagathihalli Chandrashekhar. The film stars Nirup Bhandari, Pruthvi Ambaar, and Shanvi Srivastava in the lead roles.
trailerName: AMERICA AMERICA 2  - Official Trailer | Niroop, Shanvi, Pruthvi | Nagathihalli Chandrashekhar | #aa2

title: Simon Boccanegra – Dutch National Opera and Ballet
overview: The former corsair Simon Boccanegra has risen to power in Genoa but carries the burden of personal loss and old rivalries. He is unexpectedly reunited with his long-lost daughter, and their renewed bond becomes entangled with conflicts involving noble families, love and revenge. Simon struggles to preserve peace in the city while protecting those closest to him. Can he overcome betrayal and reconcile the forces tearing his world apart before it is too late?
trailerName: TRAILER | SIMON BOCCANEGRA Verdi – Dutch National Opera and Ballet

title: Triple Decker
overview: Over the course of one bizarre day, a couple with a dangerous plan and a stranger with her own agenda find their lives colliding in the most unexpected ways. As secrets simmer beneath the surface, everything quickly spirals into a wild mix of chaos, dark humor, and perfectly timed misfortune—where every move only makes things worse.
trailerName: TRIPLE DECKER | Official Trailer | Feature Film (2026)

title: In Alaska
overview: After accidentally shooting at the TransAlaska Pipeline, Woody, a 17-year old Inuit, becomes the target of a terrorist manhunt. The chase through wilderness is led by veteran FBI agent Susan Tarheel, torn between doing her job and her empathy for the young man…

title: FAMILIAR
overview: A little girl and her mother look through an old photo album when a disturbing presence ruins the moment.

title: Wirbel
overview: A dilapidated house stands among the fields in the rolling landscape of the Czech Central Mountains. Its new and only inhabitant is Martin, who left the city to rediscover his lost sense of direction here. But when the mysterious Agnes appears on his doorstep, his secluded world begins to crumble. As the landscape resists and an ancient danger hidden in the soil comes to life, Martin must restore the lost memory of the place to save Agnes, the land, and himself.

title: Rebel Flowers
overview: A nun is forced to confront her own past and make a decision destined to change the course of her life forever. When her best friend asks her help, faith, guilt, and friendship collide.

title: Scavenged
overview: After the apocalypse, Bella becomes the target of rival survivor factions who believe she represents humanity's future. Protected by her father's best friend, Josh, she must survive betrayal, zombies, and war in a fight for hope.

title: Electric Meat
overview: A photographer spirals into madness when a murdered model he's adopted as his new muse decides she doesn't want to stay dead.
trailerName: Electric Meat - Official UK Trailer - Psychosexual horror coming to Frightfest 2026

title: Gaja's World 3
overview: GAJA'S WORLD 3 is a family action comedy that introduces us to 16-year-old Gaja and introduces us to her unusual family and the world she lives in. Gaja starts high school, meets new friends, experiences her first love, but nothing is as it seems. When her mother, who is leading Doctors Without Borders on a special mission in a war zone, is kidnapped, Gaja must show all her ingenuity and courage. In the end, she proves what really counts in life, because it is never too late to change for the better.

title: The Hollywood Blacklist: The Survivors Tell Their Stories
overview: Featuring previously unseen footage from an early-1980s Los Angeles party honouring the blacklistees. (Note: this is an expanded version of footage previously used in "La dernière fête des blacklistés", 2025)

title: Puca
overview: It is the early afternoon of a summer day in the 1990s. While their parents are asleep, Lotti and Malibù (nicknames the sisters use for each other) decide to sneak out to a local bar—a spot frequented by the boy they both have a crush on. Puca, the youngest, insists on coming along, threatening to wake their parents with her screaming if they refuse. The three girls set off; as they pass the beach, Puca wanders toward the water’s edge and claims to have seen a mermaid. Once at the bar, the older sisters—preoccupied with their adolescent moods—lose sight of Puca. A search ensues, leading to a confrontation that clears the air between them, followed by a fleeting glimpse of the mermaid diving and vanishing beneath the waves; that image makes them realize their childhood is gone forever. The unexpected happens when they return home to alert their parents…

title: House of Worship
overview: Blending timeless favorites with genre-spanning collaborations, this profound and moving celebration honors the unity, artistry, and enduring power of worship music — songs that have shaped believers across generations, now brought together for a landmark moment in worship music history.

title: Revolver
overview: Naples. In a frenetic techno club—a theater of desire, dominance, and survival—bodies collide beneath strobe lights. At the center of it all is Ronga, a trans go-go dancer who spins ceaselessly inside an iron cage; perched on stilettos, she feeds the crowd’s hunger. Orbiting her are Daniel, a photographer drawn to her raw beauty; Manuel, a toxic, predatory obsession; and Medusa, the club’s enigmatic queen who reigns from the highest platform, sporting two submachine guns embedded in her bra—her “Revolvers.” Amidst drinks, driving beats, and power games, Ronga fights for her dignity within the cruel hierarchy of her nocturnal world.

title: A Brief Encounter
overview: Kath, an Italian-Filipino woman, works remotely as a digital content moderator in Genoa. When she learns that a colleague in the Philippines has taken his own life—crushed by the very job that fills her own days (the endless cataloging of beheadings, torture, live-streamed suicides, and child abuse)—she initially takes two days off, then extends her break, no longer convinced she can bring herself to return to her terminal. A massage appointment introduces her to Jenny, a Filipino woman who tends to people's bodies as a side job. That scheduled hour evolves into something more—an encounter neither woman expected. Each carrying her own burdens and losses, they finally find a way, together, to stop being invisible. The screen, once capable only of wounding them, now reflects a new image: a redemptive possibility for healing.

title: The Newcomers
overview: Three tweens investigate what is poisoning their village's rivers. Mateo narrates as he, his brother Tomas, refugee Tiana, and her dog Nube embark on an adventure to uncover the source of pollution.

title: Take Care
overview: Women find themselves in a stage of life where loneliness blows them up like a balloon, tiredness lets them dance in the wind like a leaf, and they even lose control over their own bodies.

title: Gherking
overview: The dictator's shouts are broadcast over the radio to every corner of the country. A fire is flickering in the stove, and an old woman makes provisions for the approaching winter.

title: West/East
overview: We follow Russian inhabitants of Estonia as they travel to Russia. Their crossing of the border takes them through a geographical space marked by tensions between two ethnic groups, while the Russian-Ukrainian war reignites old fears.

title: Singularity
overview: 15,000 years before our era, during the Pleistocene, just before the great ice age, three saber-toothed tigers are born in a cave. One of them is markedly different from the others.

title: Zrugg
overview: After an attack on a farmer's livestock, an obsessive wildlife officer is sent out to hunt down and kill the problematic wolf.

title: The First Flower
overview: One intense day in the life of Siki as they navigate desire, violence, and transformation.

title: Typhoon Mambo
overview: Rusmee keeps interacting with Chalerm, her dead husband, in the form of an AI chatbot.

title: Morton Meet the Eye
overview: An amateur sleuth named Morton attempts to uncover the identity of a legendary detective known as “The Eye” during a chaotic and deadly Hollywood luncheon
trailerName: Morton Meets the Eye Official Teaser

title: It's Nice to Finally Meet You
overview: It's Nice to Finally Meet You follows Hannah, a woman who is feeling anxious about meeting the parents. She feels like a failure in every aspect of her life, but she desperately wants to be accepted by this new family. It takes every ounce of courage for her to get to the front door. When she finally does, a surprise is in store for everyone involved. This film is a story about resilience and the power of gifts.
original_title: It's Nice to Finally Meet You

title: The Pools
overview: A teenager who slips out of reality and becomes trapped in an endless, echoing aquatic labyrinth of swimming pools, towering waterslides, flooded corridors, and impossible architecture. While trying to navigate the mysterious waters, find a way out, and solve the space's sinister puzzles, the protagonist realizes they are being pursued by a malevolent entity.

title: Who Killed My Husband's Mistress?
overview: Megan's attempt to break free from her troubled marriage takes a deadly turn when she witnesses her husband's murder just days after his mistress was killed. As ominous threats start to close in, she soon realizes she could be the next target.

title: Premada Oorali
overview: Premada Oorali is a heartfelt love story set in picturesque villages in the 2020s. The film intertwines romance and family drama, exploring the relationships between a father and son, as well as a boy and girl, as they navigate through intriguing, yet relatable, relationship challenges.
trailerName: PREMADA OORALI - Official Title Teaser | Shree Raam | Rangayana Raghu | JRM Studio Exclusive

title: Yaar Jigree Kasooti Degree
overview: Five estranged college friends reunite years later when an invitation brings them back to campus. As they revive a forgotten youth festival, old bonds return, buried emotions resurface, and their shared past begins to shape their present.
trailerName: Yaar Jigree Kasooti Degree (The Film) | Official Trailer | In Cinemas on 7 August

title: Lion Heart
overview: Following her father's sudden passing, Xin, A young designer, returns to her roots to take over his struggling Lion Dance troupe.

title: The Egotist
overview: Poor and tired, Amaro finds himself in the need of moving. Along the way he takes part in conversations that make him reflect on his changing position in society and on the anxieties of a young adult.

title: Istimewa
overview: Five disabled children embark on a desperate search for their runaway foster father, only to find themselves thrust into the public eye.

title: Signal One
overview: Punk's path from West Berlin to Belgrade, Yugoslavia in 1977, seen through Igor or Iggy, as his new punk friend calls him.

title: LEGACY
overview: 🏆 Best Fantasy Short Film Award – Cinefantasy (Brazil)  STARRING: ANNABELLE LENGRONNE (Cannes Competition / Stockholm Best Actress for Léonor Serraille's "Mother and Son") & VINCENT COLOMBE (Coralie Fargeat's "Revenge").  Through a tense confrontation, "LEGACY" is a 7-minute satirical thriller using the codes of genre cinema to dissect class privilege and the enduring legacy of slavery.  Panicked and ragged, a man flees through the forest, hunted by an eighteenth-century aristocrat carrying a rifle. He is white. She is Black.

title: National Theatre at Home: London Road
overview: Autumn, 2006. The everyday life of the Suffolk town of Ipswich is shattered by the discovery of the bodies of five women. The occupant of No. 79 London Road is arrested, charged and finally convicted of the murders. Caught in the headlines and the invasion of their quiet road, the community grapples with what it means to be at the epicentre of the tragedy. Using their own words set to an innovative musical score, London Road is a moving story of ordinary people coming together during an extraordinary time. Director Rufus Norris, writer Alecky Blythe, and composer Adam Cork reunite for this highly anticipated return of the remarkable, award-winning verbatim musical.
trailerName: London Road Exclusive Clip | National Theatre at Home

overview: Brindhavihari is an upcoming Kannada romantic musical entertainer directed by Srinivas Raju.

overview: The Cameri Theater's adaptation of the widely famous Kubrick satire.

title: Colapso
overview: A 48 Hour Film Project short film by Miguel Partidário.

title: Ibu, Bagaimana Aku Tanpamu?
overview: A young girl who must come to terms with the fact that her mother doesn’t have much time left. Before her mother passes away, the girl tries to fulfill her mother’s wishes.
trailerName: MOTHER, HOW WILL I BE WITHOUT YOU? - Official Trailer | September 24 in Theaters

title: Hide
overview: In a remote town, a 14-year-old misfit teenager becomes manipulated by a mysterious, disfigured old man.

title: Under the Same Clouds
overview: On a quiet winter morning, Céline and Pierre, an elderly couple, go about their separate routines, never crossing paths. Their gestures speak of tenderness and a shared life. In the stillness of the snowy forest, they find each other once again.
trailerName: UNDER THE SAME CLOUDS Trailer | TIFF 2026

title: CHAT
overview: A family's fresh start unravels when their son discovers an AI powered tablet, unleashing a wave of terror tied not only to the supernatural but to dark secrets of greed and corruption that surround them.

title: Sebastian Wasserberg's Big Day
overview: A ginger boy called Sebastian Wasserberg navigated secondary school while dealing with ladies, friends, hard drugs, and crime. One faithful day, he somehow accidently time travels and accidently kills Hitler, leading to insane consequences.

title: Soulbreaker Sword
overview: At the end of the Song Dynasty, the martial world is filled with bloodshed, with everyone fighting for the peerless Soulbreaker Sword. A charming disciple of Emei flees with the sword and runs into Mo Huicong, a disciple of Qingcheng. The divine sword is stolen, and a mystery about their origins suddenly unfolds. It turns out that the sword's original owner is his father, and the head of Emei's beauty trap hides a blood feud for the whole clan. In a desperate battle at the martial arts conference, Mo combines with the sword to take revenge. Finally, to end the chaos, he abandons the divine weapon and roams the world with his beloved.

title: HappyDeal
overview: In the near future, a struggling single mother living out of her car with her young daughter sees a life-changing opportunity when a global online retail giant launches a hiring initiative for people in need. After an unexpected setback threatens her chances, she's offered an experimental alternative that could secure her future, but at a cost she never anticipated.

title: AAA Verano de Escándalo 2026 - Week 2
overview: Week 2 of AAA Verano de Escándalo from Aguascalientes features a AAA World Cruiserweight Championship match as Rey Fenix clashes against Mini Vikingo. Plus, La Parka, Mecha Wolf, and Lince Dorado battle for a spot at Triplemanía and the opportunity to challenge for the AAA Latin American Championship. Also, Galeno teams up with Hijo de Dr. Wagner Jr. to take on Drago and Dinámico.
cast: El Hijo de Dr. Wagner Jr.

title: Aurora Borealis
overview: Following two polar bear cubs born in captivity at Nyíregyháza Animal Park in Hungary.

title: Las damas
overview: Alba, an artist-in-residence at the Casa de Velázquez, struggles to find her place in the world and in her own body.

title: Hitler’s Games: Berlin 1936 in Colour
overview: In 1931, Germany was awarded the Olympic Games in the hope this would draw them into the international community and world peace would be promoted through sport.  For two weeks in August 1936 cameras captured the world’s greatest sporting spectacle, including the Gold Medal triumphs of record-breaking sprinter Jesse Owens. The Berlin Olympics were groundbreaking – many innovations introduced in 1936 such as television coverage and the torch relay became part of every subsequent Games.  Hitler’s Games in Colour tells the story of the remarkable amateurs who excelled, but also how Hitler used the Games as propaganda for his brutal regime, to show the Nazis as benign and their military ambitions as modest. Using black and white archive, transformed by cutting-edge restoration and colourisation, this is the story of 16 days that fooled the world…

title: I Have No Mouth, Yet I Must Scream
overview: The deceased Venezuelan awaits, uncertain of what comes next. According to the machines, the voyage to paradise starts soon. But in digital purgatory, bureaucracy and control continue.

title: The Living Tree
overview: On their honeymoon in a treehouse, Noah and Annabelle ignore a local’s warning. They’re soon pulled into a AI-run experiment by a tech giant. As the challenges escalate, secrets emerge—and survival becomes the only thing that matters.

title: Glorious Disaster
overview: Documentary on Laurel & Hardy by David Cairns and Fiona Watson

title: Together
overview: An exploration of human desires for land ownership and property through archival footage and social media.

title: Private Property
overview: Two outsiders – Maya, a Nepali immigrant working overnight to build a future, and Danny, an unhoused Black veteran searching for warmth and shelter – clash over one small space. Maya reaches for the law, then a gun, to belong.

title: Already Happened
overview: Hao Zhou confronts their younger self's compromised imagination, inviting the ghost of their youth to reconsider what lies ahead.

title: Camp Duval
overview: Welcome to Camp Duval, the wildest comedy camp ever created — where rising comics come to sharpen their jokes, survive the chaos, and hopefully make it through the night.

title: A Quiet Man
overview: A man journey's across an apocalyptic world to visit his wife's grave.

title: Masc
overview: Robin, a young autistic man desperate to fit in, tries on different roles to understand what kind of man he's supposed to be.

title: How to be a Billionaire with Xavier Niel
overview: Xavier Niel hosts a comedy show about his success.

title: The Hunted
overview: Three deadly stories of pursuit collide in this horror-thriller anthology: a concussed runner and her dog are stalked in the wilderness, a serial killer targets an abusive man, and bank robbers turn on one another over a priceless score.

title: Silenced Nights
overview: An ordinary worker witnesses the extrajudicial killing of a teenage boy by police officers. Inspired by real-life events during the Philippine anti-drug campaign, the film tracks the lone witness who risks his safety in an attempt to make the truth known.

title: Kinofagia
overview: In a bunker lost in the middle of a desolate field, two girls spend their days isolated from the world. Their only company is an old television and a collection of VHS tapes that they have turned into their own peculiar way of surviving.  Surrounded by films of war, violence, and death, they have built a routine that is as strange as it is seemingly normal. But as the tapes begin to run out, small cracks begin to appear in their relationship and in the reality that surrounds them.  *Kinofagia* is a story about people, isolation, and the human need to find something on the other side of a screen.

title: Agata the Writer
overview: Agata travels from Sydney to Sarajevo to write a war novel, but as she gathers material, she is challenged by locals who question her motives. Her creative uncertainty growing, she sees a startling mystery unfold: some provocative and obscene artworks inexplicably vanish. As Agata reads the first chapters of her new novel, it becomes clear that the story is not about the war itself, but about the quiet, very human moments of resilience that persist in its shadow. During her stay in Sarajevo, Agata has developed a deeper understanding of the act of storytelling and the profound responsibilities that come with being a storyteller.

title: Camouflage
overview: 2021. When 22-year-old Vitaly leaves his mother Tetyana and his beloved sister Eugenia behind in Ukraine, he dreams of starting a new life in Munich, Germany. Struggling to find where he belongs in a foreign country, he eventually joins a student theater group. Everything changes with Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine, as Eugenia and Tetyana are forced to flee. Overnight, two harsh realities land on Vitaly’s doorstep: the global political situation and his own family conflicts.

title: Carla Lonzi, A Feminist Story
overview: Alongside the public figure Carla Lonzi, considered to be so uncompromising, there is much to say about her private side, as fascinating as it was contradictory. There’s her tenderness and emotional fragility, her dependence on her partner, hence on a man; her complicated feelings about motherhood; and strained relationships with other women in the practice of collective harikiri called “consciousness-raising”. Drawing on invaluable, unreleased archive material, the filmmaker Francesca Archibugi, who was very close to Lonzi, brings her public life and private story, her ideas, and her legacy to the screen for the first time. These are key to understanding what women around the world are still going through and fighting for.
original_title: Carla Lonzi - Dentro e fuori dal mondo

title: The Phantom
overview: Two female producers are commissioned to create a short documentary for an exhibition dedicated to Rubén Santantonín, an elusive figure of the Argentine avant-garde who died very young, in the late 1960s. However, the client imposes one unexpected condition: the video must be made together with David Lamelas, Santantonín’s former collaborator and today an internationally recognized figure of conceptual art. At first, the plan seems clear and limited in scope: Lamelas, accompanied by a young film crew, gathers archival materials, documents the few surviving works, and interviews curators and major artists – such as Luis Felipe Noé and Marta Minujín – who, along with Santantonín and Lamelas, peopled the legendary scene at the Instituto Torcuato Di Tella. Lamelas gradually realizes that reconstructing the story of his friend also means confronting a series of gaps and contradictions.

title: Баба Яга на каникулах
overview: The sorceress goes on vacation to the village, where the family of Marya the Artisan is preparing to celebrate the birthday of the future sorceress Marusya. However, a carefree vacation quickly turns into a dangerous adventure: while residents are having fun at the holiday with songs and folk entertainment, the forces of evil are preparing a trap for Baba Yaga and the young heiress of a magical family.

title: The Craft
overview: Sauro Cantafame is “the techie”: he drives solo through a lunar southern landscape in his Ape Car, in a borderland between the real and the absurd. His mission? Implant mechanical hearts in deceased oldsters, so their families can pretend they’re still alive and cash their pension checks. He offers a ride to a fragile kid in danger, whose name says it all, as far as his prospects are concerned: Giocondo Infelice. But that gesture raises the hackles of Vito ‘a scimmia, the crime lord who has full control over the territory. Cantafame teaches the kid his strange trade in death, craft, and discontent; while Giocondo breaks out of his shell and finally finds the father he never had. But Cantafame has a few skeletons in his closet and a negative karma to fulfill, which will goad him to defy Vito in order to save his young charge.

title: Ground Floor
overview: Follows Kristóf, a man who discovers black mould covering his apartment wall and begins questioning neighbors about leaky pipes, triggering events that turn his world upside down.

title: North Melbourne Cheer Squad
overview: Members of the North Melbourne Football Club Cheer Squad prepare to face longstanding rivals Essendon: a club they haven’t beaten in a decade.

title: Mother, My Child
overview: On a night of reckoning, an immigrant teen confronts her mother’s fury—and finds a mirror of her own fragility

title: Magazine
overview: A young intern faces intoxicating power dynamics at a prestigious New York City literary magazine.

title: Отцовский клуб
overview: At the center of the story are five completely different men who meet in the waiting room of a maternity hospital on one of the most important days of their lives. While their wives are giving birth, future fathers have time to argue, quarrel, share personal fears and create their own “Fathers’ Club.”

title: Objection My Lord
overview: A father burns himself alive outside the Hyderabad High Court, demanding justice for his missing daughter, Sameera. When the system moves on and forgets, one question remains.Did Sameera ever exist? A forgotten lawyer, Parshuram, is forced out of self imposed exile to fight for the answer.

title: Disney Worldbuilders
overview: We sit down with some of the key figures shaping Disney’s most enduring stories for a series of intimate conversations about their early years, first sparks, and formative Disney memories — and how the worlds they once dreamed up are now taking shape at Disney destinations around the globe.

title: Afterglow
overview: When her mother begins to appear in fleeting daydreams, Danna must overcome her grief in order to find her way back to her sister Victoria.

title: Joyride Returns
overview: Rusty Nail returns 12 years later, to turn the desert road of the Arizona in blood, as a group of friends on vacation go to a small town near the mountains to explore them, as Rusty Nail with his black truck is near.

title: Noche de Entierro
overview: Overwhelmed by her mother and tired of her grandmother's wake, Noelia escapes to a party with her best friend in search of a break. But leaving the wake proves much harder than she imagined.

title: Come to Brasil
overview: Look in the comment section of any celebrity and you'll see one comment more than any other: “Come to Brasil.” In the west, the phrase is brushed off as a meme, but for Brazilian fans, it's a rallying cry, a plea that unites fandoms in a country that even the biggest stars pass over on their so-called "world" tours. Through the eyes of four Rio de Janeiro pop music superfans, the most popular comment on the internet is explored as a vessel to highlight the uniting forces of music and the resilience of music lovers.

title: Get afloat
overview: After becoming paraplegic, Lucas, a young competitive swimmer, isolates himself from the world, sinking into depression. His former coach, Raúl, refuses to abandon him and confronts him harshly. In this emotional turmoil, Lucas must decide whether to let his new reality overwhelm him or find the motivation to rise above it.

title: The Girls Garden
overview: Julia inherited her mother Asunta’s job as a domestic worker in the wealthy De la Puente household, where she was raised alongside the family’s daughters. Asunta, an Andean woman who migrated to Lima after Peru’s 1970 earthquake, carried a life shaped by displacement, silence, and sacrifice. Over the years, affection and inequality became inseparably intertwined within the household. Now, as illness and old age expose long-buried secrets, Julia is forced to confront the invisible social order that has defined her existence. Torn between loyalty and freedom, she must decide whether to remain in the role imposed on her or finally reclaim her own identity.

title: Deep in the Heart II: Texas Rivers
overview: Water, wildlife, and land conservation in Texas. Wildlife stories from each of Texas' major river basins, as well as diving into our state's successes and failures when it comes to managing water for both people as well as ecosystems.
original_title: Deep in the Heart II: Texas Rivers

title: Fuga
overview: Life has not been fulfilling to Mari.

title: The House
overview: For decades, Gabriel García Márquez envisioned a novel titled La Casa (The House), inspired by the home in Aracataca where he lived with his grandparents. Fragments emerged, but it was only after living in another house —in Mexico City— that he was able to develop the work that became Cien años de soledad (One Hundred Years of Solitude), his magnum opus. In this documentary directed by Eva Villaseñor, the writer’s sons, Rodrigo and Gonzalo García Barcha, return to their childhood home—a place where memory transforms time.

title: Secondhand Embarrassment
overview: When two young shoppers spot a vintage sweater at a thrift store a high stakes battle ensues.

title: Holiness
overview: In Sarapampa, preparations for the centenary of the Virgin of the Maize are marred by the visit of the Archbishop. His unfriendly attitude is generating growing discontent among the inhabitants, who remain united to protect the honor of their community.

title: Next Year
overview: Next Year is a haunting drama set in the not so distant dystopian future that unfolds in a fractured America where homosexuality is illegal and surveillance reigns. The story centers on Robert, a grieving father who is navigating life after the loss of his husband and the terrifying state of the country.

title: Sinking Road
overview: Dotty Duette gets pushed into the waters to drown by an unknown assailant, where she is then stuck on a magical golden road which drags her down to the underwater "Sinking Road Village". Once there, she meets the embodiments of the Buddhist precepts, some welcoming her and making her feel right at home until the road comes back down for her, and some, like the infamous 1st precept, being out for her blood.
trailerName: SINKING ROAD | Release Date Trailer [2D ANIMATED MOVIE]

title: Fortune House
overview: A desperate immigrant delivery driver stumbles into a mahjong parlor run by three demons, where he enters a demon’s deal: win the game, and they will grant him a green card.

title: We Are Born Good
overview: A dining mishap caused a rift between Ji and Rui, leading to a cycle of revenge. Their already troubled lives only came together to fall apart.
trailerName: WE ARE BORN GOOD Trailer | TIFF 2026

title: Salvation
overview: A tenacious aspiring guru must go to extreme measures to pay off the debts he’s accrued from trying, and failing, to set up an online life-coaching business in a post-industrial Scottish town.  Exploring the world of male influencer culture and how it might be affecting the young men who come into its orbit, SALVATION blends mounting tension, dark comedy and a forensic focus on its protagonist to explore the very modern story of a delusional life coach spiralling out of control.

title: The Fortunate Isles
overview: In the arid Canary Islands of the 15th century, Fátima is enslaved by a decadent marquis who controls the island’s only source of fresh water. The series is based on the book *Sommaren 1985* by John Ajvide Lindqvist, a master at blending Swedish realism with the supernatural. Behind the scenes, an intensive effort is underway to create the mermaid and make her look authentic.

overview: Teresa, a Catholic girl, is torn between the desire she thinks she feels for Maria, her long-time friend, and her faith, which she is no longer sure she has. As the seasons change and the vessel takes shape, director Luke Lorentzen immerses the viewer in a close-knit community rooted in time-honored craft, shared joys, and mutual respect.

title: Let Us Through, Dear Ancestors
overview: 1617, Las Islas Filipinas. The Spanish friar, Father Enciso, the encomendero of one of the islands, rules with unrelenting toughness and an insatiable libido to tame the savages.

title: On the Ropes
overview: Amine, a solitary teenager, reluctantly spends time at the local boxing gym. To escape these painful hours, he fixates on Rayan, a young boxer who stirs unfamiliar desires in him. At night, after school, Amine uses photos of his cousin Sihem to become “Amina” and secretly chat with Rayan on social media.

title: A Bit of Light
overview: After being arrested and having his medical practice shut down, an Iranian doctor loses faith in the future and resolves to end his life - but one final day among his family begins to unsettle his decision.

title: Still, Tijuana

When their relationship moves offline, they come face to face with the wounds inflicted by their respective exiles.

title: Gu Shi
overview: A family of four – Father, Mother, Daughter and Son – arrives at a mysterious house between the ocean and the forest, feeling an unnamed crisis. What begins as a temporary stay stretches into a strange limbo. After an accident leaves Son bedridden, the family turns to a ritual of telling stories about the ocean, stories that seem to make people forget. Haunted by recurring nightmares, Daughter begins to sense that her own missing childhood memories are tied to the house and to a girl in a green dress. As the past surfaces and the boundary between reality and story dissolves, she must choose her way of remembering.

title: Life of Jorge Luis Borges
overview: A biography of Jorge Luis Borges working from an exhaustive review of the papers he left, the books he read, the places he went to. And with this, an attempt to decipher a very peculiar life: someone who lived like a hidden, underground warrior, whose cause was literature, literature conceived as a kingdom and as a landscape. If Cold War spies fought from their desks or from an uninhabited house to defend their half of the world, Borges strove from a library to elevate and broaden the territories of his own tribe: the people for whom the most important part of the universe is books, plots and words. This film is devoted to that secret pilgrim (to borrow from Le Carré, the king of all spies).

title: Conversation with the Sea

But Wael drowned in the Red Sea decades ago. When no official record of his death can be found, Kamal follows the only remaining lead to uncover what happened to his son.

title: I Matter

When she is accepted into university to study acting, life finally seems to be opening up for her. But just as Rebeca begins to find her place in this new world, the life she comes from starts to catch up with her, forcing her to make choices she can no longer postpone.

title: Falling House

As the bulldozers draw ever closer, the tensions within the household start to rise.

title: Riviera 76, le Woodstock oublié
overview: This legendary event was meant to be “the French Woodstock.” Almost no one remembers it today, because nothing — absolutely nothing — went according to plan... But in 2020, this extraordinary story resurfaced with the discovery of 153 metal canisters hidden away in a cellar, containing an untold number of film reels. Unseen for decades, these reels preserve the memory of an incredible chapter in music history : three days of a music festival at the height of the summer of 1976. A 350-hectare open-air site at the Paul Ricard Circuit in Le Castellet. The American organizers behind the legendary Woodstock at the helm. Joe Cocker roaring on stage. An expected crowd of 100,000. A budget of $1 million. The Rolling Stones' mobile recording truck on site to capture the performances for a live album... And yet, in the end, it all collapsed into spectacular failure—against the backdrop of the Var region's criminal underworld.

title: Agua, ¿dónde vas?
overview: The video draws inspiration from the evocative imagery of Federico García Lorca’s *Agua, ¿dónde vas?*, in which water becomes a metaphor for existence. From the spring to the sea, it is a circular journey in which the beginning and the end merge. The sea flows back towards its source, symbolising the eternal cycle of life. It is a journey of transformation and discovery, reminding us that nothing truly disappears: everything changes form and continues to live on in the world.

title: Atopia
overview: The film explores the state of ‘atopia’ that afflicts Socrates in Plato’s *Symposium*. It is an aesthetic experience of stepping outside oneself, which the work conveys by depicting a musical improvisation by cellist Giovanni Sollima as he plays against a backdrop of abstract images created by directly manipulating 35mm film using acid etching, colour, scratches and abrasions. The secret relationship between the musician and his instrument is thus transposed onto the film medium, producing a synaesthetic perception.

title: Journey #11_0B19

title: Unknown Quantum Objects
overview: It is believed that additional dimensions beyond space-time may explain gravity and the unification of the fundamental forces. title: Stolen Birthday
overview: On his birthday, Ronnie, a lonely middle-aged man, sits in a small diner having dinner with his mother, Julie. For Ronnie, the moment feels warm and real. They talk, laugh, and share the kind of comfort that only comes from being with someone who knows you deeply. As the night continues, small details begin to feel off. The people around Ronnie react to him with confusion, and it slowly becomes clear that Julie is not actually sitting across from him. The birthday dinner exists only in Ronnie's mind. In reality, he is homeless, alone, and struggling with his mental health. When the illusion begins to fall apart, Ronnie is forced back into the world he has been trying to escape. What felt like a simple birthday dinner becomes a heartbreaking look at grief, loneliness, and the ways people create their own sense of comfort when reality becomes too painful.

title: Outskirts
overview: The documentary explores the outskirts of Palermo through the lens of photographer Francesco Faraci, whose work paints a portrait of the “out-of-focus cities”—areas that have long been marginalized, exploited, and rarely the recipients of adequate investment. This structural neglect has contributed to the entrenchment of conditions of decay, poverty, and a lack of opportunities, fostering the rise of power structures alternative to the state, foremost among them the mafia. Through the story of his own experiences in Sicily’s suburbs, the photographer reflects on possible strategies for regenerating these places, highlighting how they still represent spaces capable of preserving a human and relational authenticity that has progressively disappeared from urban centers.

AI-generated videos, drone footage, feature films, video games, and online fragments converge with the original radio broadcast, creating a layered and unstable field of perception.

title: Doctor in Duty
overview: A woman's health specialist is unwillingly required to be on full day and night duty aA woman's health specialist is unwillingly required to be on full day and night duty at hospital, a teenage girl asks the Dr for abortion to be performed for her. The film deals with the subject of abortion — a sensitive and universal issue. In many countries, restrictive laws cause deep harm to women or to children born into difficult circumstances. The film was completed three years ago, just one month before the “Woman, Life, Freedom” movement in Iran, during a time of strict regulations regarding women’s presence and dress. Post-production was paused for a year, and it was finally released in 2024. Through a blend of realism and surreal imagery, the film seeks to challenge social perceptions of women’s choices — whether to keep a child or to consider abortion If I wanted to make this film now under the current conditions, it would definitely have a different structure!

title: Wendy (Mao Remix)

Mao’s remix holds the voice back for almost two minutes while the arrangement circles and expands, projecting the original songwriting into a nocturnal and rarefied space.  Directed by Brussels-born, Montreal-based filmmaker Nicolas Fransolet and shot entirely in Tokyo, the film has no protagonist and no narrative. It follows the city through a single arc of hours, from daylight into night, moving inside the flow of streets, stations and suburbs. The images are observed rather than staged: what appears on screen is what happened in front of the lens.  What emerges is the portrait of a place at once distant and familiar, where the vast scale of the metropolis and the smallness of individual gestures inhabit the same frame. Proximity and connection almost never coincide.

At one point he owned 23 music venues including the iconic Fillmore West in San Francisco, The Electric Ballroom in Camden and Manhattan's City Centre Ballroom. title: Бэркэ

Recently, popular ethnobloggers have emerged here, sharing stories of Tungus culture with hundreds of thousands of followers online. Timofey Ivanovich is over sixty. He is a wolf hunter, and so he adopted the online pseudonym Berke (Evenk for "wolf"). Berke is an old-timer, a keeper of traditions, respected and called upon at crucial moments. Now such a moment has arrived: the wolves have returned. Hungry packs are crushing reindeer and moving toward the village. Berke ventures alone into the taiga to drive off the predators. In his real world, he has only a rifle and a video camera. And in his virtual world, there are millions of views and thousands of comments. This is the story of how a keeper of national myths saves his small people from the scourge of wolves, and ultimately becomes a new folk legend himself.

title: Flowers of the Earth

But for over a century, that mother has been fenced, burned, mined, and poisoned, her children pushed onto slivers of the territory that once held them all. The film listens to the elders who remember the forest before the farmers came, before the native were clear-cut and the living land was carved into square plots of a single endless crop.
