title: Deep Home Front
overview: Deep Home Front tells the story of the Kama region during the Great Patriotic War. Far from the front lines, people worked to the limits of their endurance, raised children, mourned loved ones, and believed that their labor was itself another front in the war. The film focuses on everyday life on the home front, where people sacrificed their health and, in some cases, were forced to live in circus arenas and orchestra pits. Teenage girls worked as blasters in the potash mines, laboratory assistants tested a typhus vaccine using methods unimaginable today, and more than 2000 housewives became record-breaking coal miners. These are only a few of the remarkable stories uncovered by the filmmakers. The screenplay is based on extensive research in state archives, departmental and municipal museums, and libraries. The production team also recorded dozens of interviews, while the film incorporates more than one hundred documented eyewitness accounts from the wartime years.

A youthful visionary (Smith) attempts to rally her peers against the suffocating boredom of a stagnant urban summer by introducing a grand collective vision: a neighborhood block party. He changed the people he met and transformed the space around him; he would stir things up and create a swell of energy—making the whole cauldron boil. Yet, often enough, he himself found himself powerless against that very tide. Making a film about such a man—avoiding the trap of turning him into a monument and ensuring the result was anything but banal—was a formidable challenge for the filmmakers. As winter ends, a new Sun rises, haunting our days, intensifying its glare, and consuming every creature that crawls upon the Earth. "The Spring Wound" captures Spring as the setting for a microcosm of desolation and progressive decay that I have explored with my camera. The pounding rhythm of the editing weaves single frames into a collage of open wounds, ghost trails, and natural phenomena, culminating in the arrival of Summer. Time flies in the blink of an eye, the infinitely small shifts its proportions, while what once seemed invisible and unfilmable is laid bare and captured by the impassive gaze of my lens. This is undoubtedly a diary film, the last of its kind, capable of gathering elements and images from my everyday life, then reassembling and transforming them into something truly singular.‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎

Tagging along are Halim, P's cousin and Amira, Nazim's Current Conquest. The night takes a dark turn when they dig up a time capsule they buried sometime ago. Tension begins to rise. unspoken betrayals, fractured trust, and painful memories resurface, as the night unleash a terror unseen and unknown. The morning after, Inspector Zul is dispatched to the island, and witnesses something he hasn't seen before. six dead bodies, a missing ana and a traumatised khatijah. He enters a nightmare more intimate than expected one which includes a ritual site. Khatijah helps Inspector Zul piece together their night of terror. As he sets his foot deeper into the island, he realises nothing is what it seems, and the truth might cost him his soul.

title: Even If It's a Film
overview: Abhijit Chowdhury's 2027 directorial feature.

title: Christmas Angels
overview: During the Christmas season, an unhoused single mother turns to love, play, and imagination to shield her young daughter from the hardship surrounding them, creating moments of wonder in a world that offers them little.

title: Strays
overview: Mati, a six-year-old girl, spends her last day with her foster siblings before being adopted. Guided by her protective older sister Valeria, the children sneak past the park fence and onto the train tracks, where they pass the time flattening pennies. But when Mati finds a dead cat, she insists on spending the day preparing a funeral for it.

title: Voices Inside Your Head
overview: Diverse individuals (a demolition expert, a visagist, a physicist, an Indigenous leader, and a Santo Daime priest) recount how psychedelics transformed their lives in unexpected and profound ways.

title: 1 in 2
overview: Nearly one in two of us will be diagnosed with cancer at some point in our lives. David Nicholas Wilkinson is one of them, twice over. 1 in 2 follows Wilkinson through his own treatment, where he discovers a steep rise in bowel cancer among people far too young to be screened for it, and far too young, it seems, to be believed.

title: Seven letters
overview: Set in the early 2000s in Argentina, Augusto lives alone and spends his time watching TV and calling random people on the phone asking for help with his crosswords. His world turns upside down and he falls into a swirl of paranoia when his sister starts calling to talk about their mother.

title: Keranda Tan Sri Terbang
overview: A man holding the title of Tan Sri who passes away. While his remains are being transported for burial, his coffin suddenly goes missing. This disappearance sparks a massive commotion involving his family, a shaman, an old rival, netizens, and the three men tasked with transporting the body.

title: Dream Girl
overview: Mikey tells Eve about the girl she loves, Eve tries to picture her.

title: Building
overview: Set during the construction of the World Trade Center in 1970s New York. After a co-worker starts spreading false rumors about him and the boss' daughter, an electrician retaliates with an escalating series of anonymous prank notes. The notes spread as gossip through the crew, sparking a psychological war of rumors and retaliation amid the daily grind of construction work.

title: The Closed Book
overview: An old woman, who lives alone in a large apartment in Copenhagen, dies in 1933. In her apartment hangs a painting of a young, red-haired, smiling woman.

title: Clémentine
overview: Mégane and Louise have known love—real love. Their story seemed straight out of a fairy tale. But how can two women love each other in a society like ours? How can you embrace who you are under the gaze of others? These are questions Mégane asks herself every day. Anxiety consumes her and drives her away from the one she loves.

title: Gebroken hart
overview: While her schoolfriends look forward to adulthood, eighteen-year-old Tasnim struggles with the consequences of her donor heart, which means hospital visits between exams, and sometimes having to scale back her dreams for the future.

title: Attention Seeker
overview: The Powers, a picturesque family. David Powers, a classic country singer with a comeback album on the horizon works away with his tools on the grounds of the estate. Janet Powers, the matriarch of the house toiling away in the kitchen preparing a feast for the family. Ben Powers, buried amongst the various computer windows of gameplay, text chats, and live streaming feeds. And Grace, dejected with a black eye starring into old pictures of days when she thought she was happy. One click is all it would take, it wouldn't undo any of what she's been through, and yeah it would probably make it all worse, she'd be attacked by everyone, the whole family would. A single click on the 'publish' button, and everything would come out, everything about her father, what it's like to live in this house. 'Why not' she thinks, 'I won't be here to see it, burn it all down'.

title: Ney Behind the Masks
overview: Follows Ney Matogrosso as he prepares for the parade of Imperatriz Leopoldinense, transforming Carnival into a space for exploring identity, freedom, and mortality. Amid rehearsals and significant encounters, the film reveals an intimate side of Ney as he revisits the choices that have shaped his journey, prompting reflection on the masks we wear throughout our lives and the courage it takes to remain true to who we are.

title: Captured
overview: A teen discovers a vintage camera filled with photos of her own escalating, deadly fate. She must find a way to fight the curse before time runs out.

title: FELDPOST 86292 - La breve guerra di un ragazzo qualsiasi
overview: The letters written by an 18-year-old sent to the front line recount his short life during the Second World War: an intimate portrait of an ordinary young man swept up by history.
original_title: FELDPOST 86292 - La breve guerra di un ragazzo qualsiasi

title: Once there was a statue of Lenin
overview: An Italian film crew travels through Moldova, amidst Soviet nostalgia, ghost states and suspended identities, discovering that the real journey lies not in a country, but in the people who live there.
original_title: C'era una statua di Lenin - Ritratto scomposto della Moldavia

title: Ciao ciao
overview: Roberto, aged 21, faces learning difficulties and family challenges as he seeks his place in the world. Every day, he cleans the streets of his neighbourhood, turning this task into a challenge of dignity and hope.

title: Encryption
overview: A conspiracy theorist Theo and his niece are looking for answers about Theo's abduction. Following a path of clues left by Theo prior to his memory loss leads them to a hideout of an underground organization nicknamed "Cryp-Tech".

title: Solo un luogo
overview: Across different cities and landscapes, people without a permanent home are redefining what it means to live. A journey exploring the search for identity among those who find their place in movement.

title: Io sono Felice
overview: Felice Andreasi, from the Derby Club to painting: the story of a one-of-a-kind talent, unconcerned with fame and devoted solely to his art.

title: Honeymoon
overview: Inside the beehive, everyday objects change shape to the rhythm of the bees. A visual exploration of time, matter and the invisible dialogue between humankind and nature.

title: Non succederà più
overview: In Quarticciolo, a Roman suburb neglected by the authorities, a collective is fighting to defend its neighbourhood. An intimate account of resistance, bonds and the choice to stay.

title: Quiet Spaces
overview: In the world of daily vlogs, life shared online becomes a space for listening and intimacy. A journey between creators and followers to discover emotional bonds that go beyond physical presence.

title: Il Pentimento
overview: A stolen masterpiece, a twenty-year investigation and an unexpected discovery: hidden beneath the Klimt painting lies another work of art. The incredible story of a mystery that has always been there.

title: L’estate dell’orsa maggiore
overview: In the heart of Abruzzo, a writer follows the tracks of two bear cubs and discovers a deep connection with nature, caught between the memory of a loss and the hope of a new life.

title: Perché tutto bruci
overview: In Naples, Mimì blends her private life with her activism as she follows the struggle of workers who have been made redundant. A journey into the suburbs, where daily resistance tests the limits of democracy.

title: Bòghes – The story of a Sardinian choir in New York
overview: From the heart of Sardinia to New York, the Paulicu Mossa Choir crosses the ocean to discover that song is the universal language capable of uniting distant worlds.
original_title: Bòghes – Storia di un coro sardo a New York

title: Lady Liberty: Secrets of an Icon
overview: This iconic statue was a gift from France to the new-born American Republic and was the first crowd-funded monument of all time. A symbol of emancipation and freedom, which took two decades to be completed. The film features original 3D virtual reconstitutions of Auguste Bartholdi’s Atelier in Paris and travels back in time to bring viewers at the heart of the Statue’s original construction, revealing the founding ideals of our democracies.
trailerName: Lady Liberty: Secrets of an Icon / Liberté : la statue qui voulait changer le monde (2026) -  [...]
original_title: Liberté, la statue qui voulait changer le monde

title: Not 8½
overview: Three film students are searching for ideas for their original documentaries. They sift through topics, argue, harbor doubts, and try to find a story that has never been told before. Will they manage to come up with something truly unique—and will they ultimately find their film?

title: Mouthwashing: Part One
overview: Mouthwashing is a game developed by Wrong Organ, about a five-person crew of the freighter, Tulpar, after Captain Curly intentionally crashes the ship into an asteroid, leaving him mutilated and sparking a tense, hallucinatory struggle for survival as co‑pilot Jimmy assumes command and the crew discovers their entire cargo is useless mouthwash. It is a dark psychological horror. This is a non-profit film.

title: The Shrinking Island
overview: Constantly covered and unveiled by the tide, the “Shrinking Island” is home only to hermit crabs - except for when human tourists try to leave their mark.

title: Parkers
overview: Every summer, nearly a million people pour into the Iowa State Fair. To get there, they have to pass through a different kind of attraction: a neighborhood of “parkers” who turn their yards into improvised parking lots, hustling twenty-dollar bills out of SUVs, pickups, and minivans.

title: The Debt
overview: A Mafia associate contemplates his choices and morals as he struggles with a terminal illness.

title: The Whistleblower
overview: Tim Kim threatens to leak the Tickle Gang's deepest darkest secrets.

title: Ice Bros
overview: Two witless fish delivery guys are forced to dispose of a body by local gangsters, but soon discover the old lady in the bodybag is very much alive.

title: Indigo Elsewhere
overview: At the edge of an unnamed city, two unemployed, directionless trans lesbians connect in a reality-shifting way.

title: Impure
overview: A dramedy about a woman whose wedding gets called off once her in-laws find out she’s not a virgin

title: Permafrost
overview: In a 1950s psychiatric hospital, Alexandre helplessly witnesses the decline of his younger brother Elias. Faced with a heart-wrenching choice to save him, he is plunged into a disturbing mental journey, where he discovers the full extent of his brother’s suffering.

title: Signal Lost
overview: National hero Mitch Gator, has to save lives from stopping the Freak-Meister with his bomb. But can he do that and make it back in time for his daughter's birthday party?

title: The Only One
overview: When her exes are suddenly being murdered one by one, suspicion falls on Zoe and it's up to her and a ragtag team of old friends to prove her innocence and figure out the identity of the masked Prince Charming killer.

title: Mitti De Putt
overview: Two villages are bound by a rivalry that has outlived the men who started it. For one young man, the feud stops being history the day his uncle murders his grandparents and carries his mother away. Left with nothing but the land beneath his feet and the promise he makes on it, he sets out to answer blood with blood. To bring his mother home, he must first confront the man who took her, and the price the soil demands is heavier than he knows.
trailerName: Mitti De Putt (Trailer) | Dev Kharoud, Sharan Kaur, Vikramjeet Virk AmarHundal,IqbalCheema,RMalkana

title: Her Diary
overview: Upon the death of his sister, Jack reads his sister's diary and finds out that she's around him all along.

title: You Know I Love You
overview: In Mexico City, during a visit to their patriarchal grandparents' house, rebellious seven-year-old Lucía and her siblings will stumble upon something that will change their lives forever: their grandfather's revolver.

title: Dear Awa
overview: Set in a peaceful Singpho village in Assam, Dear Awa follows Khongpha, a young girl with cerebral palsy, and her mother as they navigate grief after the loss of her father, an Indian Army officer. Supported by a compassionate teacher and their close-knit community, they slowly heal, until an unexpected figure from the mother's past threatens their newfound stability.

title: Bahasa Cinta Yang Beda
overview: The married life of Cinta and Rangga, where their relationship begins to feel stagnant due to routine and unrecognized differences in their love languages.
trailerName: OMG! Aaargh finally Cinta is married to Rangga! ❤️❤️❤️

title: Felt
overview: Eleven year old Ella must face her monsters when confronted with her older sister moving away.

title: PRIDEFALL
overview: Ben Goode, an arcade employee, gets a chance to win $20,000 in an air hockey tournament. But it won't be as easy as he thinks when Max Puck, an egotistical air hockey try-hard, signs up.

title: Email
overview: A man receives a spooky email. (scary)

title: Going Home Project: Ravel & Shostakovich in Cinema
Promise Street, 1988
overview: While working on the unfinished self-portrait of her bedridden mother, a young woman notices an unknown presence in her house.

title: Recording
overview: Doing as they are told by their parents, young girls swear in front of a top university that someday they will be admitted to it. Through a child’s perspective, home videos that presumably remain in the memories of mothers and fathers wishing for their children’s happiness are ironically transformed into an archive revealing the egotism of parents and the social structures that lie behind it. Stitched together out of home videos from the filmmaker’s own childhood, is this film a black comedy or a child’s small act of revenge?

title: Taratata - Hommage spécial à Catherine Ringer
original_title: Taratata - Hommage spécial à Catherine Ringer

title: Blue Flow
overview: A depiction of people living in the same riverside area in different eras: 1952, 1983, and 1995. Through long takes with horizontal movement, the scenery unfolds through time like a painted scroll, and the images of a fish and a girl jumping into the river connect memories across eras. Quotations from “The Orchid Pavillion Preface” also serve to subtly evoke the eternal flow of time and the transience of human life.

title: Today’s investigation
overview: In a bistro restaurant, a couple watches a neglected stranger and has fun imagining his life. What if he were a killer? A marginal with a shady past? The game is funny, complicit, almost harmless. But behind the smiles and speculation hides a much darker truth: they are not the ones watching a monster... These are the monsters we look at.

title: Creep Beneath the Earth
overview: Catfish, which were long ago thought to cause earthquakes, have also been seen as symbols of the hope of reconstruction. Through the political science of “disasters and reconstruction,” this voluble essay film evokes the feel of modern Japanese society imbued with both a sense of stagnation and a premonition of catastrophe. It shares its geographically and historically macro perspective that goes beyond the human scale with the filmmaker’s With Friction, As Friction, which was screened at the 2018 Image Forum Festival.

title: Tinu Ninu
overview: Being a graduate of Visual Communication Design and having worked on a graphic design project for a legislative candidate did not guarantee Nino a permanent job, even though he had graduated two years ago. His unstable employment caused Nino considerable anxiety, which made him give up on his intention to propose to Tina, his college friend, before returning to his hometown to take care of his family's fruit shop.

title: Resonance
overview: When archaeologist Clara Hartley discovers her family's century-old secret to manipulate time, she must confront her estranged past and an inter-dimensional threat to save her daughter's future and the fabric of reality itself.

title: Pehla Pyaar Doosri Baar
overview: Three friends attend their school reunion and enter into different relationships, discovering the trials, tribulations, allure, and absurdities of love.

title: O Menino Que Carregava Água na Peneira
original_title: O Menino Que Carregava Água na Peneira

title: Wet Paint: The Movie
overview: Watch paint dry, in HD. Nothing else happens.
trailerName: Wet Paint: The Movie: The Trailer

title: The Gesture Between Us
overview: Since founding the physical theatre company Dos à Deux, Artur and André have made the camera their constant companion, documenting their lives, their travels around the world, and their creative processes. Over 28 years of rehearsals and touring, the award-winning artistic couple has built an intimate archive in which art and love intertwine both on and off the stage. It is from this unique body of material that the documentary emerges.

title: Pequeño diccionario de gramática de las nubes
overview: Young participants in Escuela Dentro Cine make a collective visual alphabet, using self-filming and the image of clouds to explore freedom, rebellion and their own ways of seeing.
original_title: Pequeño diccionario de gramática de las nubes

title: Sometimes all you need is a red sky
overview: A child book’s illustrator goes all the way to South Korea to finish up his next project. However inside every spring-warm street the only thing that comes up to his mind is the girl with whom he thinks shares the same sky.
original_title: A veces sólo necesitas ver un cielo rojo

title: Flight
overview: A documentary by Farhad Khodadadzade, Vlucht follows Noisia and their manager Walter as they set out to explore new possibilities for the future following the start of their farewell tour in 2020, while pursuing their shared interest in birdwatching.

title: Kashpirovsky. Under the Spell
overview: The film tells the remarkable story of Dr Anatoly Kashpirovsky, who, at the height of his career, claimed to anaesthetise three women remotely for major surgery through the sheer force of his persuasion. His televised healing séances, broadcast across the Soviet bloc, broke viewing records, reaching hundreds of millions of people. Loved by his followers and despised by his enemies, Kashpirovsky became an unlikely symbol of a world undergoing radical political transformation.

title: Un jour après l'autre
overview: An experimental feature by Yoan Wilisky.

title: The Ambitious
overview: The year is 2023, and elections are nearing in Goma, a Congolese city of one million people situated near the border with genocide-ravaged Rwanda. It is a region rich in valuable natural resources, where bloody conflicts over ethnic and economic issues have been raging for three decades, devastating eastern Congo. Two members of the La Lucha civil society movement decide to abandon activism in favour of a career in politics. Espoir, a young activist, stands as a candidate for the National Assembly on behalf of the opposition. Sankara who, confined to a wheelchair, has become a symbol of resistance, joins the outgoing president’s coalition. When rebel troops from the M23 group enter Goma, their dreams of democracy are thrown into doubt.

title: Lessons in Stagnance
overview: Over the course of one stagnant day in a small town, two directionless, codependent dorks stumble through friendship, insecurity, and love while doing everything they can to avoid growing up.

title: The Child
overview: Thirty-seven-year-old Zane and Kaspars seem to have it all – love, careers, a home, and shared hobbies. Still, for a decade, they have been unable to have a child. After trying fertility clinics, diets, churches, and healers, Kaspars is slowly coming to terms with the idea that life can be fulfilling even without children. Meanwhile, Zane cannot accept the thought of not becoming a mother and is ready to go to any lengths to make it happen.

title: Confession
overview: In 1938, in Stalin's Moscow, a disillusioned professor, Alexei, faces brutal interrogation by his former student, Vladimir, in Lubyanka Prison. Refusing to confess, he confronts his past sins and finds redemption through faith, sacrificing himself to save others in a haunting tale of morality and resistance.

title: Thread Bound
overview: When a skeptical teen meets a mysterious boy with a healing gift, they begin a journey to unravel the painful threads of their past, and discover that something greater may be connecting it all.

title: Solo Vivo
overview: A profound narrative about the history, resistance, and social impact of the Ecological Farmers Market (FAE) of Porto Alegre, RS. A sensitive look at the dignity of rural work, resilience in the face of climate extremes, and the strength of a community united by respect for the land to nurture human relationships and promote health through healthy eating.

title: 'Tis the Season for Setups
overview: Hyper organized single mom and party planner Lexi, her free-spirited mother June, and teen daughter Piper are set to spend Christmas at a local ski resort after Lexi is hired to organize their annual holiday party. Upon arrival, she immediately butts heads with Ridge, the ski instructor and son of the lodge's owner, Dan.

title: Papagayo
overview: A month after the Hamas attack and Israel's bloody retaliation, which marks the beginning of the genocide of Palestinians in Gaza, an Israeli illustrator living in Spain breaks up with her long-term partner, a Spanish filmmaker of Syrian origin. Omar decides to continue working on the film they had been making together, using footage shot in the Middle East and the unfinished drawings left behind by his beloved. A story about religious fanaticism and its absurdities, and a painful dissection of the relationship between two people who wanted to be together despite their cultural differences.

title: Little Pieces
overview: Alice returns to her estranged aunt's home to collect family photographs after her death. This simple errand unearths a buried family secret, pieced together from fragmented visions and stilted conversations with her mother. Reeling from the discovery, Alice reflects on what we inherit from our families and what we release.

title: Little Wing
overview: Little Wing is an intimate short film exploring grief, longing, and the ways loss is carried in the body. It is a journey into grief, miscarriage, and the connection you have with your child, and yourself, in the aftermath of this.

title: Inah
overview: Inah lives a solitary life with her cat, Frida. Trapped in a process of grief, she retreats into her paintings. When Daniela, Inah’s granddaughter, comes to visit, she begins to notice some unusual behaviors. Amid moments of affection, joy, and forgetfulness, Dani realizes that Frida represents more of an escape than a refuge for her grandmother.

title: Happy Journey
overview: A group of seven women across generations set off on a spontaneous European getaway, leaving their everyday lives behind. Amid the chaos, laughter and picturesque landscapes, the journey becomes an unexpected celebration of freedom and friendship.
trailerName: Happy Journey - Trailer | Shekar Chandra | Annapurna, Aamani, Jhansi, Vamsi

title: Ashes Again!
overview: Tabby and her dad are having their photograph taken, but Tabby refuses to smile: Dad doesn't even keep them - just sends them to her mum (wherever the hell she is).

title: Devout
overview: A young nun declares that she has been chosen by God, but finds in her sainthood she awakens a much darker presence within her convent.

title: Your Loss
overview: An AI Funeral Director offers advice and inspiration to the bereaved.

title: Transference
overview: A hypnotherapy session with Heather, a traumatized woman, and Dr. Elizabeth Russell takes a strange  turn as Heather’s memories appear to be connected to Russell. Using a VHS camcorder as a conduit, Russell digs through Heather’s nightmarish memory fragments to piece together answers about her own troubling past.

title: Kill. Bury. Print.
overview: When the McCurtain Gazette, a small family-run newspaper, begins reporting on alleged sex, drugs, and violence within the county sheriff's office, they find themselves the target of the sheriff's retaliation. Tensions escalate when the paper obtains a secret recording revealing the sheriff and local officials allegedly discussing having the family killed, turning a local investigation into international news.

title: Reflejos de mi País
overview: In this new Christmas special from Banco Popular—marking 34 years of history—the aim is to highlight Puerto Rico's natural wealth, flora, fauna, and cultural diversity.

title: Sidelined
overview: A couple hosts a dinner to celebrate their recent engagement. But the inclusion of a distant sibling and their partner resurfaces family grievances and proves that some things are harder to share than a last name…

title: Moon Cycle
overview: A rarely told queer love story from Indian mythology on Ila and Sudyumna, a being whose identity shifts with the phases of the moon.

title: Ana the Cleaner
overview: Ana spends her days cleaning the homes of Chicago's elite while feeding an obsession with true crime. When one of her clients suddenly disappears, Ana becomes convinced she's uncovered the perfect murder.

title: 4 Out
original_title: 4アウト ─もう一度、プレイボール─

title: FKA twigs: Live at the Adidas Arena, Paris
overview: As part of her "Body High" tour - FKA twigs brings her visionary spectacle to Paris for a genre-defying show. The performance served as a culmination of all that the artist has represented to culture over the last decade. It highlighted her mastery of WuShu, opera, visual arts, vogueing, pole-dancing, and her professional background in dance, while she performed songs from her GRAMMY-award-winning album 'EUSEXUA' and her lauded discography. A towering figure in modern music, FKA twigs is celebrated for her unique perspective and her total art approach – where sound, visuals, and performance merge into a single, immersive experience. The performance unfolds within a breathtaking scenography: video projections, theatrical vignettes, and choreography, all of which have earned praise from numerous publications, including The Guardian, which has described the tour as "an Olympian display of pop prowess.
original_title: FKA twigs: Live at the Adidas Arena, Paris

title: Contame otra vez
overview: Inside a vintage train-car café, a grandfather shares his past while his grandson scrolls the present away.

title: Snow Globe Town
overview: Emily Church joins her sister Zoe and Zoe’s longtime boyfriend on a Christmas getaway to Pine Grove, a town famous for its romantic holiday traditions. While helping with Zoe’s proposal plans, Emily is paired with skeptical journalist Bert Baxter. As they are drawn into the town’s festive celebrations, unexpected feelings begin to challenge what they both thought they knew about love, family and Christmas.

title: Return to Santa
overview: Decades after a childhood letter to Santa goes unanswered, Jake has grown into a practical adult who no longer believes in Christmas magic. When Santa finally discovers the lost letter and begins granting Jake’s long-forgotten wishes, his orderly life is thrown into chaos. With his childhood best friend Julie unexpectedly back in town, the two work together to manage each new wish while growing closer along the way.

title: Nawmai: The Wancho Warrior
overview: Bitter enemies Rankho and Longmei clash when Prince Wangthak falls for Princess Sencha, unaware that her tyrannical uncle Liwang seized her throne. When Liwang captures Sencha and demands lost lands, a devastating war ignites between the villages.

title: Termination Point
overview: An alcoholic finds herself stuck in limbo after sleeping past her stop home on the bus.

title: Where’s Godot?
overview: “Where’s Godot” is a critique adapted from Samuel Beckett’s play “Waiting for Godot”. The short film portrays the reality of the Brazilian Northeast countryside, along with the wait for a new dawn.

title: Gasmask
overview: Fifteen years after the fall of civilization, the last remnants of humanity are left to survive in a world without electricity. When a solar-powered generator opens up new frontiers for discovery, our narrator starts recording his memories using an old phone, and a group of artists — a musician, a storyteller, and a dancer — utilize the electricity to bring their creative impulses to life. Suddenly, members of a generation shaped by the apocalypse are able to scavenge through old smartphones like relics of a vanished civilization, discovering pictures of cats and fragments of forgotten music from a world they never knew.

title: Lippenstift
overview: Tomorrow is the funeral of Benedicte’s stepfather. She is 43, a psychologist, and a mother. She has to deal with her children’s anxieties about what to wear, see her patients before leaving, prepare sandwiches for the trip, and put up with her husband’s sarcasm. So far, she’s holding it together.

title: The Millennial Trap
overview: A millennial is forced to choose between work or her mother's birthday brunch.

title: Hippomancy
overview: A horse and man come to an understanding.

title: Save the Date for Christmas
overview: Susie has checked out on dating while Alec is a hopeless romantic, and these longtime friends have both struck out in the love department after failing to meet the right man. After being each other's plus-one to what feels like the twentieth wedding this year, they vow to take a break from attending weddings and looking for their respective prince charming. That break doesn't last long. The next day, Susie's sister announces a last-minute Christmas wedding... and Susie convinces Alec to tag along. The objective for the week? Survive as the two lone single people and avoid family matchmaking. Over time, the Christmas wedding duties and time with family during the holidays force these two best friends to forge a new appreciation for love and marriage. Susie finds herself turning over a new leaf in pursuing romance while Alec discovers love can walk into your life when you least expect it.

title: Barking All the Way
overview: Billie (Anderson) is a workaholic realtor who heads home for Christmas but her journey is derailed after a loveable but chaotic canine named Yappy almost causes her car to crash. After talking to Yappy's owner, the mysterious yet oddly familiar Mrs. C, Billie agrees to watch Yappy while she visits her grandchildren for the holidays. Yappy ends up playing the role of matchmaker and new best friend, pulling Billie towards her traveling contractor ex-boyfriend from high school, Hutch (Harding). Eager to move on, she's determined to leave Hutch in the past, but when her mother hires him to work on their shed, she finds herself spending more time with him than she ever expected. As the holidays draw closer, Billie begins to question whether chasing her dream of becoming her firm's number one seller is truly what she wants. When the mysterious Mrs. C leaves her cabin for Billie and Hutch to breathe new life into, her answer may come sooner than expected.

title: Hearts All Aglow
overview: Mari is a fiercely intelligent music historian who manages to get an invite to the annual Christmas gala for the local music museum and has one goal: secure an interview with Tasha the legendary Grammy award-winning singer, record producer, and museum’s founder. Mari has to summon the courage to ask the mogul who rarely does interviews these days for this favor, which proves more difficult than anticipated. Also crashing the gala is Julian, a polished and perpetually busy New York attorney on a mission of his own: his late mother received the autograph of Nat King Cole on a piece of sheet music when she was a young girl and he regrettably donated this treasured piece of family history to the DuPree Museum while emotionally numb in the aftermath of his mother’s death. Now his sister tells him she wants to give the framed sheet music to her daughter/his niece, who inherited her grandmother’s musical talent, for Christmas, and Julian is determined to bring it back home.

title: Noelle Nomads
overview: Before they can embark on their luxurious Hawaiian holiday, uptight sports medicine physician Joseph and his daughter Annie must first begrudgingly make a pit stop at a remote campground and deliver a package from his late father to a mysterious person named Birdie. Their plans are derailed when Joseph accidentally crashes into free-spirited Nora's RV at a rest stop. Things go from bad to worse when they not only fail to find the elusive Birdie, but their ancient Winnebago breaks down as well. Forced to spend the next few days at the campground while they wait for replacement parts, Nora introduces Joseph and Annie to the eccentric campers who lovingly dub themselves the Nomads. The embers of romance begin to glow as Nora shows Joseph how to embrace the freedom of camp life. When the mystery of who Birdie is becomes clearer and the much-awaited parts arrive, allowing Joseph and Annie to finally make their Hawaiian getaway,

title: An Angel in My Stocking
overview: Three years after a disastrous marriage, Amanda unexpectedly gets stranded with her ex-husband Jack in a remote Vermont town, where a mysterious traveler claiming to be her guardian angel pushes them to confront their past.

title: The Snowflake Effect
overview: When driven corporate attorney Tanya rushes into a charming gift shop searching for a last-minute White Elephant gift, she crosses paths with Jason, a handsome, laid-back clerk. Their brief encounter leads Tanya to purchase a beautiful antique glass snowflake which, unbeknownst to her or Jason, is a good luck charm that carries a generations-old Christmas tradition. However, since the ornament is entered into a holiday gift exchange rather than gifted with proper intention, Tanya suddenly finds herself on the receiving end of everyone else's misfortune. After Jason's Aunt Coco explains the snowflake's magical lore, Tanya reluctantly teams up with Jason to track down the snowflake as it makes its way from one recipient to the next across Chicago before Christmas Day or she'll be stuck with bad luck until next Christmas.

title: Miles to Christmas
overview: When an early snowstorm sweeps through the Midwest, punctual, straight-laced "suit" Cassidy Fields is forced to hitch a ride with free spirited, music loving Johanna "Jo" Woods in her bother Chase's 18-wheeler to the nearest airport to catch another flight. However, when Jo's flight successfully takes off and Cassidy's is cancelled again at the last minute, she joins Chase on the road back to Tennessee from Chicago to make it home in time to spend Christmas with her father. Quickly, Cassidy and Chase's connection begins to spark. Through losing the car keys, stopping to partake in a Mrs. Claus parade and a surprise run-in with Jo, whose plane got grounded mid-flight due to weather, Cassidy builds bonds with both siblings as they all challenge one another's life philosophies. As the trio pushes past every obstacle, they work to embrace their differences and find that the fastest way home is when they lean on one another for help.

title: Auditions
overview: A film school is holding an aptitude exam for its directing program. Güney, the last candidate of the day, is called into the room. What begins as an ordinary student interview gradually spirals out of control when his ex-girlfriend arrives. As the jury’s familiar questions give way to personal reckonings, the examination room becomes a courtroom where it is no longer clear who is judging whom.

title: Eight Nights for Love
overview: Hannah, who works for a large auction house in New York City, is excited for her best friend Ethan to return home for a visit during Hanukkah and is looking forward to some time off from work That plan is short-lived when Ethan shares the news that he's convinced the daughter of his wealthy boss to use Hannah's auction house to sell their family's collection of Judaica with the condition that Hannah handles the sale. Complicating her holiday further, she meets the mysterious Pearl, who gifts her with an antique menorah that is anything but ordinary as it takes her back to a different times of her life each night of Hanukkah, with Pearl as her guide. This front row seat to past moments leads Hannah to reflect, break out of her comfort zone and overcome her fear of failure. Thanks to her trips through the past, and as she and Ethan spend time together in the present, Hannah realizes she has feelings for him she never acknowledged.

title: There Is a Me
overview: At six years old, Amy was torn from everything familiar and thrust into a system marked by instability, abuse, and neglect. Her childhood unfolded through foster care, sexual trauma, and addiction, leaving her wounded and angry long before she reached adulthood. At seventeen, her life fractured again when her mother was murdered. Grief-stricken and untethered, Amy fled to the streets of Nashville, where survival quickly gave way to exploitation and crack addiction. Over the next three years, she endured violence, repeated arrests, and profound isolation. In the darkest moments of her life, on the very streets that nearly destroyed her, Amy encountered God.

title: The Most Wonderful Secret
overview: Every Christmas, a small town honors the memory of a beloved teacher — who once spread joy through her "Secret Norma" gifts — by creating a whimsical and heartfelt scavenger hunt for one worthy recipient. When burned-out art teacher Vanessa visits her widowed brother and niece Esther for the holidays, she is surprised to be chosen as the next "Secret Norma" recipient. Hoping to bring Esther some Christmas magic, Vanessa decides to help revive the town's holiday block party. Her handsome electrician neighbor Spencer offers help with the preparations if Vanessa will help him sell his mother Norma's house. As Vanessa solves the riddles of "Secret Norma" and plans the block party, her passion for teaching art begins to spark along with her feelings for the charming electrician next door.

title: The Christmas Eve Feast
overview: Silvana "Silvy" Gianetti is disillusioned with her job as the executive chef at a swanky restaurant in New York. Growing up in a large and loving Italian-American family, Silvy is drawn to the food and comfort of her home. When her beloved Nonna suffers a minor wrist injury, Silvy is called back home to Boston's Italian North End to prepare the family's beloved "Feast of the Seven Fishes" Christmas Eve dinner. As she preps for the big feast, her family is joined by Ethan , a photographer who is documenting different family traditions around town and who's become close to her Nonna. After a rocky start with Ethan, things begin to heat up as Silvy grows to appreciate the heart and soul he puts into capturing the magic of the little moments and a romance could be simmering. Every day leading up to Christmas Eve, Silvy gathers in the kitchen with her Nonna, mom and aunt to prepare the pasta, struffoli and other Italian classics near and dear to Silvy's heart.

title: Christmas Delivered
overview: Determined to unwind from the stresses and loneliness of her everyday life, Kimberly Carr travels to Canada to spend Christmas with her grandmother, JoJo, at her beautiful, cozy farmhouse. Kimberly's plans for a restorative holiday are turned upside down when she crosses paths with Ben Chambers, owner of a local tree farm and new Christmas tree delivery app called TreeBen. Ben's a dreamer who never looks before he leaps while Kimberly is methodical and lives her life based on practicality. But when Ben's app is plagued by an onslaught of issues, Kimberly uses her tech expertise to help him out and ensure that no one in town is deprived of a Christmas tree... even though she isn't convinced of the need for the app in such a small town. Kimberly and Ben discover they may have more in common than they realized. In the process, Kimberly begins to question if she's truly happy with her life or if she's ready for a change and ready for romance.

title: Cold Call
overview: In the winter of 2023, the Media is buzz with the kidnapping case of a 13-year-old boy. The Investigators find that a group of 4 Market Research Executive (MRE) are prime suspects.
trailerName: Cold Call - Official Trailer | Siddu Moolimani | Santhosh S A |Pranav Giridharan|Thambidurai Ethuraj

title: Double Booked for the Holidays
overview: The one thing identical twins — quiet and bookish Abigail and globe-trotting event planner Charlie — can agree on is that this first Christmas without their mom will be difficult. When they unexpectedly get a last-minute chance to travel to Wales and spend a week running the Story Shoppe, an AirBnb/bookshop in Hay-on-Wye, they jump at the opportunity. Abigail is particularly excited, given the town’s role as the backdrop of the bestselling Winterton Chronicles, her all-time favorite Regency holiday romances.

title: Christmas in Blue Dog Valley
overview: On-set veterinarian Goldie MacKenzie (Cahill) leaves the glamour of Hollywood behind to buy a family-run veterinary clinic in tight-knit Blue Dog Valley, arriving just in time for the town's cherished Christmas season. When Dr. Gable, the clinic's longtime owner, unexpectedly ends up out of town, Goldie is hosted by his handsome son Cohen (Walker), the black sheep of the family because he decided to forego their expectation of becoming a vet. Cohen and Goldie get off on the wrong foot, but when the folks of Blue Dog Valley cold shoulder "the newcomer," Cohen teams up with Goldie to win over even the frostiest of community members. Goldie is also aided by the mysterious canine she dubs Blue whose spontaneous appearances always seem to guide Goldie to exactly where she needs to be. As Goldie works hard to prove herself to the townspeople when furry and Christmas crises arise, she finds herself pulled towards the very heart of her new-found home... and a certain black sheep.

title: Our Holiday Playbook
overview: When Lexi Bell returns home for the holidays, she faces a beloved family tradition she'd rather avoid: the fiercely competitive Bell Bowl, an annual Christmas flag football showdown between her father and uncle that has fueled decades of sibling rivalry. But when an injury sidelines her brother-in-law, it looks like Lexi's family's losing streak will remain unbroken. To give them a fighting chance, she strikes a deal with Eddie, a former local football star-turned teacher: Lexi will use her baking know-how to help Eddie best his brother in their annual bake-off if he'll pose as her boyfriend and meet the "eligibility requirement" to play on their team. As they navigate each other's festive family gatherings, traditions and celebrations, what started as a transactional partnership begins to become something more as Lexi and Eddie find themselves feeling less and less like their romantic relationship is just pretend.

title: Mistletoe and Mimosas
overview: Claire Bennett is a successful business consultant in Manhattan who unexpectedly inherits her beloved Uncle Lou's Christmas-themed bar, The Tipsy Reindeer, in upstate New York. When she returns, Claire discovers the bar comes with high debt – her Uncle Lou was overly generous to people in town while the booming business of Algorithm, an upscale and trendy new club, added insult to injury. She intends to turn things around before Christmas and sell to someone who will preserve her uncle's legacy and then return to her life in the city. Claire meets Zach, Algorithm's part owner and manager, who tells her they want to buy The Tipsy Reindeer so they can expand. Claire bristles at the proposition and they agree to face off in a 12 Days of Christmas-inspired series of festive events to see who can bring in the most business. If Claire wins, Zach will use his contacts to find the right buyer, but if Zach emerges victorious, Claire agrees to consider Algorithm's offer.

title: The Nights Before Christmas
overview: One Christmas Eve, Marty (Hynes), whose life is in a bit of a rut, finds himself wishing he had more time. Thanks to some holiday magic, he awakes the next morning to discover it's Christmas Eve – again. Confused at first, Marty learns to embrace his new normal and begins to truly appreciate the sights, sounds and people of New York City that previously went unnoticed. With this gift of time, he expands his world by learning how to play a new instrument, picking up new languages and reading...every single book. But when Marty meets Chloe (Mailey), a newly out-of-work journalist having a tough day, he falls hard for her. The only problem is that when the morning of December 24 comes once again, she doesn't know who he is. As the Christmas Eves continue to repeat themselves, Marty makes it his mission to win her over and, in the process, figure out what he needs to do to finally make his way to Christmas Day — hopefully with Chloe by his side.

title: My Christmas Cowboy
overview: Meg set aside her newscaster aspirations after a disastrous audition experience in college and has been happy as a news producer in her small town of Fern, Texas. Billy Kane, her former college crush and audition partner, is a well-known celebrity host in Hollywood on the brink of losing his career after an on-camera gaffe. At the advice of his publicist, Billy begrudgingly returns to Texas to lay low and spend the holidays with his sister and her family. When Meg and Billy cross paths he’s happy to see her but her feelings are on the frostier side: she’s still upset he took advantage of her failed audition to get the gig himself. Meg finds herself seeing Billy more than she’d like since his nephew Graham is in the horse therapy program her dad runs at their ranch. With the annual Reindeer Roundup holiday event coming up, Meg’s dad gets sidelined after an injury and enlists Billy to serve has its host, much to Meg’s chagrin.

title: A Season of Promises
overview: Heidi (D'Orsay) and Sophie (Liebert) are sisters who couldn't be more different – Heidi is buttoned-up and laser-focused on landing the play-by-play job for the local pro hockey team while Sophie is following her dream of making it in stand-up comedy while waitressing. Though a years-ago rift following their mother's passing has pulled the sisters apart, what they do share is a deep love for their father, Ed (Denton). When a fainting episode lands Ed in the hospital, Heidi and Sophie rush to his side. Hating seeing their father in that state – and still alone four years after losing their mother – the sisters decide to set aside their differences and team up to play Cupid at Christmas. As Heidi and Sophie work together to prepare Ed for the dating world in the hope he'll find someone special in time for the holiday, they each go on their own journeys that bring them unexpected joy, love and peace for Christmas.

title: Holiday Unplugged
overview: Sally (DeLoach), an art teacher, has spent the last 10 years honoring the memory of her late husband, Jake, while raising their children, Keegan (Brandon Ironside) and Boo (Remy Marthaller). Feeling like she’s finally ready for love, she joins a dating app and is matched with Damon (Di Pace), her former colleague who taught her kids’ kindergarten class. Jake had co-founded a web platform that preserved family home videos. When a server migration wipes out Sally’s treasured videos of him – and her phone containing backup copies accidentally shatters – the only hope is finding the original tapes. She doesn’t want Keegan and Boo to know about the missing videos so to buy time until they’re recovered, Sally institutes a screen-free Christmas for her family while secretly searching for the tapes.

title: Merry Memories
overview: Michaela (Lindura) is a rigid accountant who steps in to help her brother care for his young son Danny (Omi Fitzpatrick-Gonzales) while Danny's military mom is deployed over Christmas. When Danny is assigned to create a holiday scrapbook for his mom, Michaela reluctantly accepts help from his free-spirited substitute teacher, Bryan (Morgan), whose creativity clashes with her need for preciseness and control. As they set out to capture festive moments for the scrapbook, unexpected mishaps turn into meaningful traditions – and sparks begin to fly. Through Danny's project, Michaela learns to embrace imperfection and open her heart, while Bryan rethinks his future as a traveling substitute teacher.

title: A Danish Christmas
overview: Marie helps her family's Copenhagen inn at Christmas when Ryan arrives, and she mistakes him for a travel writer. She curates a tour in search of hygge and the two find a connection as well.

title: Forgotten Holiday
overview: Kathryn Liu is an antiques buyer for her father’s store and has been happily dating Rob Ashford for nearly a year. When he surprises her with a pre-Christmas proposal, her fear of a failed relationship sends her dashing away without giving him an answer. Heartbroken, as Rob drives to his sister’s house he has a car accident that leaves him without memories of the past year, including their relationship and his once-infectious love of Christmas. Following the unconventional orders from his doctor, Kathryn agrees to help trigger Rob’s memory by retracing their romance and reintroducing him to the holidays. But as his memories inch closer to returning, Kathryn must face the painful truth that bringing Rob back to himself may mean losing him forever, unless she can finally find the courage to fight for the love she was too afraid to claim.

title: Vertigo
overview: When Federico invites his friends Vera and Nico to try a mysterious new drug, the experiment quickly turns into a disorienting psychological journey. As the substance takes effect, reality begins to fracture and hidden tensions emerge. Between hallucinations and memories, the three friends are forced to confront the fragile boundaries between perception and truth.

The acclaimed play is now converted to a gripping film, teaching of mental collapse and burdensome secrets.

title: Non-Migrants
overview: In a small Bulgarian town a young man faces a crisis when his girlfriend plans to emigrate abroad. Angered, he breaks into the abandoned local factory and starts working without any specific purpose, ideology, or political agenda. But this unusual form of “protest” attracts media attention and may unexpectedly restore lost faith and friendships.

title: Unspoken Bond
overview: A feature documentary about a relationship often overlooked: the bond between humans and animals—not a substitute for human connection, but a profound one in its own right. Through three lives transformed by an animal, it reveals a bond that heals and connects us as deeply as any human relationship.

title: The Watergate Caper: Richard Nixon and the Death of the American Dream
overview: The Watergate Caper is an archival documentary, narrated by Harry Shearer (This is Spinal Tap), tracing the rise and fall of Nixon from the presidential primaries of 1968 through the Watergate break-in of June 1972 to his resignation two years later, killing trust in the political process and the American presidency in the wake of the Vietnam War.  The film draws on hundreds of hours of TV news taped off-air by the Nixon White House to tell the untold story of the Watergate burglars. How did tapping the wrong phone with a bug that didn't work lead to their arrests and Nixon's resignation?  It also explores representations of the Nixon years in popular culture, using the music, commercials, and cinema of the era to evoke a fevered political landscape of culture wars, dirty tricks, paranoia and assassination.

overview: Roars and shrieks sound in the dark. The camera turns to a man and woman ferociously cursing and hitting each other. The disturbance seems likely to grow and draw in the surrounding people in the village, but eventually the man and woman arguing break out in song, and their rage spreads into a group dance. Through a powerful single shot, this documentary poses questions about the relationships that bind the person who films, the people who are filmed, and the people who watch, that is, the audience.

title: Sleeping Eyes
overview: The black object that falls from the sky is not a “monolith” but a smartphone. People whose freedom to read and see has been stripped away by the flood of visual information inundating modern society eventually have even their physical bodies symbolized and digitally transformed. This work attempts to satirically depict everyday scenes using video game engines, 3D capturing, and eye tracking technology.

title: Our Times
overview: Double exposure cinematography creates a subtle discrepancy in the actions the characters perform in a peaceful landscape surrounded by greenery and a blue sky. Does this discrepancy show the possibility of a new “different” way of living, or the constraints of a repetitive daily life from which there is no escape? A longing for reality expressed through poetic text and the warm texture of analog film.

title: Teteu
overview: A documentary that follows Jabjab, a boy living in the forest in West Sumatra, Indonesia, with calm and peaceful footage. Indigenous people who choose a traditional lifestyle of coexistence with the forest are influenced by developments from the outside world and are ineluctably drawn toward changes in their way of life. Scenes of a boy going to the city to attend school are contrasted with those of a boy living in the forest through well-composed black and white and color footage.

title: Fridged

title: True Colours
overview: Detective Tom Webourne isn’t your average rugged scrappy looking detective… He has  heightened senses. When the police stumble across a crime scene which they are clueless  about it’s the detective’s time to shine. title: Tableaux
overview: Tableaux presents three new works by Ulrich Seidl for the Über das Leben, die Liebe und den Tod exhibition in EYE FilmMuseum in Amsterdam . Each is composed of footage originally shot for different films but never used. The material consists of so-called tableaux, a distinctive hallmark of Seidl’s visual language in which one or more of his protagonists are filmed looking directly into the camera in silence for a brief period. These images or scenes are unsettling not only because they break the ‘sacred’ fourth wall, but above all because Seidl makes the viewer complicit. The protagonists look directly into your eyes. It is as though the viewer, rather than the person on screen, is caught in the act of voyeurism. The effect is disconcerting, yet it also creates a more immediate sense of engagement with the characters.

title: Asambhauuu
overview: The story is a metaphor for Yudhishthira and the dog, and explores the idea of dharma. Chintu, a dog, loves his owner, Chintan, like a brother. Chintan, too, loves him with all his heart. When fate puts their love and loyalty to the test, they go to extraordinary lengths to fight for each other.

title: Á Huldu - The Hidden Ones
overview: In the Icelandic countryside, a news cameraman is found dead under unsettling circumstances, his reporter colleague has vanished without a trace.  The mystery remains unsolved.  Years later, a documentary crew retraces the investigation, piecing together fragments of testimony, archival material, and newly uncovered footage. What begins as a cold case review becomes something more elusive as new evidence reveals hidden connections and unanswered questions.  Á Huldu – The Hidden Ones is an 85-minute English and Icelandic-language feature that adopts a true-crime documentary framework to explore the instability of truth, the ethics of observation, and the persistence of unresolved narratives.

title: The Movie: False Architecture

Though he fights with all his upper-body strength, he cannot scream or pull away as he is dragged into an infinite maze of millions of liminal levels. Max spends weeks traversing these architectural nightmares while the invisible creature stalks his every move. He finally reaches the final level: a terrifyingly exact duplicate of his own house. The monster attacks, violently choking Max on the bedroom floor. Desperate, Max grabs his heavy metal tripod and tripod light, brutally smacking the creature until a spray of blood outlines its horrifying shape. Escaping through the front door, Max collapses onto his actual kitchen floor and is reunited with Max’s Mom. As she hugs him, Max looks over her shoulder. The green light is still burning under the fridge. He didn't escape; the woman he is holding is just a duplicate of the shape-shifting entity.

overview: Dasha is flying to another country, but just before her departure, she stops by to say goodbye to her childhood friend Fedya, who is transforming an abandoned factory into escape rooms. While touring the deserted spaces, Dasha reminisces about her childhood and risks missing her flight.

title: Завтра
overview: Pavel is mired in debt and in desperate need of money. His creditors are determined to collect what is owed—at any cost and as soon as possible. Driven by desperation, Pavel decides to take a risk; borrowing his wife’s car under the pretext of celebrating his son’s birthday, he seizes a final chance to make some easy money.

title: Talking Stage
overview: As two strangers prepare for their first date, well-meaning friends take over the conversation, turning a promising romance into a comedy of mixed messages, modern dating and missed connections.

title: Sour Grapes
overview: When her husband skips couples' therapy, Justine is left face-to-face with his over prepared personal assistant instead.

title: Secret Dinner Guest
overview: When an invisible dinner guest joins the table, a light-hearted evening quickly descends into unsettling chaos.

title: Lovers' Quarrel
overview: A cosy night in turns into complete chaos when a desperate friend crashes a couple's evening, hiding from his furious girlfriend after an unfortunate case of mistaken identity.

title: Barricade
overview: A couple's intense argument traps two housemates outside their own kitchen, forcing them into increasingly desperate attempts to rescue a cake before it's too late.

title: Ouroboros
overview: Jacot is a silent executioner: he kills, he carries out orders, he never fails at his task. When Perrin, an overly talkative guard, brings him a child to execute, he chooses to defy the royal order and lets the child escape.  Jacot must then face the consequences of his act: if he is found out, he will be condemned himself. He will have to cover his tracks and craft a lie so perfect that Perrin will believe it.

title: Joan
overview: The morning after a one night stand takes an emotional turn.

title: One More Spin
overview: A man and a woman cross paths while doing laundry, each stealing glances but exchanging few words. In their minds, the quiet between them fills with a rapid montage of imagined encounters—from instant chemistry to comedic disasters, heartfelt confessions to utterly bizarre twists. We see each version through both sets of eyes, revealing how differently two people can overthink the same moment. As the dryer stops and reality returns, they are faced with the decision to finally make a move.

title: A Última Diária
overview: Designed to symbolize luxury in Brasilia, the Torre Palace Hotel was abandoned, occupied, and demolished. Amidst archives, ruins, and memories, the building re-emerges as the protagonist of an essay on the city, housing, and destruction.

title: Stack
overview: On the eve of Father’s Day, a bricklayer-preacher named Stack juggles two job sites and one Sunday sermon — all within 48 hours. Set in Cleveland, this short film captures the rhythm of faith, fatherhood, and the quiet grind that holds a family together.

title: Work, Create, Repeat
overview: Kira Cummings, a pyrography (woodburning) artist from Jackson, Mississippi, embodies persistence. To fuel her creative fire, she’s had to juggle as many as three jobs while chasing her dream of making a living from her art.

title: Homo Umbilicus
overview: A farmer's belly propels him into an extraordinary world, turning Homo Sapiens to Homo Umbilicus.

title: Detective Conan: The Counterfeit Case of Ultra 30
overview: As a new 10,000-yen banknote featuring the Touto Tower design is issued and the nation is swept up in excitement, Conan and the Junior Detective League, accompanied by Professor Agasa, Ran, and Sonoko, visit the Nagano factory of the Japan Banknote Printing Bureau. Meanwhile, counterfeit money is discovered at the scene of a murder in Tokyo, prompting the Metropolitan Police Department to establish an investigation headquarters. As the unprecedented circulation of counterfeit new banknotes throws the public into confusion, Conan and Heiji head to Osaka, where the counterfeit money is believed to have been printed.
original_title: 名探偵コナン 30号殺人事件

title: Ghost Stories
overview: A librarian is closing up the library to only find out that they aren't alone.

title: Slåtter
overview: The short film premieres as part of World Affairs’ exhibition "Collected Works 2016–2026" by Jonatan Leandoer Håstad.

title: Amped
overview: A dysfunctional and toxic rock band is barely being held together by their stressed-out manager. With one last concert to impress a record label and get signed, the band's future hangs in the balance as tensions threaten to tear them apart.

title: La jangada
overview: La Jangada is the union of 35 musicians embraced by nature with a common goal: to bring to life songs that are born from the heart of this country.  In search of the vastness that these songs convey, we wanted to bring a piece of Santiago del Estero's land straight to the Río de La Plata.

title: Michael Jackson: Animated
overview: The Life Of Michael Jackson, Animated!

title: 70 Up: The Victorians
overview: 70 Up: The Victorians - A year after the 7Up children looked to Britain’s future, the filmmakers flipped the script and looked to its past. Hear the incredible stories of people born in Victorian Britain

title: No One Leaves
overview: When Meredith and her husband go to have dinner with their neighbor on the next farm over, he introduces them to his visiting niece. But as the evening progresses, Meredith begins to suspect that this young woman isn't his niece, but his captive.

title: The Classroom
overview: In a systematic classroom, the routine changes after the disappearance of Gustavo's backpack and an argument between Guilherme and Pietro over a seat.

title: A Clockwriter
overview: A screenwriter’s character manifests time, with each typewritten letter advancing the clock one minute closer to an encircling deadline.

title: Beyond
overview: Beyond follows people living with and beyond cancer as they discover strength, connection, and a new sense of possibility through climbing. Set between indoor walls and wild mountain rock, it is a powerful story about recovery becoming adventure.

title: Cascarrabias
overview: When Chava returns home to care for his ailing father, bitter truths lead them to a point of no return.

title: Area Codes
overview: A girl from Stockton, Gabriella, breaks up with her boyfriend of 4 years and decides to help her best friend move to Los Angeles as a short getaway. At the biggest night market in LA, he meets a boy who was born and raised in SoCal, Jayson, and he shows her iconic and sentimental places within every area code of the greater LA area.

title: Mysticisme du Sud
overview: Three friends search for a magic lake that mysteriously appeared in South Tunisia. While some people think it could be a curse, others believe that this appearance exists because of local practices and occult rituals. People search for it, seeking the prophetic qualities it is said to possess. Between tales, strange visions and possession, we get through a region that is still searching for something more.

title: Exhibition on Screen: Monet
overview: To coincide with a major exhibition at Tate Britain, Exhibition on Screen brings a brand-new film dedicated to the father of Impressionism, Claude Monet. The documentary explores his passion, rebellion, and his revolutionary mastery of light and color.

title: Hotel Alcohol
overview: In the psychiatric hospital, the chief doctor organizes the "Olympic Games," in which protagonists Bako, Medea, and Drago form a group called "Hotel Alcohol." They lose the games, leave the hospital, and head toward the sea.

title: Narcs
overview: After two hall monitors catch wind of a debaucherous high school party, they team up with an excommunicated popular girl to stop the party and save their classmates from ruining their lives.

title: Killer Ants
overview: A quiet community is thrown into terror when a deadly breed of ants begins spreading without warning. Small enough to go unnoticed and dangerous enough to overwhelm anyone in their path, the insects quickly turn familiar surroundings into a deadly trap.  As the infestation grows, survival becomes a race against an enemy that can enter almost anywhere. With the threat multiplying and escape becoming increasingly difficult, those caught in its path must find a way to stop the swarm before it consumes everything around them.

title: The Dateline Holiday Special
overview: Undercover E.L.F. (Evil Lad Finder) Chris Miss is on a mission to confront and interrogate a suspected Evil Lad.

title: Ethereal Grounds
overview: Ethereal Grounds engages with the filmic rituals embedded within emotional rites of passage, regeneration, and transformation through an evolving dialogue between land-based narration, projection environments, and hand-drawn interventions.  Layered imagery, atmospheric textures, and cinematic language dissolve into reflective spaces suspended between the imagined and the embodied.

title: Entre líneas
overview: A young man wanders the city, sketching urban scenes that catch his eye in his notebook. It is during this journey that he discovers what he truly wants to do.

title: Ghost Light

title: Change of Heart
overview: Maia lives with her grandmother, Nora, on the family’s conventional cattle farm, which she will be taking over. After a devastating storm, Maia’s livelihood is questioned by her eco-minded neighbors and an anxiety is ignited in her, as she starts to grasp the disturbing scale of climate change. Maia must navigate between acting against the dire future of the planet and staying true to her heritage. Maia Against the World is a heartfelt and humorous drama about generational divides, eco-anxiety and cows.

title: Némesis
overview: When four friends are bored at home, they decide to go up to the attic to find something to entertain themselves. While searching, they discover a mysterious VHS tape labeled “NÉMESIS. DO NOT OPEN.”

title: Starting Towards the Finish Line
overview: Ever since his mother moved to the city for work, Xiaoqing, who has lost his father, has had a dream: he too wants to go to the Lotus City. After many setbacks, his goal seems out of reach. But when he finds an old, rusty car in the reeds, he finds new hope: will he and his friends make it to the city?

title: A Doctor to Die For: The Sarah Harris Story
overview: Sarah is drawn into a dangerous relationship with a middle-aged surgeon Dr. James Ryan. As Dr. Ryan secretly supplies her with surgical-grade drugs to keep her compliant and submissive, Sarah's life spirals out of control.

title: Fatherhood
overview: Devoted soon-to-be father Lee grapples with work-family balance and self-doubt, but a surprising connection with a regular customer awakens a longing for the fatherly bond he never had.

title: Festive Fun with Peppa
overview: Join Peppa Pig and her family as they celebrate baby Evie’s first Christmas. This festive cinema experience brings together seven classic festive-themed Peppa Pig episodes, new interstitial content, and four brand-new songs with music videos. From snowy adventures and festive plays to decorating the Christmas tree, Peppa and her family share treasured Christmas memories in this special big-screen experience.

title: Maut
overview: Defying his father's wish to pass on the family reindeer-herding business, a young Evenk decides to leave for the city to work—a choice that becomes a personal tragedy for the herder.

title: Scent of colors
overview: Mina forms a study group, but whenever she feels a strange distance growing between herself and her friends, she quietly pulls away. She does not clearly understand what the feeling is.  As she comes face to face with each friend, Mina begins to realize that they, too, see strengths in her that she has never recognized in herself.  Without directly naming the emotion, the film explores the vague feelings that make us feel small, redefining them through different words, relationships, and emotional shades.

title: Echo of the Recess
overview: Xu Xiao, a Senior Two student from an impoverished family, always wears dust-streaked clothes. She suffers prolonged ostracism and vicious sneers led by classmate Zhou Qing and her gang. Her lunch tray is publicly knocked over, and she is subjected to humiliating torment in a rainy alley. Her only friend Su Meng keeps her distance, terrified of being implicated. When Xu Xiao seeks help from her head teacher, she only gets perfunctory, dismissive words. Her mother works nonstop to sustain the family, too swamped to detect the despair buried deep in her daughter’s heart. Abandoned by everyone, Xu Xiao has nowhere to seek solace.

title: IVDICO
overview: Summer, 2010. Sunyoung (38), a former judge turned lawyer, runs her own law office while raising her daughter alone after a divorce. As the time to pick up her daughter Sohee approaches, a legal consultation with a middle-aged man named Sangryeol who arrives late holds her back. The longer the consultation drags on, the further his words stray from the law, and the conversation slowly curdles into an inexplicable unease.

title: Yémen, carrefour de toutes les guerres
original_title: Yémen, carrefour de toutes les guerres

title: The Fixation
overview: Álvaro, an accomplished photographer struggling with debt and his father’s terminal illness, reluctantly accepts an erotic photography assignment designed to recruit VIP clients. But the project takes an unexpected turn when he discovers that its star is Felipe, a famous model with whom he shares a turbulent past. Their reunion reignites a toxic relationship fueled by desire, jealousy, and obsession. As tensions escalate and increasingly dangerous situations surround the project, Álvaro must navigate the blurred lines between passion and madness while fighting to maintain his sanity—and survive.

title: The Last Chapter
overview: A group of friends reunites for a long-overdue visit at the home of an old college classmate, now an eccentric, bestselling author and collector. What begins as a seemingly innocent reunion takes an unexpected turn as the day unfolds, revealing that their host has brought them together to confront the past and settle some unfinished business rooted in revenge.

title: Isla
overview: Lusted after by all, she trades her innocence to escape her island. Betrayed, she strips away her abusers' darkest secrets in this sultry cinematic classic.

title: Cherry Tomato Kit
overview: Noma, a hikikomori, orders something every day from Aeri's Shop, a secondhand goods seller online — all for the handwritten note tucked into the package. Aeri's notes alone are enough for him, and on them he builds a love that grows misshapen. The day after Aeri calls him by name for the first time, a package arrives that isn't what he ordered.

title: Beware of Loss
overview: As children, we all had something that once felt like the most precious thing in the world. For the protagonist, it was a toy that was always by their side. Yet now, having grown up, they find themselves no longer cherishing that toy as they once did.  “Why do we eventually forget the toys that once meant the most to us?”  Through the documentary, we explore how the things we hold dear change as we grow. In the place once occupied by a beloved toy, other precious things have taken its place—friends, family, relationships, and memories.

title: Chin Up, Girl
overview: Her boyfriend bets she can't do a pull-up because she's a woman. Stung, Jieun practices with her friend Sujeong, struggling to get it right. As they're at it, a stranger walks over and starts giving unsolicited advice. Rather than argue, the two flip the situation on its head—and laugh.

As they confront their unresolved lives, doubts and fears, their reunion becomes a portrait of a generation caught between the end of youth and an uncertain future.

title: Backwoods
overview: A group of teenagers sets out on a camping trip to the woods for a couple of days. They arrive at the very spot where one of them had already spent time with his father on several occasions. The kids settle in, feeling calm and comfortable. It seemed as though nothing foreshadowed trouble.  But everything changes when the friends decide to play hide-and-seek. From that moment on, dark times begin. At the same time, a mute boy appears in the woods—and he’s not there by accident. No one even suspects that this two-day camping trip will lead to the uncovering of terrifying secrets.

original_title: Todo lo que (no) nos dijimos anoche

overview: Jonas Durnell's grandfather, Leslie Durnell, recounts his life experiences.

title: Tickets, Please.
overview: On her daily commute to work, an aspiring entrepreneur has recurring visions of a man finding a duffel bag full of cash. But when she encounters strange people who suddenly become rich in unexpected ways, her reality begins to unravel as she struggles with the unseen powers which determine fate and fortune.
trailerName: TICKETS, PLEASE. - Teaser Trailer | A Surrealist Short Film (2026)

title: Riza
overview: In an apartment, a man tends to a tree with quiet devotion. He waters it, he cleans it. The tree forgets, he remembers. An allegory about love turning into duty, care becoming a prison, and the quiet, delicate line between offering and losing oneself. The film tells the story of a man caring for his mother with dementia, a silent struggle between fading memory and enduring love.

title: Edgar Allan Poe’s Murder Mystery Dinner Party: The Musical
overview: Edgar Allan Poe is throwing a murder mystery dinner party, and you’re invited—alongside his ghostly sidekick Lenore and a room full of famous authors, all with something to hide. But as the wine flows and the fake murders become real, guests start dropping like flies. Whodunnit? Why!? And who’s next?!!  Join literary legends from Mary Shelley and Lewis Carroll to Jane Austen and Oscar Wilde as they scramble to solve the mystery, protect their secrets, and defend their outsized egos.  Based on the hit web series, this brand-new musical serves up mystery, mayhem, and original songs in one delightfully deadly night of theatre.
