title: Doggy-Dog World
overview: On the night of his band’s big come-back, a sober musician has a panic attack and locks himself in the green room with a bottle of schnapps. It’s up to his long-suffering best friend to get him through it and get him on stage.

title: Burdened
overview: After a tragic car crash leaves their mother in a coma, 19-year-old Dakota is forced into adulthood as she becomes the primary caregiver for her younger brother, Zach, a young boy struggling with severe ADHD. Torn between grief, guilt, and her own stalled future, she must decide how much of herself she can give without disappearing.

title: Where the Hell Is Anna?
overview: When her estranged best friend Anna mysteriously vanishes into a women-only retreat in the woods, messy and heartbroken Derick crashes the culty pagan commune determined to bring her home. But the longer she stays, the harder it gets to tell who’s healing and who’s brainwashed. As the Summer Solstice nears and Anna is chosen for a “ceremony” called Induction Day, Derick uncovers disturbing secrets buried beneath the flower crowns and sisterhood mantras, including blood rituals, fertility experiments, and the looming promise of paradise known as Summerland.

title: Dissociar
overview: Sol wakes up in a strange place but eventually realizes that the whole place feels more like an endless purgatory.

title: The Alfred Eulogy
overview: Following the death of his friend Alfred, Ryan prepares to deliver a eulogy. What begins as an attempt to remember the dead gradually becomes a deeply personal confrontation with grief, guilt, resentment, loneliness, and everything left unsaid between two people.  As Ryan’s memories begin to fracture and contradict one another, the distinction between remembrance and reality slowly dissolves. The Alfred Eulogy is an intimate exploration of grief, masculinity, emotional repression, and the weight of words that were never spoken.

title: Shadow in the Desert
overview: An unknown creature haunts a young woman struggling with addiction after she steals a relic tainted with sinister energy.

title: Jane In Rewind
overview: A newly queer girl named Jane finally scores a date with the experienced cool girl Emily, but when the date starts going south, Jane finds out she can rewind time.

title: The Higher Path
overview: Simon is a jaded office worker whose life seems to be going nowhere. He is repeatedly passed over for promotion, he is bullied by the sleazy office alpha, and he has unrequited feelings for his beautiful colleague, Jen. Then one day, Simon stumbles across a mysterious self-help tape and becomes captivated by the strange and enigmatic voice which promises life-changing benefits and rewards. All he needs to do is listen to the tapes and follow the Higher Path. Simon soon commits to the Higher Path and receives the full set of tapes from a mysterious cult of men. His life begins to change dramatically: he beats his alpha male colleague to a promotion and gets the girl of his dreams… but at what cost? Dark visions start to plague Simon’s mind, and strange men begin to stalk him. Simon soon discovers that the voice on his tapes may have an agenda of its own.

title: Us
overview: In a country marked by violence, a group of incarcerated women participates in a film workshop inside a prison in Guayaquil. As they film their daily lives, stories of love, guilt, and forced separation from their children emerge. Through games and confessions, the camera creates a space for resistance, where imagination transcends the prison’s boundaries and allows them to explore other ways of being.

title: Zebras
overview: A young man lends his house to a friend while he is away at work, leading the friend to embark on a schizophrenic adventure.

title: Meat the Future
overview: Tommy Watanabe, a kind-hearted but naïve Japanese yakiniku chef in Taiwan, believes that good food can make the world better. When a cynical teenager tells him to “become president and fix society,” Tommy takes it literally and launches an unlikely grassroots campaign. As his sincerity attracts public attention, a conman exploits Tommy’s trust and steals campaign donations, forcing him to confront the harsh realities behind idealism and politics.

title: Walking on the Flower Street
overview: Centered on the Xihu Spring Flower Market in Yuexiu District, this documentary uses multi-site ethnographic observation to document the 2024 event. It presents Greater Bay Area traditions shaped by Lingnan and Cantonese cultures—flower loving, viewing, using, and growing—expressed through the annual Flower Street Parade as a living form of intangible cultural heritage.

title: Koplopers
overview: When five football hooligans from the south of the Netherlands take part in a social experiment, a confrontational group game exposes hidden vulnerabilities and challenges their loyalty, leading the group to unravel.

title: One Night at KitKat
overview: Berlin, Saturday night. Behind the doors of the legendary KitKatClub, a world unfolds that usually remains hidden. In a place where mobile phones are strictly forbidden, a camera was allowed inside. The founding duo looks back on the origins of the club—a venue that, like few others, epitomizes Berlin’s club culture, techno, the fetish scene, and sex-positive parties. Guests and staff share stories of self-acceptance, body positivity, and community. Intimate, unfiltered, and non-judgmental, the documentary offers an exclusive glimpse into a night at the KitKat.

title: Lefty and Righty Found A Home
overview: Two pieces of clothing come to life and set off on an unexpected journey in search of a home, discovering friendship, courage and a sense of belonging along the way.
original_title: Лефти и Рајти си најдоа дом

title: GANGSTALKER!
overview: A young reptilian is sent to earth on a mission to hunt incels.

title: Hurricane
overview: Manuel, a young filmmaker, seeks help from his friend Facundo to develop his script. Together they make the story come to life and the characters become independent. However, at the end, different possible paths arise that strain their relationship.

title: Atomic Eve
overview: In the year 2029, the world is at war. As announcements of incoming nuclear attack shake the United States, people of all walks of life scramble to reconcile with the end of the world.

title: Snowbody Like You
overview: A holiday first date ends in a frosty misunderstanding, leaving Peyton and Ethan to go their separate ways. Years later, a Christmas blizzard brings them back together, giving them one more chance to discover if the magic between them was meant to last.

title: Chocolate for Christmas
overview: When a woman returns home to save her family’s beloved chocolate shop, she finds unexpected love and a renewed appreciation for what matters most. This sweet holiday romance celebrates family, community and the lasting power of tradition.

title: Morsefest 2025
overview: Recorded live at Trinity Church, Brentwood, UK on February 5-7 2026. The weekend features songs from Spock's Beard, performances from Cosmic Cathedral, Neal Morse and the Resonance, and the 20th anniversay performance of Neal Morse's One album.  Blu-ray 1 – Neal Morse & The Resonance / Cosmic Cathedral Blu-ray 2 – Beardtunes / One 20th Anniversary

title: nois
overview: Pietro Ximenes, through an old Cyber-shot camera, records his last year with Ana, João Matheus, Pedro, Antônia, Luiz Felipe, Arthur, Yan, Daniel and Laura studying together

title: Opens Tonight
overview: A showcase of 100 years of film programming at the historic Tampa Theatre.

title: Horror Insurance
overview: A homeowner is approached by a door-to-door insurance saleswoman, offering Horror Insurance. When the homeowner refuses, the salesperson calls on her colleagues to gently persuade the homeowner into a sale.

title: Scammed
overview: Millions of Americans have fallen victim to a growing epidemic of online scams, from sextortion schemes aimed at teens to crypto investment scams targeting seniors.  FRONTLINE and Associated Press have spent more than a year investigating this shadowy world that's grown into a global criminal industry, powered in many cases by organized crime, trafficked labor, American technology, and, increasingly, Al.

title: Tambu
overview: Tambuisa is a documentary exploring TambuFest, a day-long celebration of drumming and dance in Jamaica. TambuFest was conceived and produced by University of Pennsylvania anthropologist Deborah A. Thomas, musician Junior “Gabu” Wedderburn, and Dr. Nicholas Ferguson, a medical doctor and drummer. The word “tambu” is used throughout the African Diaspora to describe various drumming traditions and styles.

title: Diaspora Power
overview: Inspired by the stories of Haitian women and men who arrived in Quebec during the 1960s and 1970s, Diaspora Power, directed by Joseph Hillel, traces a generation navigating exile, migration, and the challenges of building a new home.  Through intimate personal stories, the documentary explores the realities of integration and systemic racism alongside the solidarity, community networks, and cultural connections that sustained Haitian immigrants as they established new lives in Quebec. Together, these individual experiences form a collective portrait of a diaspora determined to maintain its roots while becoming an integral part of Quebec society.  Diaspora Power is both an act of remembrance and transmission, honoring the people whose lives, labor, and resilience helped shape the social and cultural fabric of contemporary Quebec.

title: Unsanctioned in a Sanctuary City
overview: New York City has always been shaped by migrants. Unsanctioned in a Sanctuary City, collectively created by high school filmmakers from Educational Video Center’s Youth Documentary Workshop, examines what it means to be an immigrant in New York amid increased immigration enforcement and ICE activity under the Trump administration.  Focusing on the experiences of street vendors, the young filmmakers explore the relationship between migration, work, community, and belonging while examining how federal immigration policies affect the people whose labor and cultures help make New York City what it is.  Through a youth-led lens, Unsanctioned in a Sanctuary City asks what the promise of a “sanctuary city” means when immigrant New Yorkers continue to live and work under the threat of detention and deportation.

title: No Place Like Home
overview: Housing is a human right. Why should people go through so much trouble for a right that everyone deserves? Everyone should have access to affordable housing. As it stands in New York City, housing has become a commodity for the profit of few. No Place Like Home is a documentary that explores this issue and hopes to get people thinking about possible solutions to this problem.

title: Where Do Black Men Live?
overview: Where Do Black Men Live? explores the experiences of low-income and housing-insecure Black men in Cambridge, Massachusetts, amplifying voices too often excluded from conversations about housing, urban policy, and racial justice. Produced by The Black Response and based on 25 ethnographic interviews conducted by Haitian sociologist Stephanie Guirand for her doctoral research, the film uses a verbatim theatre approach, with its dialogue drawn directly from the words of the men interviewed. Eight men, portrayed by actors, are brought together in an imagined circle where they share deeply personal experiences of searching for, securing, and maintaining a place to call home. Directed by Corinne Spencer, with co-directors Gift Tapiwa Marovatsanga and Joy Wrolson, Where Do Black Men Live? transforms research and lived testimony into an intimate exploration of housing insecurity, systemic racism, resilience, and the fundamental question of who gets to feel secure and at home.

title: Remedy for a Broken Faith
overview: A journal entry brought to life, a woman explores grief and what remains of herself in the aftermath of loss. After years of numbing herself against emotions like anger and sadness, a moment of jealousy triggers new reflections and a journey of self-discovery. Or rather, re-discovery. In finding the courage to admit her feelings to herself, she recovers her strength to hope.

title: Other Half
overview: After cheating on her girlfriend, Jade (Grace Rolek) finds herself isolated in a world of newfound heart break. Determined to suffer through the grieving process alone, she refuses to answer calls, texts or communicate with friends and family. In her booze-soaked depression, Jade attempts to rediscover what being alone really means. With no one to blame but herself, she indulges in self-destructive behavior to cope. Despite her attempts to ignore her estranged best friend Avery (Cleopatra Boudreau), Jade is surprised to find her showing up at her door and entering (well, stampeding) into her space. title: Rising: Voices of Protest and Hope

title: The Fold
overview: A visual and psychological investigation of the French psychiatrist and photographer Gaëtan Gatian de Clérambault (1872–1934), who took thousands of images in Morocco of veiled Islamic women, and sometimes men, through which he sought to explore his psychoanalytic ideas about covering and fantasy. Through a digital re-imagining of his death — a suicide in front of a mirror —, followed by assessments of clinicians and academics, The Fold explores de Clérambault’s significance as a historical figure while also looking more broadly at the way we understand images. The interviews are filmed within a setting inspired by the house of mirrors in Orson Welles’s The Lady from Shanghai (1947) and draw on the aesthetic of film noir, a style of cinema that commonly features a crime-centred narrative and morally ambiguous male protagonists.

She is contacted when people believe the end is near. title: Badge

In pursuit of the suspected thief, he encounters three Cub Scouts—Gah-eul, Yena, and Dasom.  When he learns that the culprit is connected to the Scout troop, Kyeongnam reluctantly teams up with the three children to recover his bicycle, embarking on an unexpected adventure along the way.

title: A Court of Claws and Riesling
overview: A young woman, dissatisfied with modern dating, adopts a cat despite her allergies – only to find that the combination of antihistamines and white wine has her hallucinating a handsome fae lord, straight out of her saucy books… But he may have sinister intentions.
original_title: A Court of Claws and Riesling

title: Void
overview: Ernest, a man slowly losing himself to dementia, struggles to care for his bed-ridden sister as reality begins to fracture around him. Through surreal, absurd, and liminal flashes, his memories, routines, and sense of identity gradually dissolve, until he can no longer recognize the person he once lived for.

title: Take It Back
overview: On the eve of college, aspiring filmmaker Anna clashes with her controlling mother. A chance encounter with a man from her childhood resurfaces a painful secret, pushing years of resentment to a breaking point.

title: Fever Dreams
overview: Nick pieces together a mystery from his childhood: who, or what, killed his mother.

title: 28 Kegs Later
overview: When the zombie apocalypse breaks out, two unsuspecting heroes discover that there is one trick to not get bit: You must stay drunk. They decide to throw the biggest party in town to save as many people as they can. Starring Dave Anthony (Maron) and Gareth Reynolds (New Girl), this horror-comedy is a party you won't want to miss.

title: Aarambham Oru Albaniyo Katha
overview: Four unemployed graduates from Bethoorpara, North Kerala, face ridicule from family and society. When they finally land a job, it brings unexpected trouble, forcing them into a desperate struggle to escape.

title: I suoi occhi mi parlano ancora
original_title: I suoi occhi mi parlano ancora

title: Her Only Way Out
overview: After surviving a terrifying crash and being coerced into silence, a woman realizes the only way to escape is to stage her own death and disappear completely.

title: The Alienist
overview: A small-town psychiatrist loses the sight of distinction between sanity and insanity, beginning to commit anyone.
cast: João Pedro Pires de Fraga Moreira

title: Ukraine Ghost Ship
overview: When Russian forces bombed a giant hydroelectric dam on Ukraine’s mighty Dnipro River in June 2023, farmland flooded, homes were destroyed and over 50 people lost their lives. Upriver, as waters drained, ancient ships’ timbers were uncovered on the newly exposed beach. Now, a Ukrainian archaeologist Dmitro Kobaliaa has assembled an international team to recover these remains, to reveal the story of a vast Russian military flotilla sent to conquer land around the Black Sea coast. It’s a battle still raging today. As fighter jets shoot overhead, Dmitro’s discoveries reveal a history of Ukraine before Russian rule, a history the Russians are trying to destroy, but one Dmitro is desperate to preserve.

title: Run
overview: RUN is a short zombie thriller about two survivors in a city that's already fallen. Food is scarce. Hope is fading. They're forced out of hiding to make a dangerous supply run, but after encountering the infected, they become separated.

title: Marvel Zombies: The Winter Soldier
overview: The first of three specials following the events of the Marvel Zombies series.

title: The Property
overview: When two desperate university students, Timothy and Bryce, answer a Craigslist ad in the country for a sum of cash, their seemingly odd host shifts into something far more sinister, threatening their lives.

title: Only Me
overview: A disoriented man wakes up in a car in the middle of nowhere, with a gun, a cryptic note and a bound woman. As events unfold, he is drawn into the disturbing world of a Mumbai model whose carefully constructed rituals blur the lines between victim and predator. Through violence, deception and haunting memories, the film explores trauma, control and the struggle to reclaim one's agency.

title: Model Citizen
overview: A man awakes from a coma to find that his well-being is now the responsibility of an avatar provided by the government.
trailerName: Model Citizen | Official Trailer | Warner Bros. Entertainment

title: さよならの前に、できること
original_title: さよならの前に、できること

title: The Girl With The Ribbon
overview: The reclusive Jennifer grapples with a life tied together by a thread, when she begins to question the reality of the love between her and her boyfriend, Albert, things begin to gruesomely unravel...

title: Age of Forgotten Heroes: City of Snakes
overview: The Wanderer Marcus Griffin assumes the Heroic name Dynamics Plus as he leaves his homeland in search of adventure. On his quest to discover his greater destiny, he will meet friends, allies, lovers, and discover some legends must be lived to be believed and fate must be tested.
trailerName: Age of Forgotten Heroes- Series Trailer 01
original_title: Age of Forgotten Heroes: City of Snakes

title: ELECTRICKS
overview: An electrician takes a job to replace sockets, desperate for cash after months of unpaid invoices. In a young mother’s flat, he discovers an illegal electricity bypass left behind by her parents. For her, it means a debt of hundreds of thousands; for him, the impossibility of finishing his work. Should he walk away and look for money elsewhere, or help her through unofficial means? A drama about survival in a system that leaves both characters with no choice but to bend its rules.
trailerName: ELEKTRIKY | trailer | Akademie Michael | Kryštof Kindl

title: The Tara on Her Head
overview: An elderly man has always perceived reality as tilted. Gradually, however, everything seems to turn upside down—even the image of Green Tara, to whom he makes daily offerings.  His youngest son, a monk at a temple, is summoned home; he finds himself navigating the boundary between reality and illusion as he tries to understand what is happening to his father.  The most conceptual film in the competition reinterprets themes and figures from Tibetan Buddhism, transporting them into a realm suspended between spirituality, paradox, and irony.

title: Crocodile Tears
overview: Hired to pose as a dead boy's girlfriend, a professional mourner finds her hardest act is keeping herself from falling apart.

title: Fractured
overview: An experimental, performance-driven film that explores the quiet disintegration of a relationship. Through restrained gestures and minimal interaction, it captures two individuals struggling and ultimately failing to rebuild what’s lost, arriving at the realisation that some chapters must end.

title: Procedure
overview: In 1976, Elaine Carter, a closeted police officer, is assigned to escort Thomas Avery, a whistleblower whose actions saved the life of the woman she loves. Confined together mid-flight, Elaine is forced to confront the strict procedure that has defined her career, and the personal cost of finally breaking it.

title: Trash Magnet
overview: An egotistical artist steals a lost watch for their project, and becomes trapped in a time loop that forces them to confront the real-world cost of their self-absorption.

title: Being Gregor
overview: Take on the life of Gregor Samsa, a weary salesman whose world unravels as he transforms from cherished member of the family, into a hideous insect. We all carry multiple identities... but where do you truly belong?

title: Behind the Reflection
overview: A woman struggles with their identity, leading to a life of addiction, alcoholism and violence. A gritty drama based on the true life of Rozelle Gemma.

title: CreatorSMP Hardcore 4 - De Finale
overview: Experience the spectacular finale of CREATORSMP HARDCORE 4, live on Twitch, YouTube and exclusively on the big screen at Pathé! Watch one of the Netherlands' biggest Minecraft creator events unfold and experience every moment of suspense, action, and emotion like never before.  One final adventure. One unforgettable experience.

title: ADHD
overview: Clara, a neurodiverse, overwhelmed corporate employee, struggles to manage her workload and the number of daily tasks she has to keep up with just to stay alive in the modern world, within a sterile corporate environment. After being summoned to a meeting with her manager and HR, she deflects criticism of her work and inappropriate behaviour by blaming everything on her ADHD.

title: The Undiscovered Country
overview: In the wake of a college student's unexplained disappearance, her classmates struggle to make sense of her absence, a mosaic of overlapping memories, fragmented conversations, and shifting perspectives begins to reveal the complex truths they have concealed from one another, and from themselves.

title: The First Silence
overview: A gaslit woman battles with her memory of events.

title: Fire and the Thud
overview: A drunken man comes up with a permanent solution for taking care of a noisy, soul-sucking, gigantic modern-day nuisance.

title: Wet Feathers
overview: After developing a phobia of pigeons, the eccentric Brett Trueman escapes to the underground town of Coober Pedy where he recounts experiences from his life.

title: Adam’s Fire
overview: In the misty mountains of West Virginia, a grieving young boy who has lost all hope finds an unexpected friendship, a chance to heal, and the breathtaking power of forgiveness.

title: Dancing Bull
overview: A rural family trains and decorates their bull for  Gangireddu Melam, an ancient Sankranti tradition. They leave their village and travel to the big city, performing for strangers to make a living. As tradition meets modern life, their journey reveals the struggle to preserve their cultural legacy.

title: A Call for Help
overview: A man calls his friend for help as something or someone chases him.

title: The Righteous Road Trip
overview: A heartwarming holiday journey with Jewish humanitarian Jonny Daniels and his dog Tyson, as they travel 3,100 kilometer across Poland, Slovakia and Hungary in a van filled with Christmas trees and gifts for the last living Righteous Among the Nations, the extraordinary people who saved the lives of Jewish people during the Holocaust – of which less than 65 are still alive today.

title: Süper Kahramanlar 4
overview: Hereos 4 4 4

title: Gaffer
overview: As the manager of an unruly Sunday League team, the Gaffer lives for the 90 minutes every week where he’s in total control. But when his best player goes missing just minutes before the most important game of the season, the Gaffer’s fragile authority begins to crumble.

title: Perfect Imperfection
overview: A conversation between a uni-bound student and his mentor. Exploring themes of voice and vulnerability.

title: Hazard Perception
overview: An expectant father and a woman haunted by her fear of driving spark an unexpected connection while waiting to be called in for their driving test.

title: Close
overview: Keane finds a box of his absent father’s negatives. He prints the images in a darkroom’s red glow. As he and his mother Diane look through distant exposures from the half-past, the prints expose a life that was always out of frame. Closure leads them back to the shoreline, where Keane reframes what remains.

title: Celebrating Tchaikovski
overview: When an impatient female driver's determination to get past a refuse truck threatens the safety of two bin men who disarm their bully with their own infectious and delightful interpretation of art.

title: Untitled Mix
overview: An ambitious young DJ and his stoner sidekick have their friendship tested as they attempt to get airtime on a local pirate radio station.

title: Night Folly
overview: A Super 8 film by James Pearson.

title: Disposable
overview: Rebecca lives in a world where everything is disposable—things, moments, relationships. When she meets Ben, she feels hope for the first time that something could be different. But their encounter sets off a process that forces Rebecca to look at herself and the world in a whole new way.

title: One of One
overview: Milo "Miles" Williams, a rising fashion designer fighting to be seen, meets Vee — a magnetic, enigmatic presence who pushes him to turn his pain into something unforgettable. As success demands reinvention, he must decide how much of himself to sacrifice to become "one of one."
trailerName: One Of One - Official Movie Trailer

title: A Trout and the Last Waltz
overview: Born in rivers, yamame trout journey to the sea and return as cherry salmon, connecting forests, rivers, and coastal communities. This documentary explores how dams, abandoned forests, and renewable energy development have disrupted these natural cycles, examining what economic progress has cost the environment and the cultures shaped by it.
original_title: サクラマスのラストワルツ

title: Your Life Sucks, Here's Why
overview: Cora must choose between seeking help from the real world or an oddly comforting, perfectly-perfect 1950s show, 'The Fix It Family'.

title: Egg
overview: Struggling after his father's death, Josh goes to visit his father's oldest friend Ray, who lives off-grid in remote Wales. Surrounded by wild birds, Josh finds an abandoned egg and is compelled to find its nest to return it and takes Ray along with him. While talking, the two men find a way of sharing their grief and looking forward.

title: The rest is silence
overview: Le reste est silence is a documentary that shows simple moments from the life of an old couple, while displaying a reflection on art, death, and what can be beyond it

title: Andhkar
overview: Andhkar is a suspense thriller about the murder of a famous painter's wife in her bungalow. Set over one night from 6 p.m. to 6 a.m., it is a classic murder mystery where nothing is as it seems.

title: White Lightning
overview: WHITE LIGHTNING is a gritty, funny, and uniquely American story about second chances, legacy, and what it takes to outrun your past. This feature-length documentary follows 18-year-old sprinter King Combest as he attempts to break his father’s 25-year-old national high school record–and the cycle of drugs, jail, and poverty that has shaped his Kentucky family for generations. King’s father Casey (aka “White Lightning”) was once an elite sprinter destined for Olympic greatness before a marijuana arrest derailed his career and left him working as a janitor on the margins of society. As King chases his father’s iconic record, it becomes clear that the real stakes are far greater: becoming the first man in the Combest family to earn a college degree and forging a path beyond a legacy of crime and addiction.

title: Bullet Train: Ready for Tokyo Dome — We Are Bullet Train! -
overview: As Japanese dance-and-vocal group Bullet Train approaches its long-awaited Tokyo Dome concert, this documentary looks back on the journey that brought its members to this milestone. Newly filmed interviews are combined with footage from the group's past live performances, revealing the memories, ambitions, struggles, and personal feelings behind their rise. Created for the group's 15th anniversary, the film celebrates the bond between the members and their devoted fans as they prepare for the next chapter of their story.
original_title: 東京ドーム公演記念 乗車準備会 僕たちは、超特急です!

title: Run and Hit
overview: Two boys find out how to go back in time and accidentally create a time loop.

title: The Strongest Team in Vilnius
overview: From playing on neighborhood courts to winning numerous titles in basketball tournaments. The “Ferimstos” basketball players, who call themselves the strongest team in Vilnius, invite you to join their eighteen-year-long story of friendship—a journey through basketball courts, arguments, wild parties, and eternal love.

title: The Red Chair
overview: A modern legend unfolds when a lone chair appears on the shore, drawing the attention of a curious and watchful community. Through shifting hands and acts of care, the chair becomes woven into the folklore of the shore—until the day it disappears, leaving behind only the unseen forces that shaped its myth.

title: Untitled
overview: An experimental visual and audio exploration into the subconscious mind of Lazarus.

title: Sinking Rockaways
overview: A short documentary by Columbia University Graduate School of Journalism documentary filmmaking postgraduate student Sahar Sedaghat, following local resident Quinn Robinson and the Dune Squad as they work to restore and protect New York’s Rockaway coastline.

title: Invierno ST/CR
overview: Set in Santa Teresa, Costa Rica, “Invierno” emerges from seven years of conversations in the lineup between the film’s Swedish-born director and surfer, Jakob Daschek, with fellow wave rider, Lorenzo Wickstrom Vargas. In Costa Rica and neighboring Central American countries, “invierno,” translates to the rainy season or green season in English, lasting from May through November. The film depicts how the summer is full of tourists, and when “invierno,” begins, it’s the season for the locals.

title: Hot Sand
overview: Co-directed by Rockaway residents, Emma Hastil and Kaia Abraham, “Hot Sand” was shot over the summer of 2025 in Rockaway. It’s a dreamy little glimpse of a hot summer day in a small town, following the people who make the community so unique, yet familiar.

title: Out of Time
overview: When Ethan's father dies, the boy is sent into a bout of depression. But then Ethan finds a way to travel back in time to try and save his father, but learns that fate is a very hard thing to change.
